jobs.name: Internship in Controlling (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At Corporate Finance@BASF, we do not just focus on figures, but solutions. Our approach is strategic and innovative, we get things done. Doing so, the needs of our business partners are priority and we have the finger on the pulse when it comes to sustainability and digitalization. Topics such as evaluation of mergers & acquisitions and major investments, financing, the preparation of published statements, the management of financial risks and advising the board of directors on economic decisions are all part of our daily job. In collaboration with our globally networked communities, we continuously develop and enhance our processes. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Exciting controlling tasks await you in the Group Reporting & Performance Management department from december 2026 for a period of 3 to 6 months. You’ll have the opportunity to apply your academic knowledge and gain valuable insights into BASF’s finance and controlling processes. You will support budget planning, forecasting and risk management activities. Moreover,  you will assist in the systematic analysis of financial and operational data and preparation of both regular and ad hoc reports. You will contribute your knowledge to the identification of business developments as well as trends and thus contribute to economic decision-making. Furthermore, you will work with various IT tools and systems relevant to controlling and reporting. Varied project assignments and international teamwork complement the diversity of responsibilities. WHAT YOU OFFER currently pursuing a degree in business administration or economics with a focus on controlling or finance ideally first work experience during internships or study-related activities or experience abroad above-average performance strong affinity for numbers and IT systems, especially SAP, Microsoft Excel and Power Point independent work approach, and commitment proficiency in English is required; knowledge of German is an Advantage WHAT WE OFFER Practical phase - actively apply theory in challenging and varied tasks/projects Teambuddy - contact person for all questions and regular feedback Networks - get to know different perspectives, ways of thinking and fields of work Internship compensation - a recognition of the commitment, more information here: on.basf.com/compensationBASFSE Flexible working hours - depending on the location and area of work HOW TO REACH US Laura Deland (Talent Acquisition), laura.deland@basf.com , Tel.:+49 30 2005-58168 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You're also welcome to book an online appointment . You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here ABOUT US First information about our application process can be found here: http://on.basf.com/applicationprocess . BASF SE, located in Ludwigshafen am Rhein, is the corporate headquarters of the BASF Group and part of the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region. BASF stands for competence in chemistry since 1865 and is represented today in the world's major consumer markets, with a wide range of products. As the largest employer in the region, BASF SE offers multiple career opportunities for students, university graduates and professionals providing also training in over 30 professions. Leisure, sports, culture and a good infrastructure characterize the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region, in which BASF is also involved with numerous activities. Learn more about BASF SE at on.basf.com/BASFSE_LU Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.description: Job Description: QUALIFICATIONS Advanced knowledge in organic chemical synthesis with a PhD in chemistry, medicinal chemistry or related o Postdoc and experience abroad, as w ell as in crop protection or pharmaceutical research are all an advantage but not essential o good English language skills o creativity, curiosity and enthusiasm to drive innovations o interpersonal and communication skills to develop innovative solutions in a diverse team RESPONSIBILITIES In our team Fungicide Chemistry you will work on the identification and development of highly effective, innovative chemical crop protection active ingredients designed to meet global market needs. From day one, you will join a diverse, international and multi-disciplinary team. You will be trained on the job and be supported by experts as well as other newer team members to address challenging and exciting scientific targets. o You will lead an organic synthesis laboratory team. o Your responsibilities will also include the design of active ingredients, their synthesis with a laboratory team, the analysis of their biological activity and the use of structure-activity relationships to initiate new designs. o You will drive multiparameter optimizations, applying medicinal chemistry concepts at the interface of fungi and plants. o With your work you will navigate at the frontiers of chemistry, modeling, biology, agronomy, regulatory and intellectual property. o You and your team will work with modern technologies and stay abreast of new developments (organic synthesis, drug discovery, competitor activities). By developing focused personnel policies, we implement the company's strategy on employee-related issues. As part of Corporate Human Resources, we design tools for the development and retention of Senior Executives, provide operational support in their personnel matters, and are responsible for their strategic succession planning. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We offer you the opportunity to actively shape and conceptually develop the global leadership development of BASF in our Corporate Leadership & Development unit for 5 to 6 months*. From day 1, you will actively contribute to the conception, organization, and evaluation of measures in our leadership development portfolio. We emphasize intensive guidance and support as well as mentoring and regular feedback from the very beginning. Do you enjoy variety? Based on your onboarding, you support valuable team projects in areas such as leadership culture, leadership training, leadership development, potential assessments, feedback tools, or networking events. Thinking big? Together, we analyze trends, challenge the status quo, and drive changes to continuously enhance the global identification and promotion of our best leadership talents. Eager to apply your creativity? You assist in user-friendly presentation and professional communication of our concepts, e.g., through presentations, intranet pages or Q&A's. Value flexibility? We structure our projects independently, allowing flexible time management. Depending on feasibility, we work 40-60% from home. You will also have the chance to explore how emerging technologies - including AI-supported tools - can enhance our HR development work, both conceptually and through hands-on experimentation. *Periods that last longer than 3 months are only possible through a combination of voluntary and compulsory internships. We are flexible regarding the next entry points. Please provide your earliest start date and your latest end date. We are currently looking for someone who can start preferably in spring 2027. However, applications for a later date are very welcome as well. WHAT YOU OFFER You are studying Psychology, Social Sciences, Business, Humanities, or Communications, and you are in the advanced stages of your Bachelor's or Master's program. Your curriculum includes a mandatory internship . Practical experience in HR and prior knowledge in areas like Change Management, Training, or Assessment Diagnostics are a plus but not necessary. You enjoy working independently, possess good self-organization skills, and are proficient in English as well as in using MS Office applications. Wir verbinden Saatgut und Traits, Pflanzenschutzprodukte, digitale Werkzeuge und Nachhaltigkeitsansätze, um Landwirten und anderen Stakeholdern entlang der Wertschöpfungskette die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu liefern. Wir tun alles in unserer Macht Stehende, um eine nachhaltige Zukunft für die Landwirtschaft zu schaffen, indem wir Innovationen, Kunden und die Gesellschaft miteinander verbinden. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Hier erhalten Sie nähere Einblicke in unsere Agricultural Solutions Vision & Mission! WAS SIE ERWARTET Mit unserem 18-monatigen Trainee-Programm erhalten Sie einen umfassenden Einblick in die verschiedenen Tätigkeitsfelder der Bereiche Finance und Controlling. Von Anfang an werden Sie eigene Projekte bearbeiten, in denen Sie Ihre Innovationsfreude einbringen und Themen im Bereich Finance oder Controlling weiter voranbringen können. Ihre drei Einsatzstationen à sechs Monate sowie Ihre spätere Zielfunktion werden individuell mit Ihnen abgestimmt. Dabei berücksichtigen wir Ihre Wünsche und Stärken. In jeder Einsatzstation arbeiten Sie sich in das entsprechende Themenfeld, wie z.B. operatives und strategisches Controlling, Innovationscontrolling, Geschäftsbewertungen oder auch Digitalisierungsprojekte ein. Bereits nach kurzer Zeit übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für spannende Projekte oder initiieren diese selbst. Dabei steht Ihnen immer eine fachliche Ansprechperson zur Seite. Während der gesamten Zeit des Traineeprogramms erhalten Sie Mentoring, welches Sie in Ihrer beruflichen und persönlichen Entwicklung stärkt. Ein Auslandseinsatz ermöglicht Ihnen, eine neue Kultur kennenzulernen und Einblicke in andere Arbeitsweisen zu erhalten. So entwickeln Sie Ihre interkulturelle Kompetenz weiter und bauen nebenbei Ihr globales Netzwerk aus. Auch hier stimmen wir die Location individuell mit Ihnen ab. Das Traineeprogramm bereitet Sie optimal auf eine Karriere im Bereich Finance und Controlling vor. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, in verschiedenen Bereichen und Positionen zu arbeiten und Ihre Karriere entsprechend Ihrer Interessen und Stärken zu gestalten. Durch die enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, die Übernahme von verantwortungsvollen Projekten und Kontakt mit Senior Management, Trainees und Alumni bauen Sie ein starkes Netzwerk auf. Damit legen Sie den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche berufliche Zukunft in BASF. WAS SIE MITBRINGEN Wir suchen engagierte Hochschulabsolvent:innen, die sich eigenverantwortlich Ziele setzen und Lust haben, ihre Komfortzone zu verlassen. Folgende Mindestanforderungen setzen wir voraus: Masterabschluss im Bereich der Wirtschaftswissenschaften Mindestens 3-monatiges Praktikum in Finance und/oder Controlling Mindestens 3-monatiger Auslandsaufenthalt (in Form von Studiensemestern oder Praktika im Ausland) Maximal drei Jahren Berufserfahrung Fließende Englischkenntnisse sind ein Muss, Deutschkenntnisse ein Plus Zusätzliche Anforderungen: Teamfähigkeit : Sie arbeiten gerne im Team und können sich schnell in neue Gruppen integrieren. Kommunikationsstärke : Sie können komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich und präzise vermitteln. Analytisches Denken : Sie besitzen die Fähigkeit, Probleme systematisch zu analysieren und Lösungen zu entwickeln. Eigeninitiative : Sie zeigen proaktiv Engagement und bringen eigene Ideen ein. WAS WIR BIETEN Persönliches Mentoring, das Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt Individuell abgestimmte Seminare, die Ihre persönliche Weiterentwicklung sichern Exklusive Networking Events, bei denen Sie Ihre Karrierenetzwerk erweitern können Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag ab Tag 1 und beste Karrierechancen SO ERREICHEN SIE UNS Laura Deland (Talent Acquisition), laura.deland@basf.com , Tel.:+49 30 2005-58168 beantwortet gerne Ihre Fragen zu dieser Position. Gerne können Sie sich auch einen Online-Termin buchen. Unser Recruiting-Team erreichen Sie auch hier Erste Informationen zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess finden Sie hier ÜBER UNS Agricultural Solutions bietet als zuverlässiger Partner der Landwirtschaft innovative, nachhaltige Lösungen für Pflanzenschutz und -gesundheit. Mit dem Agrarzentrum in Limburgerhof, nahe der BASF Konzernzentrale in Ludwigshafen, erwartet Sie in der Metropolregion Rhein-Neckar beruflich wie in Ihrer Freizeit ein attraktives Umfeld. Mehr über die BASF SE erfahren Sie unter: on.basf.com/BASFSE Das Auswahlverfahren umfasst die Überprüfung des letzten Bildungsabschlusses und des Führungszeugnisses. Bitte reichen Sie erst nach unserer Aufforderung die erforderlichen Dokumente ein. Vielfalt ist unsere größte Stärke! Werden Sie Teil unserer Erfolgsformel und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft – in einem globalen Team, das Inklusion und Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Weltanschauung lebt. Und übrigens, wir überlassen es unseren Mitarbeitenden, ob und wann sie sich duzen. Jetzt bewerben Unsere Mitarbeitenden stehen im Mittelpunkt und setzen sich jeden Tag dafür ein, unseren Kunden einen echten Mehrwert zu bieten. Wir legen großen Wert darauf, unsere Mitarbeitenden heute und in Zukunft gezielt zu fördern, damit wir die Talente und Fähigkeiten haben, die für unseren Erfolg entscheidend sind. Vereint durch die Leidenschaft für die Landwirtschaft, entwickeln wir gemeinsam innovative Lösungen, arbeiten partnerschaftlich zusammen und streben nach den besten Ergebnissen – als ein Team. So schaffen wir Wirkung. Aus Liebe zur Landwirtschaft und dem wichtigsten Beruf auf der Erde. jobs.name: Traineeprogram START IN Finance & Controlling with focus Controlling (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions vision & mission! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT With our 18-month trainee program, you will gain a comprehensive insight into the various fields of activity in the areas of finance and controlling. From the very beginning, you will work on your own projects in which you can advance topics in the field of finance or controlling. Your three assignment stations of six months each as well as your later target function will be individually coordinated with you. In doing so, we consider your wishes and strengths. In each assignment station, you will familiarize yourself with the corresponding topic area, such as operational and strategic controlling, innovation controlling, business evaluations, or digitalization projects. After a short time, you will take responsibility for exciting projects or initiate them yourself. You will always have a professional contact person at your side. During the entire time of the trainee program, you will receive mentoring that will strengthen you in your professional and personal development. An assignment abroad allows you to get to know a new culture and gain insights into other ways of working. In this way, you will further develop your intercultural competence and expand your global network at the same time. Here, too, we will coordinate the location individually with you. The trainee program prepares you optimally for a career in the field of finance and controlling. After completing the program, you will have a wide range of career opportunities within the company. By working closely with various stakeholders, taking on responsible projects and being in contact with senior management, trainees and alumni, you will build a strong network. In doing so, you will lay the foundation for a successful professional future at BASF. WHAT YOU OFFER We are looking for committed university graduates who set themselves goals and want to leave their comfort zone. We require the following minimum requirements: • Degree in the field of business/economics (Master, PhD, MBA) • At least 3-month internship in Finance and/or Controlling • At least 3 months abroad (in the form of study semesters or internships abroad) A maximum of three years’ work experience. • Fluency in English is a must, German language skills are a plus Additional requirements: • Ability to work in a team: You enjoy working in a team and can quickly integrate into new groups. • Strong communication skills: You can convey complex issues in an understandable and precise way. • Analytical thinking: You have the ability to systematically analyze problems and develop solutions. • Initiative: You proactively show commitment and contribute your own ideas. WHAT WE OFFER Mentoring that supports your personal and professional development A wide range of seminars tailored to your needs Networking events where you can expand your career network Permanent employment contract from day 1 and best career opportunities HOW TO REACH US Laura Deland (Talent Acquisition), laura.deland@basf.com , Tel.:+49 30 2005-58168 will be happy to answer your questions for this position You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here: on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US As a reliable partner of the rural economy, Agricultural Solutions offers innovative, sustainable solutions for plant protection and health. With the agricultural center in Limburgerhof, close to the BASF Group headquarters in Ludwigshafen, you can expect an attractive place for both work and play in the Rhine-Neckar region. Learn more about BASF SE at on.basf.com/Headquarters Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Banco de Talentos - PCD - Pessoas com Deficiência - Brasil
jobs.description: Criamos química para um futuro sustentável Cerca de 111.000 funcionários do Grupo BASF contribuem para o sucesso de nossos clientes em quase todos os setores e em quase todos os países do mundo. Nossa carteira compreende seis segmentos: Químicos, Materiais, Soluções Industriais, Tecnologias de Superfície, Nutrição e Cuidados e Soluções Agrícolas. A BASF gerou vendas de cerca de 78.6 bilhões de euros em 2021. A BASF, em contínua busca pela equidade e pluralidade de seus colaboradores, representatividade na sociedade e em linha com sua estratégia global de Diversidade & Inclusão, lança seu Banco de Talentos – PCD - Pessoas com deficiência, com o objetivo de buscar profissionais para atuar em seus negócios. Acreditamos que a diversidade de nossos colaboradores e colaboradoras com sua pluralidade de ideias e experiências, traz novas perspectivas e resultados, permitindo que alcancemos nosso objetivo de ser uma organização de alta performance, gerando interações criativas, inovação e valor para nossa gente, nossos clientes e para a sociedade. Quer se juntar ao time BASF? Se inscreva em nosso Banco de Talentos e, caso surja uma oportunidade para o seu perfil, vamos entrar em contato com você. Este Banco de Talentos é direcionado para profissionais PCD - Pessoa Com Deficiência , que tenham interesse em oportunidades de trabalho em todo o Brasil. O que queremos? Queremos que nossos(as) colaboradores(as) se sintam valorizados(as) por serem quem são, do jeito que são e, assim, possam desempenhar 100% das suas potencialidades. Como atuamos? Atuamos sempre para alcançar três grandes objetivos: Promover equidade ao longo de toda jornada dos(as) colaboradores(as) e nos processos de gestão de pessoas. Desde a seleção, passando pela integração e todos os processos internos. Desenvolver ações afirmativas que garantam a representatividade das sociedades em que operamos negócios e que gerem oportunidades para grupos historicamente discriminados. Contribuir para gerar diferenciais competitivos ao influenciar a cadeia de valor. jobs.name: Officer/ Specialist Payroll and HR administration Specialist with French (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation, and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Within the HR Services Team France, we are a diverse and inclusive team of experts and young professionals. Together, we are committed to deliver the highest quality of service to our BASF partners in France. To complete our Administration& Payroll team, we are looking for an HR Specialist/ Officer (m/f/d) with a strong enthusiasm for Payroll, HR processes and customer relations. Your responsibilities will include: You process variable elements for the preparation of monthly payroll, improve and maintain HR administrative processes in our HR systems. You prepare monthly and yearly reporting on HR data. You ensure that all legal and regulatory requirements concerning our HR services are met. You advise and inform the employees based in France regarding HR topics. You work closely with our local HR partners in France as well as with our internal departments in Berlin and our technical service providers. You are innovative and participate in internal projects, identify opportunities for improvement and encourage the sharing of best practices between our European HR teams. You take part in the digitalization of our HR services; by identifying opportunities for improvement and sharing best practices with your international colleagues. WHAT YOU OFFER You have successfully completed vocational training or hold a degree in Human Resources, Payroll, or a related field, and you bring initial professional experience in HR, including a first exposure to payroll processes. Building on this initial experience, you are motivated to further develop your knowledge of payroll processes and deepen your understanding of legal regulations related to social security, taxation, time management, and compensation & benefits. You feel comfortable working with HR systems (ideally SAP HR) and have a good level of confidence using Excel in your daily work. You are fluent in French and have a good command of English. Knowledge of German would be a plus. You enjoy working with people and interacting with stakeholders in a friendly, helpful, and service-oriented way. You have strong analytical and organizational skills and are able to structure your work well, even when working towards deadlines. WHAT WE OFFER Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location Team and company events in which we celebrate our achievements and live up our team spirit Location-independent work models with defined days of presence in Berlin and place of residence in Germany - Here a first impression Subsidy for public transport, personal employee benefit card and other discounts Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks HOW TO REACH US ? You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US As an international service hub, the BASF Services Europe GmbH bundles a wide range of services for the BASF Group throughout Europe. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our career opportunities here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

Zoek je een uitdagende, goedbetaalde baan voor de lange termijn met opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden? Vind je het leuk om hoogwaardige producten te maken en complexe technische vraagstukken op te lossen? Dan is de vacature proces operator bij BASF Heerenveen perfect voor jou! Bij BASF Heerenveen werken we met een enthousiast team van ruim 230 medewerkers aan de ontwikkeling en productie van innovatieve, watergedragen polymeerproducten en additieven. Deze producten worden wereldwijd toegepast in de verpakkings- en coatingindustrie. We werken in een dynamische omgeving waar passie, innovatie en teamgeest centraal staan. Sluit je aan bij ons team en help mee de toekomst van verpakkingen en coatings vorm te geven! Wat ga je als ervaren proces operator doen? Samen met jouw ploeg ben je verantwoordelijk voor het soepel laten verlopen van onze geautomatiseerde productieprocessen. Jouw taken zijn onder andere: Grondstoffen beheren: Je zorgt voor de aanwezigheid van grondstoffen en halffabricaten, bereidt oplossingen en bedient het productiebesturingssysteem. Werkplanning uitvoeren: Je zet de productieplanning om in werkopdrachten en coördineert de operationele werkzaamheden. Kwaliteit bewaken: Je neemt productiemonsters, voert analyses uit en definieert instructies voor afstelling en opwerking. Je bewaakt de status van de laboratoriumapparatuur en valideert analyseresultaten. Storingen oplossen: Je signaleert storingen, controleert veiligheidsmaatregelen door inspectie en rapporteert afwijkingen. Indien nodig stel je de situatie veilig en voer je eenvoudige onderhoudswerkzaamheden uit. Onderhoud ondersteunen: Je ondersteunt het onderhoudsteam, bijvoorbeeld tijdens shutdowns. Optimalisatie en veiligheid: Je werkt volgens de voorschriften en doet aanbevelingen om de productie-efficiëntie, kwaliteit en veiligheid te verbeteren. Klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging? Solliciteer voor de functie process operator bij BASF Heerenveen - YouTube Jouw profiel Wij zoeken een ervaren en enthousiaste professional met: Meerdere jaren ervaring als proces operator. Een afgeronde Operator B of C of MBO procestechniek opleiding is een must. Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in de chemische industrie. Een diploma Bedrijfsbrandweer Manschap , of bereidheid om dit te behalen. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal . Bereidheid om in een 5-ploegendienst te werken (6 dagen werken, 4 dagen vrij). Wat bieden we jou? Bij BASF krijg je een aantrekkelijk arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket: Marktconforme vergoeding met maximum €5.000 bruto maandsalaris, 32% ploegentoeslag, 8,3% vakantietoeslag, een vaste eindejaarsuitkering (1 maandsalaris) en een bonusregeling. Aantrekkelijke aanvullende regelingen zoals verzekeringen voor ziekte en ongevallen, een reisverzekering, fietsplan, employee assistance programma en collectieve zorgverzekering. Mogelijkheid om fulltime of parttime te werken. Opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden. Een uitdagende functie bij een van de beste werkgevers van Nederland! Waarom werken bij BASF Heerenveen? Bij BASF staan innovatie, duurzaamheid en diversiteit centraal. We bieden gelijke kansen voor iedereen, ongeacht leeftijd, afkomst, geslacht, seksuele identiteit, beperking, religie of wereldbeeld. Samen bouwen we aan een toekomst waarin techniek en duurzaamheid hand in hand gaan. Klaar om deel uit te maken van ons succesverhaal? Solliciteer nu! Als Farb-Expertin oder Experte sind Sie aktiv im fachlichen Austausch mit der globalen Community sowie ggf. mit Kunden und tragen zur Weiterentwicklung des Fachgebiets bei, z.B. durch Best-Practice-Sharing. Durch die Bearbeitung kleinerer Projekte oder die Übernahme von Sonderthemen zeigen Sie aktiv Ihr Interesse an einer beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und übernehmen mittelfristig mehr Verantwortung. jobs.name: Deputy Manager - Sales, PU Footwear, Performance Materials
jobs.description: About BASF in Vietnam BASF has been active in Vietnam since the establishment of its representative office in 1994 and celebrates its 30-year presence in the country this year . BASF Vietnam Limited was set up in 2009. The company maintains two sales offices in Hồ Chí Minh City and Hà Nội, offering solutions for Vietnam’s key industries, including Agriculture, Construction, Automotive, Footwear, Paints & Coatings and Electrical & Electronics. BASF’s sales to customers in Vietnam were approximately €238 million in 2023. BASF employed 110 people in Vietnam as of the end of the year. Further information on BASF in Vietnam is available at www.basf.com/vn . Job Description: OBJECTIVES OF THE POSITION This role serves as the sales or local key account manager responsible for implementing the Value Chain hunting strategy, engaging with the VN team to identify potential polyurethane (PU) Footwear projects and secure new approvals. It involves establishing relationships with key shoe factories including Taiwanese, Korean and Chinese transplants (TTT/KTT/CTT) and acting as the local contact in VN to drive the PU business growth alongside the global and regional PU key account team. MAIN AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITIES AND KEY ACTIVITIES Key T1/T2s Collaborate with the VN team to explore new PU projects, scout potential from TTT/KTT/CTT transplants, and develop an account engagement plan for business expansion in VN. Monitor market trends, engage with customers, and understand our customers' sustainability objectives concerning footwear. Promote sustainable materials, generate new projects in partnership with the VN team, and execute top-down initiatives from customer HQ (e.g., BMB PU or recycled PU projects). Take responsibility for assigned PU business KPIs and targets in VN. Oversee the PU footwear customers in VN, focusing on building relationships with key customers, devise engagement plans and explore new business opportunities in VN. Partner closely with the Asia key accounts core team (GKAM, RKAM, and local account managers in other key countries) to drive PU business growth within customer’s value chain in VN and contribute to the overall targets. Innovation & Project Pipeline Provide market insights and help to steer the Sportwear innovation pipeline to ensure that the correct market solutions are developed. Initiate innovation projects to secure growth, create business cases and provide prioritization. Manage and ensure the execution of the PU footwear business pipeline Other Tasks Perform other tasks or projects as required from time to time JOB REQUIREMENTS Minimum Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Business Administration or other related subjects. Minimum 5 years Sales and / or Marketing and / or Product Development experience, preferably in the footwear industry. Profound knowledge & background working within footwear value chain focusing material development or manufacturing or product development at T1/T2. Experiences in cross-regional team environment working. Good knowledge and experience in Polyurethanes, ideally for the footwear industry. Key account management skills are preferred. Effective communication skills in English and Chinese OR Korean. High proficiency in Salesforce.com and Microsoft Office tools Required Competencies: Drive Sustainable Solutions, Demonstrate Customer Focus, Act with Entrepreneurial Drive, Communicate Effectively. Job Description Footer:

jobs.name: Internship Predictive Maintenance (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF The Global Engineering Services service unit contributes to shaping a sustainable future with outstanding technical expertise. With our dedicated, interdisciplinary teams, we support BASF's divisions in growing together with our customers and markets. We implement investments competitively. Around the globe, we provide safe and reliable solutions to ensure that production plants deliver excellent performance. We are continuously improving and driving digital transformation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Our Asset Monitoring Solutions & Services unit develops innovative and sustainable solutions to increase plant availability. Unplanned downtimes are specifically reduced by combining process engineering/mechanical engineering knowledge with methods from applied mathematics, data science and IT. The overarching goal is the holistic and sustainable optimization of the maintenance process over the entire life cycle of a plant. As part of a mandatory internship of three to six months, with the option of supplementing this with a voluntary placement, you will have the opportunity to integrate different types of machines into the monitoring process from January 2027 and get to know different IT systems in the process: You will put innovative technologies & methods for model- and data-based condition monitoring of process engineering machines as well as apparatus into practice. You will quickly familiarize yourself with the system architecture and contribute your ideas to the further development of system tools. At the Ludwigshafen site, you will work in an interdisciplinary and cross-departmental team in which you will present and discuss your results. The focus of your work will depend on your interests and skills. WHAT YOU OFFER enrolled student in a bachelor's or master's program in a technical field, e.g. engineering or physics interest in linking plant engineering with digital technologies excellent knowledge of English and good knowledge of German ideally good knowledge of drive and driven machines, process engineering or chemistry motivation and perseverance to implement innovative and practical solutions based on scientific findings independent and autonomous work and ability to actively contribute ideas to the team WHAT WE OFFER Practical phase - actively apply theory in challenging and varied tasks/projects Team buddy - contact person for all questions and regular feedback Networks - get to know different perspectives, ways of thinking and areas of work Internship remuneration - recognition of your work, more information here: http://on.basf.com/VerguetungBASFSE Flexible working hours - depending on the location and area of work HOW TO REACH US Tina Le (Talent Acquisition), tina.le@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005-56367 will be happy to answer your questions about this position. You can also book an online appointment . You can also reach our recruiting team here . You can find initial information on our application process here . The selection process includes a background check of the last diploma obtained and a criminal record certificate. Please submit the required documents only after our request. ABOUT US BASF SE, based in Ludwigshafen am Rhein, is the corporate headquarters of the BASF Group and part of the Rhine-Neckar metropolitan economic area. BASF has stood for competence in chemistry since 1865 and today is represented in the world's major consumer markets with a wide range of products. As the largest employer in the region, BASF SE offers a wide range of career opportunities for students, graduates and professionals and provides training in over 30 professions. Leisure, sport, culture and a good infrastructure characterize the Rhine-Neckar metropolitan region, in which BASF is also involved with numerous activities. You can find out more about BASF SE at: http://on.basf.com/BASFSE_LU Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.description: Now hiring! Chemical Operator Cincinnati, OH. Pay Range: Starting at $28 hourly - 24/7 | Rotating Shifts, overtime eligible! We are looking for a Chemical Operator to join our Care Chemicals (EM) team in Cincinnati, OH. Come create chemistry with us! As the leading global chemical supplier for the personal care, home care, industrial and institutional cleaning industries, and technical applications in the agrochemical industry, BASF Care Chemicals is focused on partnering with customers to create innovative solutions with great speed and agility to meet the current and future needs of society in a more sustainable way. We are proud to contribute to the long-term success of our customers’ brands by offering a broad range of products and concepts such as common household items, like cosmetics, detergents and cleaners, as well as industrial products and processes like crop protection, rubber belts, hoses, concrete, and metal plating. At Care Chemicals, we not only care about supporting our customers and achieving strong business results; we care about our team members. We aim to create a motivating, inspiring and inclusive work environment where all team members feel supported, heard and developed. Being part of our team means showing up every day to work collaboratively across functions to win for the overall success of the team. We value bringing diverse perspectives and backgrounds together to stretch our teams to think differently, have the courage to speak up and challenge the status quo, and problem solve for the greater good of our customers and society. We as the Care Chemicals division of BASF carry the passion to care in our DNA: we care for our customers, consumers, employees, society and our planet. Come, be a part of our team and create Care Chemicals with us. As a chemical operator you will be responsible for the safe and efficient operation of the production equipment inthe Cincinnati, OH plant. This includes operation of chemical processing equipment; including reactors, refining,and filtration systems. Also involves the transfer of material to and from other departments as necessary andloading of tank trucks and rail cars for customer shipments. During your rotating shift as a Chemical Operator, you will Load and unload tanks and rail cars and receipt of truck deliveries, in addition to perform collection of samplesfrom tank cars and vessels. Conduct visual inspection of operating equipment to determine current operating status whilst demonstrateeffective operations of the DCS in daily work environment. Read, record, and interpret data of instruments (reactors, tanks, pumps, filtration systems, etc.) and makecorrective adjustments as required for efficient production runs. Demonstrate proficiency at operating all production equipment, with minimal supervision, as well as use ofcomputer systems to complete work assignments. Participate in all required safety training and wear proper personal protective equipment when working in theplant area. Perform housekeeping to maintain production and operations in a neat and orderly condition. Work and communicate effectively with Supply Chain Planners, Logistics Planner, Production Coordinator,Maintenance, Lab, team members, etc. to accomplish high quality standards that meet/exceed customerrequirements. Support and adhere to the principles of the American Chemistry Council's Responsible Care®, EPA and OSHAinitiatives by protecting the environment, health, safety and security of our employees, contractors, carriers,distributors, visitors, customers, and neighbors. If you... Hold a High School Diploma or GED required. Preferrably possess a minimum 2 years working in a manufacturing environment. Bring DCS console operating knowledge and SAP (preferred). Possess excellent safety standards and strong troubleshooting skills. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. jobs.name: Business Development and TD - CASE Applications
jobs.job_field: Business Development and TD - CASE Applications
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Job Description: O bjectives of the Position To implement CASE and eMobility, Performance Materials India sales & marketing strategy in new business development and customers’ management by initiating contacts with existing and potential customers. Develop & execute Business Development plan for CASE and eMobility in accordance with the country & regional strategy and objectives. Establish & foster strong relationship with customers & industry. Identifying new business opportunities, managing relationships with key stakeholders, and executing strategic initiatives to meet CASE's business goals. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Business Development: Provide technical support and expertise on CASE (coatings, composites, adhesives, sealants, and elastomers) and eMobility products to clients and internal teams. Understand product specifications, applications, and industry standards. Identify, evaluate, develop, pursue, and implement new business opportunities and strategies that align with CASE's goals and objectives to increase market share and revenue. Assist the sales team with technical presentations, product demonstrations, and client training sessions. Collaborate with Technical Development & Product Development teams to improve existing products and develop new solutions based on market needs. Manage projects related to product applications, client requirements, and technical support. Oversee and manage business development projects, ensuring timely and successful completion. Prepare and present regular reports on business development activities, market analysis, and client feedback. Monitor and report on business development activities, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Conduct market research to identify trends, competitor activities, and potential areas for growth. Provide insights to guide business strategies. Strategy: Define CASE and eMobility milestones, market directions, project pipeline (products & applications), volume, profit, product portfolio and developmental goals & directions in India. Identify business opportunity for established and new customer/product/application and develop value proposition on products and pricing for CASE and eMobility in India and provide on-going update to the regional team. Monitor and analyze development in the segment and initiate improvement opportunities. Scout, identify, analyze, define and set up target applications, target customers (OEMs & Tiers), target products and drive the business growth for the accounts plan with the country with sales and TD team. Observe and transfer new market trend/development and prepare business case for new product or application development. Identify and prioritize translation/multiplication business opportunity globally from other countries or regions. Monitor legislative, technological and social changes in e-Mobility & new energy and participate / lead the key industry associations in the segment in the country Develop deep knowledge of market intelligence network in the segment to be well prepared for marketing counter measures. Align and coordinate with regional CASE & country PM units and reach out to collaborate with cross-divisional industry group or business units. Customer Management: Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, and industry influencers. Understand market, customer, and industry needs and provide tailored solutions. Supports in providing the response related to quality, technical applications, inquiries, and other related issues, conducts customers’ assessments and analysis. Coordinate with BASF experts to conduct field visits, seminars, presentations and attend to customers’ inquiries. Conduct customers’ assessments and analyses to align and ensure the strategic focus in the right place. Ensure all supporting functions involved in the delivery of agreed customer’s needs; resolve problems/ expedite matters where appropriate. Share M arket Intelligence, strategy & communicate internally via visit reports. Credit Management: Monitor the growth of the customers’ business, review and coordinate with credit controlling team to make appropriate credit recommendations. Follow-up on payment collections and ensure on-time payment from the customers. Team Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales, Technical Development, Product Development, CSO, SCM, and production to ensure alignment and support for business initiatives. Job Requirements (m inimum requirement to carry out the work) Edu c a t i o n: Bachelor’s Science degree in Polymer, Chemistry or equivalent, such as Material Science, Chemical Engineering. Working Experience: 5-8 years technical sales working experience preferably with polyurethane industry, CASE background/experience preferred. Technical & Professional Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of Business Development and technical know-how and applications of CASE, eMobility, New Energy and Polyurethane Industry. Applications, applications development, technical expertise, machines, and p rocessing experiences would be highly desirable. Have hands-on experience with polyurethanes (CASE) processing equipment in High/low pressure foaming machine, Spray foaming, etc., would be highly advantageous. Good English and computer skills (MS 365). Job Description Footer:

jobs.name: Laboratory Technician I
jobs.description: Job Description: Now hiring! Laboratory Technician I Geismar, LA We are looking for a Laboratory Technician I to join our Geismar team. Come create chemistry with us! This position is responsible for quality assurance testing of in process samples, raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods within the scope of the Company Quality Policy. Using appropriate software to evaluate data based on internal and external specifications, support the continuous improvement of lab and plant processes through QA/QC activities and meet and/or exceed customer expectations. As a Laboratory Technician I, you will - Analyze raw materials, intermediate products, finished products and other chemical samples and evaluate suitability according to established specifications to ensure quality and availability of final product - Analyze samples, provide quality data and become an active member along with the Lab Supervisor and Production personnel to provide innovative ideas to improve lab and plant processes and demonstrate continuous improvement - Know, understand and use software tools such as Lotus Notes, LabWare, SAP, Microsoft Office Programs, etc. which enhance quality reporting - Ensure the suitability of laboratory equipment through proper operation, maintenance, calibration, verification and good quality control and assessment activities. - Generate quality data and significant statistical data to support plant personnel in their efforts to enhance process control, meet customer requirements and continuously improve our product quality characteristics. If you... are able to work as part of a team, understand chemical and instrument measurement processes, be self-motivated, and willing to develop technical knowledge and understanding of the chemical and measurement processes involved in their respective units, you will need a - Minimum 2-year Associates degree in Chemistry or 2-year technical degree in analytical testing in Chemistry or related field is preferred. 0 - 2 years’ experience working in a chemical manufacturing laboratory environment. - Basic understanding of general chemistry - Basic understanding of theory, operation, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of laboratory instrumentation such as gas chromatographs, viscometers, spectrophotometers, pH meters, titrators, etc . - Basic understanding of the techniques of quality assurance and quality control - Basic understanding of math and statistics - Basic understanding of ISO, RCMS, and cGMP quality system requirements - Basic computer skills using software packages such as Microsoft Office, Power BI, SAP, Lotus Notes, etc. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact myhr@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Job Description Footer:

jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Due to the strategic realignment of the Coatings business unit, a dedicated finance department is being established. This presents an exciting opportunity to develop and shape the finance organization from its foundation. Therefore, we are looking for a Senior Specialist Global Functional Process Owner Order-to-Cash Finance with the following objectives: You own the global Order-to-cash (O2C) Finance processes, which includes Customer Master Data, Invoicing and Billing, Cash Applications, Collections, Dunning & Accounts Receivable Management. You establish and maintain global standards for Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, ensuring these are aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements across the coatings division. Moreover, you oversee the O2C activities, identify and drive process improvement opportunities, leveraging technology and digital solutions to enhance automation, efficiency, and continuous improvement within the finance organization. You manage a third-party business process provider in the area of O2C and will implement process performance KPIs to steer the service provider. In addition, collaborate closely with related functions such as P2P and B2R, you will coordinate integration efforts and you will ensure holistic alignment of financial processes. Last but not least, you engage with internal stakeholders to ensure that O2C processes meet business needs and support strategic objectives. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and pension related benefits. We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. Surventis stands for diversity - we are proud of our Coatings employee networks WomenInCoatings, Color Pride and CultiConnect. The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g. through regular employee surveys and management feedback. At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio “Freizeit” with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant “Auszeit” including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center “LackiKids” and a vacation program “LackiKids on Tour”. jobs.description: Job Description: In the Philippines, BASF has been supporting manufacturers from various industries since 1963. Help in the monitoring and implementation of health and safety policies/procedures, EHS/RCMS/EMS, and DOLE regulations. Demonstrate professionalism, and integrity at work. Demonstrate high level of energy and maintain stable performance under pressure. Proactive, can work independently and in teams All applications will be treated confidentially. Only short-listed candidates will be interviewed. Job Description Footer:

jobs.name: Maintenance Technician
jobs.description: Now hiring! Maintenance Technician Savannah, GA We are looking for a Maintenance Technician to join our Catalyst team in Savannah, GA. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Catalysts division is the global market leader in catalyst technologies. The division develops andproduces mobile emissions catalysts as well as process catalysts and offers precious metals trading, recyclingand related products and services. The primary function of this job is to ensure proper maintenance within the facility and to ensure timely productionof highquality products in a cost efficient, safe and environmentally responsible manner. The job requirestechnical and problemsolving skills. Work activities include the repair and maintenance of the facility and its equipment. During your shift as a Maintenance Technician, you will Conduct routine and preventive maintenance on plant equipment and facilities in a timely and efficient manner, troubleshooting and resolving maintenance issues. Work independently, when necessary, to complete maintenance tasks while following written instructions. Utilize hand tools, power tools, cutting and burning equipment, welding equipment, and material handling equipment proficiently. Maintain a clean and organized work area and complete all required paperwork accurately and on time. Adhere to all applicable Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) policies. Wear prescribed Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and ensure all required safety safeguards are properly used. Notify the supervisor before undertaking any work activity for which you are not adequately trained. Promptly report any unsafe acts or conditions to the supervisor and take immediate interim steps to protect yourself and others from serious risks. Recognize that safety and environmental responsibility are key aspects of BASF’s principles, and promptly report all unsafe conditions and incidents to the appropriate manager to ensure the safety of yourself and others. If you... Possess a High School Diploma or General Educational Diploma. A Technical Degree is preferred. Have a minimum of 3 years of experience in industrial maintenance. Demonstrate proficiency in precision maintenance on rotating manufacturing equipment. Have experience working with SAP. Are skilled in operating equipment such as forklifts, scissor lifts, and boom lifts. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Deputy Manager - Sales, Surface Treatment, Coatings
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Job Description: OBJECTIVES THE POSITION Manage sales of surface treatment business unit under the Chemetall® brand via direct and indirect distribution in assigned northern territories of VN aiming to generate sustainable sales growth for G-ECT SEA. Identify and exploit market potential as well as to explore and create customer needs to ensure profitable sales growth by new and existing technologies in new and existing customers. Take full sales responsibility for Northern Territories, the Sales Manager coordinates Surface Treatment activities for Industry and Automotive (OEM/Component Activities) and thereby acts as single point of contact (SPOC) for Segment Management APAC and Business Management SEA. MAIN AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITIES AND KEY ACTIVITIES Sales Management and Development: Explore and develop new business by high market presence in the field to ensure sustainable growth. Prepare, negotiate, and conclude business contracts and maintain business growth with customers. Ensure relationship management w/ all levels of seniority of customer organization (esp. key decider). Coordinate launch of new products at key customers aligned with Business Management and Marketing Provide trainings and share know-how with customers and distribution partners to ensure that the full potential and advantages of G-ECT’s products and process solutions are being materialized. Maintain and manage sales opportunities, leads, and visit reports maintained in Salesforce CRM tool. Ensure accurate demand forecasting as basis for stock planning to secure reliable supply to Vietnam. Ensure “on time response” related to commercial, quality, and technical inquiries / issues of customers. Achieve net sales / profitability budgets and implement pricing measures timely and efficiently. Market Intelligence: Explore and exploit customer needs, industry trends and drivers, unique selling proposition to recommend the best solution(s), leading to the achievement of value creation for the customers and BASF (by Chemetall Process /Solution Selling approach). Conduct studies and analyze market trends, competitors, product applications, processes and technology and develop related marketing / selling strategies for VN market. Cooperate with G-ECT SEA Business and Marketing as well as APAC Segment Management to develop a strategic growth roadmap for the assigned sales segments in Vietnam. Technical Service / Consultancy: Ensure technical consultancy and support to customers on product applications, process optimization, trouble-shootings, and handling complaints by yourself and/or by connecting the customer teams with our regional technology experts and local technical sales support to provide solutions to proactively avoid or sort out technical issues. Initiate technical lab support or reformulations request of products via CURT workflows in Salesforce Miscellaneous: Participate in and contribute to regional / subregional G-ECT meetings, workshops, and conferences Follow-up on payment collections and ensure on-time payment from the customers in case of overdue Strictly adherence to BASF Group’s Compliance Code of Conduct as well as all BASF country policies JOB REQUIREMENTS Bachelor Degree in Chemistry or Commerce. Minimum 5 years experiences in commercial or technical roles in Metal Surface Treatment industry Ability to work in multi-cultural environments and matrix organizations Good knowledge of Surface Treatment market, products, application processes and technology Native Vietnamese and good command and English; additional language such as Korean, Japanese, or Chinese language are an advantage Presentation, conflict management and communication skills to convince all levels of seniority and departments, such as GM, Production, Application and Procurement as well as Line operators and Lab staff Relationship management and negotiation skills Microsoft Office user skills (i.e. PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook); additionally Salesforce CRM know-how is an advantage Required Competencies: Act with Entrepreneurial Drive, Demonstrate Customer Focus, Communicate Effectively, Develop Self & Others. Background in fast‑paced, high‑volume industries—such as chemicals, trading, retail, or commodities (including bulk products)—is preferred. Personal Attributes: Proactive and continuously eager to learn, with the confidence to navigate complex situations and resolve challenges.
