jobs.name: Supply Chain Modeling & Optimization Specialist
jobs.description: Job Description: Objectives of the Position Digitalization will be part of our DNA at GB. We will change processes that will simplify life within but also outside of GB, sometimes even without our BASF colleagues noticing it. Within GB, we will use digital tools to stop us spending too much time on tasks that hinder us from doing the things that are really needed, such as consulting our service recipients. Digital tools will free up our time to help our internal partners and we will be able to actively shape our division’s digital footprint. GB Strategy is to transform Kuala Lumpur Hub into a digital Hub to support BASF. GBC Supply chain team is looking for an exceptional Supply chain professional to support in development and implementation of new digital tools that will help operations. You will focus on designing and implementing (along with counterparts and solution architects) Control Tower solutions for BASF Overseas delivery services. In addition, you will need to understand the customers' requirements and use cases to map to the Control Tower solution. As part of the digital transformation, you will play a key role in change management and communication to stakeholders. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities (50%) Supply chain Tactical Support •    You will be responsible for providing tactical support for door-to-door supply chain delivery process •    You will monitor exceptions at each supply chain stage to allow timely and informed decisions for effective escalation management •    You will drive supply chain disruption monitoring activities including what-if scenarios and help create recommended actions / options •    You will support operations teams during crisis management events by providing impact analysis and recommending corrective / preventive actions •    You will conduct market analysis to identify market trends, new opportunities, alternate ports, carriers, and modes •    You will improve supply chain resilience and mitigate our customer delivery risk exposure •    You will identify improvement opportunities for supply chain process and recommend best fit solutions or tools (20%) Communication and Change Management. •    You will work closely with operations to identify business requirements and structure them into actionable and meaningful objectives •    You will drive change management and help deployment of new tools and processes •    You will work with carriers and service providers identify and resolve issues impacting service delivery •    You will provide timely communication to relevant stakeholders on disruptions, identify impacts, provide recovery options and estimate expected back to normal (20%) Citizen data science •    You will coordinate analytics and data ETL (Extract, Transform and Loading) activities for all deliveries. •    You will work with data science and digitalization experts to implement statistical and machine learning models to create predictive and prescriptive solutions that provide users with key insights. •    You will build prototype models for proof of concept and paving way for new digitalization tools. (10%) Supply chain operations support •    You will create and run monitoring, exception, performance and KPI reports for delivery and shipment status. •    You will help automate and maintain reporting for operations and performance •    You will Identify and evaluate automation and technology opportunities to drive operational improvements. Education Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply chain, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Chemistry, or related field Working Experience At least 4 years of relevant Supply Chain / Logistics / Transportation Management Technical & Professional Knowledge Knowledge of working with SAP and business reporting Knowledge of working with SQL, Azure, and cloud databases Knowledge of supply chain, logistics and shipping industry Advantage for knowledge of working with business intelligence applications like Tableau, Power BI etc Self-driven and takes initiative to learn and experiment Open minded with diversity and strong communication skills Great analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving abilities Job Description Footer: BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Account Manager Glysantin DACH (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF As a European distribution organization of the BASF Group, BTC Europe sells highly-refined specialty and fine chemicals to international customers in numerous industries. We capitalize on our proximity to our customers, agility, many years of expertise and the accumulated know-how of the BASF Verbund. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We are looking for a field account manager for the DACH sales region to start as soon as possible, with a 100% remote work arrangement. A company car will be provided. In your new position, you manage and grow customer relationships in the Automotive Fluids Independent Aftermarket, focusing on coolant/antifreeze and brake fluid products. Your expertise is asked for when negotiating contracts and steering technical and commercial projects with customers and internal teams. Together with your colleagues, you actively acquire new customers and business opportunities, driving cross-selling and price management initiatives. Not least, you represent BTC at industry events and fairs, ensuring visibility and collaboration with BASF counterparts. Furthermore, you contribute to digitalization initiatives and support the development of industry-specific strategies within local and European teams. WHAT YOU OFFER technical professional training in a relevant area or completed master’s degree in business or STEM fields several years of professional experience in automotive fluids technologies and aftermarket sales strong knowledge in contract negotiations, account planning, and customer relationship management, ideally with Salesforce experience fluent German and advanced English skills, plus confident use of IT tools and MS Office applications proactive team player with excellent communication skills, intercultural competence, and a growth-driven mindset willingness to travel WHAT WE OFFER 100% home office company car inspiring networks for developing and implementing your own ideas (e.g., Women in Business) mentoring programs and learning opportunities for your professional and personal development career paths for professional growth, including opportunities to move into other roles within the company 30 vacation days, plus options for special leave and sabbatical models flexible working time arrangements (e.g., part-time employment) an attractive salary, based on business success and your individual performance bicycle leasing options HOW TO REACH US Svenja Sollmann (Talent Acquisition), svenja.sollmann@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-59355 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are also welcome to book an appointment online (technical questions cannot be answered in this appointment) You can also reach our recruiting team here ABOUT US BTC Europe GmbH is a wholly owned subsidiary of BASF. Learn more about BTC Europe GmbH at on.basf.com/BTCEurope/EN Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. And by the way, we leave it up to our employees to decide if and when they address each other informally.

jobs.name: EHS Specialist III
jobs.description: Now hiring! EHS Specialist III Malcom, IA (On Site) We are looking for an EHS Specialist III to join our Performance Materials team in Malcom. Come create chemistry with us! The Performance Materials division is at the forefront of the much-needed sustainability transformation in plastics. Our experts co-create products with customers to bring innovations to major industry sectors such as transportation, consumer goods, industrial applications, and construction.These solutions contribute to a sustainable future by pushing the boundaries in thermal resistance, robustness and lightweight applications. Your primary responsibilities will include ensuring compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations related to environmental protection, hazardous waste management, and spill prevention, as well as adhering to BASF's internal standards, such as Responsible Care®. You will play a crucial role in enhancing our site programs to maintain our license to operate while fostering a culture of safety and compliance among all personnel.  In addition, you will lead our site security initiatives, identifying and mitigating security risks to uphold and optimize our security standards. As a key member of the site leadership team, you will collaborate closely with the site manager and contribute to the overall success of the Malcom site.  You will also be an integral part of the BASF EHS community, working alongside EHS experts across the organization and reporting directly to the EHS Director for Performance Materials North America. As an EHS Specialist III, you create chemistry by... Leveraging your effective communication skills to develop strong working relationships with employees, the EHS community, and regulatory agencies/third parties, serving as a positive change agent within the organization. Utilizing your knowledge of Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene, and Environmental disciplines to develop and maintain EHS programs, policies, and procedures for the site. Drawing upon your experience in Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene, Environmental management, and Emergency Response program management in a manufacturing environment to lead and participate in risk assessments, accurately addressing identified deficiencies. Providing guidance - both tactically and strategically- to site leadership on critical EHS issues, ensuring adherence to corporate EHS policies and procedures, including the Responsible Care® Management Systems. Creating training content and, where appropriate, delivering training or coaching, facilitating the sharing of programs, procedures, tools, and best practices across the BASF EHS organization. Prioritizing opportunities and issues to drive the continuous improvement of EHS processes and systems. Utilizing your strong organizational skills to identify and monitor key performance indicators within your area of responsibility, making necessary adjustments to improve EHS performance. Leading and participating in project reviews, process hazard analyses, and change management processes, ensuring all internal and external reporting requirements are met through your solid analytical and computer skills. Being a role model and collaborating with hourly employees to reinforce a culture of behavior-based safety and support emergency response activities. Working with and traveling to other sites to evaluate audit readiness and share best practices Leading and/or participating in EHS work teams and/or task forces If you have... A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or a related field. Two (2) years of experience in an industrial/manufacturing environment Ability to work independently under broad goals and objectives with minimal guidance. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Experience with Environmental Reporting and Safety Management Systems strongly preferred Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.description:
Ubicación Madrid WELCOME TO THE TEAM If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable backend services that support and enhance our internal and external applications. Work in an agile, self‑organized team and collaborate effectively with colleagues. Develop new backend functionality using Java and Spring Boot, following modern backend engineering principles and best practices. Maintain and improve existing backend services, ensuring performance, reliability, and long‑term maintainability. Design, implement, and evolve RESTful APIs and service interfaces to enable seamless integration with frontend applications and other systems. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code in line with team coding standards and industry best practices. Contribute actively to planning, refinement, reviews, operations, and continuous improvement activities within the team. Collaborate closely with frontend developers to ensure smooth data flows, clear API contracts, and consistent end‑to‑end behavior. Implement and maintain unit, integration, and component tests to ensure high quality, stability, and regression prevention. Share responsibility for operations and maintenance as part of the team’s DevOps mindset, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous optimization. (Nice to have) Show interest in frontend technologies such as Angular and full‑stack development, with opportunities to collaborate across the stack if desired. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or comparable practical experience. Around 3-5 years of professional experience with Java (≥ 21) and building backend applications in production environments Strong hands‑on experience with Spring Boot (3.x) and core Spring modules such as Spring Data, Spring Integration, Spring Batch, and Spring Security Solid understanding of persistence technologies, including JPA 2 / Hibernate, and designing robust data access layers. Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining RESTful APIs for microservice‑based systems. Good knowledge of SQL databases, ideally PostgreSQL, including data modeling and query optimization. Experience writing unit and integration tests (e.g., JUnit or similar frameworks) to ensure code quality and stability. Familiarity with microservice and cloud architectures, including service communication and API‑based integration. Experience working with containerization technologies such as Docker; exposure to Kubernetes is a plus. Proficiency with JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA or comparable Java IDEs. Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum or Kanban) and working in agile development teams. Strong communication skills in Spanish and English, both verbal and written. WHAT WE OFFER Continuous training and professional development with our internal vacancies. Safe environment where we promote your health. Restaurant ticket. Competitive economic offer with a base salary plus a variable for good performance. Hybrid model of work and adapt your schedule according to your circumstances. Connect outside the office and practice sports with colleagues through company groups. Flexible remuneration that you can voluntarily allocate to transportation services, training, childcare, etc. Pension plans, life and accident insurance, personal loans and participation in company stock programs. Financial aid for schooling and other measures for families. HOW TO PARTICIPATE IN THE PROCESS Send your CV in English through the job offer so we can get to know each other. If your profile matches, we will call you from the Spanish Talent Acquisition team in Germany (prefix +49) and support you throughout the process. With each step, you will be closer to meeting your future team! Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Master Data is the backbone of any digital enterprise — getting it right is essential to enable automation, enhance decision-making, and deliver seamless customer experiences. As we continue to industrialize our data landscape, we are looking for passionate individuals who want to make a difference by ensuring that our MDM systems are reliable, scalable, and aligned with our global data strategy. Join us in building a connected data enterprise where high-quality master data powers innovation, compliance, and business growth across the agricultural value chain. RESPONSIBILITIES Collaborate with product stakeholders to understand business needs, transform them into technical specifications, and estimate resources and timelines. Develop and maintain features within the Stibo STEP platform, including customization of workflows, business rules (JavaScript), WebUI, and data model configurations. Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code while participating in code reviews to ensure adherence to development standards and maintainability. Use Azure DevOps to manage code repositories, development tasks, and implement CI/CD pipelines. Ensure high system quality and performance by applying continuous testing, monitoring, and optimization strategies, including implementing security and access controls. Support issue resolution, debug and troubleshoot problems within the STEP environment, and document solutions and technical progress. Contribute to data integration activities by identifying, modelling, and linking internal and external data sources within the STEP architecture. Actively engage in BASF development communities, promoting knowledge exchange and innovation around digital product development and data-driven solutions. jobs.name: Country Controller
jobs.description: In the Philippines, BASF has been supporting manufacturers from various industries since 1963. Today, BASF is a leading supplier of chemicals for industries, including Construction and Coatings, Automotive, Nutrition & Health, Home & Personal Care, and Agriculture. BASF also operates an Agricultural Research Station in the country which conducts research, laboratory studies and field testing of novel technologies. In 2024, BASF posted sales to customers in the Philippines of approximately €100 million and employed 92 people as of the end of the year. Further information is available at www.basf.com/ph . Job Description: Objectives of the Position In charge of financial planning, forecasting, reporting and business analysis and commercial controlling support for APA business in country. Act as financial advisor, challenger and business partner to the APA Local Business Manager (LBM) in all matters of financial relevance including business steering and projects/initiatives. Be the go-to person for Compliance questions. Be member of the country and business area APA management team Main Tasks Financial Reporting and Forecasting & Operational Planning: Responsible for monthly actual reporting and full year forecasting of P&L, specific balance sheet items and sales. Conduct forecasting processes as part of the integrated planning process (supply FC, demand FC, financial FC). Accountable for developing, tracking and reporting financial scenarios (risks & opportunities). Develop business commentary for corporate management. Identify risks/downsides and opportunities/upsides to sales plan. Document and track risks and opportunities including likelihood and decision time and review on a monthly basis. Commercial and Operational Controlling: Collect and review calendarized articles including volumes and prices. Support Country Management in steering pricing and rebate schemes. Develop price/volume scenarios. Check rebate settlement calculation, monitor rebate accruals. Track profitability on product level and initiate countermeasures (e.g. price increases) Track and support steering of expenses, i.e. selling cost, R&D cost, and manufacturing/tolling cost (if applicable) Request for ICTPs of new products, providing relevant information relating to market price and local COGS Monitor development of local COGS development (PUP review, MARS Q&A, material master status, tolling fees). Support operational business steering with adequate reports, ad-hoc analyses and recommendations Drive operational excellence projects Be the interface to the local credit management team. Monitor aging of receivables and support collection of overdues via development of payment plans Support LBM/Marketing/Sales in the design of commercial schemes by providing accurate information and developing comparative models for profit analysis Design SOP for commercial scheme pay-out and ensure proper records are kept for audit purposes Strategic controlling: Support financial evaluation as well as development and implementation of strategic projects (e.g. business models, go-to-market approach, make-or-buy decisions, investment decisions, portfolio management) Support strategy development. Plan, forecast and monitor capital expenditure Drive and train mindset of value based management across the organization Support value based decision making throughout the organization targeting sustainable optimization of absolute Market Performance. Perform ad-hoc analyses based on operational business steering requirements. Execute specific action plan to reduce dysfunctional stock (aging, no & slow mover). Strictly follow the inventory guideline process for inventory write-off and stock taking procedures [SC1] [RB2] . Oversee and coordinate with the Supply Chain team for all SC related tasks. Corporate Governance and Compliance: Go-to-person and increase awareness around compliance, internal guidelines and processes. Support design and/or improvement of internal controls Support internal audits and track follow-ups. Accountable for contract management. Responsible for project mangement specifically with the Differentiated Steering Minimum Education and Qualifications Required Bachelor Degree in Finance / Accounting Master’s Degree in Finance / Accounting is an advantage Working Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional experience in Controlling Technical & Professional Knowledge Advanced finance and accounting skills, proficiency in interpretation and analysis of financial reports. Strong knowledge of demand planning, inventory & distribution planning process APO DP & SAP knowledge is beneficial. Advanced skills in MS Office applications. Good command in English. Good communication skills, team player. All applications will be treated confidentially Only short-listed candidates will be interviewed Job Description Footer:

jobs.name: SAP FI-AP Consultant (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO THE TEAM If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In our unit Digital Solutions & IT Architecture, EC/XD, we develop concepts and IT solutions for our global coatings and surface business. We drive innovative solutions, ensure seamless end-to-end processes, and identify global best practices for our different locations. In this role as SAP Consultant for FI/AP you will: Define or select the technically optimal implementation of FI and AP processes, initially focusing on a global project for invoice processing You also take technical responsibility for interfaces to satellite systems. Work closely with the Global and Regional Process Owners of EC/XD and Controlling & Finance digitalization teams. Support shapping the future standalone FI and AP architecture and implement quality standards. Designing and implementing SAP solutions, including customizing, coding and integration into existing system landscapes, in close collaboration with technical implementation partners. Support as 2nd level our Application Managed Services in analyzing critical Incidents on our production system. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU Bachelor's Degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science or Business Administration with an IT focus. In-depth knowledge of IT landscapes, especially customizing and coding in the SAP (S/4HANA) FI module with focus on invoice processing. Knowledge in related SAP modules (SD, MM) and Process Director is a plus. Experience with methods and tools for interface description and data architecture. Several years of experience with global IT projects is desirable. Strong communication and presentation skills in English and Spanish. Analytical skills and enjoyment of teamwork to achieve optimal results with internal and external partners. WHAT WE OFFER Continuous training and professional development with our internal vacancies. Safe environment where we promote your health. Restaurant ticket. Competitive economic offer with a base salary plus a variable for good performance. Home office and adapt your schedule according to your circumstances. Connect outside the office and practice sports with colleagues through company groups. Flexible remuneration that you can voluntarily allocate to transportation services, training, childcare, etc. Pension plans, life and accident insurance, personal loans and participation in company stock programs. Financial aid for schooling and other measures for families. HOW TO PARTICIPATE IN THE PROCESS Send your CV in English through the job offer so we can get to know each other. If your profile matches, we will call you from the Spanish Talent Acquisition team in Germany (prefix +49) and support you throughout the process. With each step, you will be closer to meeting your future team! If you have any further questions about this process, please contact: Antonio (antonio.casas-castro@basf.com*) *Please note that we will not be able to accept your resume via this email. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.name: Business Analyst (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and strongly encourage applications from individuals with disabilities. We value diversity and believe that varied perspectives enhance our team's effectiveness. Our hiring practices are designed to ensure equal opportunity for all candidates. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to dissect complex issues and propose practical solutions. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate with. With cross-functional teams and explain complex technical concepts to non technical stakeholders. Self-motivated, with the ability to take initiative and drive projects forward with minimal supervision. Experience working with external vendors or partners. Ability to learn quickly and stay updated with emerging trends in tools and technologies. WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. jobs.name: Senior PKI Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. Digitalization will be a true part of BASF’s DNA that creates new exciting customer experiences and business growth as well as drives efficiencies in processes. This is our digital VISION for BASF. Global Digital Services (GDS) is supporting BASF business in Digitalization transformation. Our MISSION is to drive forward the digital transformation of BASF, providing innovative, global and high-quality digital products and services through a strong agile culture. The product family Cyber Engineering & IAM Solutions enables the business to operate securely by ensuring consistent security measures and maintaining a unified defense through reliable, standardized engineering practices. As a product team of this family, the Certificate Management team is a key enabler for Information Security by managing cryptographic keys and digital certificates. It operates and continuously enhances the trust anchor systems Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Hardware Security Module (HSM) and Key Management System (KMS) incl. provisioning of TLS certificates by a Cloud service. RESPONSIBILITIES As a team member of the Certificate Management team, you will be part of a team delivering global IT services in an agile set-up with the following main tasks: Configuration and operation of Windows- and Linux-based certificate lifecycle solutions (PKI). Creation and customization of processes for certificate lifecycle management. Configuration and operation of key management systems and hardware security modules. Focus on automation and standardization of the respective use cases, you are responsible for. Troubleshooting, ticket handling & Change Management QUALIFICATIONS Completed Master’s degree or comparable in the field of IT, e.g. Cyber Security, Informatics/ Computer Science, Mathematics Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience in the environment of PKI/CA and/or cryptography Powershell-Scripting, Repository Management over Github, General-Scripting (Azure DevOps) Strong commitment, fast comprehension & Innovative thinking skills Agile Development & Growth Mindset Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking English proficiency required Nice to have: Knowledge in working with Thales Safenet HSMs and/or Nexus PKI BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. jobs.name: Manufacturing Operator
jobs.description: Now hiring! Manufacturing Operator Sparks, Georgia Starting pay at $18. You will work 14 out of 28 days in 12-hour rotating shifts. You will get shift differential (increase in pay) when rotating to night shift. $500.00 Signing bonus : $250 after 30 days, $250 after 60 days from hire date. Full benefits package available including 401K. We are looking for a Manufacturing Operator to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Sparks, GA. Come create chemistry with us! BASF's Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. As a Manufacturing Operator, you will measure and batch raw materials to ensure product quality, safely operate batching equipment, and comply with all regulations. You will maintain batch records, complete daily checklists, and update shift activity boards while adhering to safety policies and participating in safety meetings. During your 12-hour rotating shifts as a Manufacturing Operator, you will Measure and batch raw materials in accordance with precise Manufacturing guidelines and procedures so the product meets customer specifications. Safely operate equipment associated with batching operations including pumps, motors, mills, tanks, ventilation systems, control panels. Operate processing equipment in compliance with company training and all federal, state, and local regulations. Maintain batch records, complete daily checklists, update shift activity boards. Always adhere to established safety, health and environmental policies and procedures, including participating in Safety meetings. If you... Earned a HS Diploma or GED . Have at least 2 years of experience in a Manufacturing facility or have work skills that may transfer to a Manufacturing environment. Are open to a 12-hour rotating day/night shifts. Can perform physical activities such as bending and climbing stairs. Are willing to wear the necessary Personal Protection Equipment, such as, hard hats, gloves, goggles, masks & sometimes respirators to ensure safety precautions are met. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact myhr@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Project Lead Strategy Consulting (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Welcome to the global management consultancy of BASF! We focus on strategic projects that drive the effective transformation of our businesses. Our teams work on a broad range of topics such as sustainability, organizational development, efficiency projects, M&A, and profitable growth through all types of innovation. We put people first: We are proud of our strong team spirit, and we cherish diversity. Become part of a great international team where your hands-on approach and desire to leave an impact are truly valued. Together, let’s create new ideas and offer the best solutions to our customers. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As Project Lead (m/f/d) you collaborate with colleagues on complex strategy consulting projects and provide impactful solutions for businesses and functions across BASF. You identify potential improvements in each project and advise the management team competently and empathetically. From Day 1, you apply your skills and contribute your ideas to ongoing projects. You communicate clearly and openly with all parties involved throughout all project phases. Our end-to-end consulting services allow you to accompany a project from start to finish. You enjoy top management visibility by working with BASF Executives globally on a wide range of strategic high-priority projects with sustainable impact. Our projects cover the fields of Innovation & Growth, Marketing & Sales, Organizational Excellence, and Post-Merger Integration/Carve Out. For an overview about our practice groups see here . WHAT YOU OFFER professional experience in strategic consulting and project work in a (global) strategy consulting firm depending on your qualifications and professional experience, you start as Project Leader (3-5 years) or Senior Project Leader (5-7 years) proven expertise in project management methods as well as consulting methodologies and approaches excellent communication skills in English; German is a plus convincing and competent behavior in client interactions open-minded and inclusive attitude, reliable team player international work experience is a plus WHAT WE OFFER Attractive location: Your work location is in Monheim (near Düsseldorf), the administrative headquarters of BASF Personal Care & Nutrition GmbH. The Monheim office has a canteen and modern, flexible workspaces designed to accommodate various teams and functions. Hybrid Work: You can combine remote work with up to 3 office days. Regular visits of our headquarters in Ludwigshafen are required, e.g. for monthly team days or unit events. Depending on the project/client, journeys to other BASF sites may be necessary as well. Work-Life-Balance: We offer access to childcare providers, flexible working time models, and cooperations with fitness and health studios, along with numerous other (preventive) offers for your mental and physical health. Individual support for your professional development is part of our mission. jobs.name: (Senior) Specialist External Reporting (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We in Agricultural Solutions are preparing to be an independent, pure-play agricultural company within BASF group. To be ready for independence, we are looking for you to join us in our new Corporate roles (see here: build your career on our Standalone Transformation ). In this role you take ownership of the preparation and publication of the Group’s external financial reports, including annual and interim financial statements, the management report (“Lagebericht”) and regulatory filings, ensuring full compliance with IFRS and internal reporting standards. Your expertise is in demand as you manage and further develop the disclosure tool, prepare and review notes and disclosures, and ensure full alignment with consolidated figures, accounting policies and applicable reporting requirements. You ensure that group accounting policies and IFRS interpretations defined by Accounting Governance / IFRS are consistently applied and accurately reflected throughout all external reporting outputs. Career starters with passion & basics in supply chain processes are welcome Hands-on experience in process optimization, continuous improvement, or service performance management within a global operations environment. Proficient in MS Office applications such as Word Excel, PowerPoint, MS Teams, and digital tools Strong analytical and conceptual thinking with a structured problem-solving mindset. jobs.name: Breeding Agronomist
jobs.description: About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a Breeding Agronomist, you will enjoy a varied role conducting field trials and plant breeding experiments. You'll be responsible for planning and executing field trials, inclusive of trial site management, data collection and communication with our colleagues. How You Will Do It Establish and maintain field trials to produce data and seed, maintain all breeding records, update breeding database with trial and seed production results. Responsible in all aspects of the field program; locating and contracting land, land preparation and all in-season agronomy, following trial protocol and implementing treatments, harvest of trial and shipping of seed. Collaborate with breeders in the conduct of experiments and seed productions in growth chambers at Longerenong. Manage the supply of all key inputs (land, pollinators, contractors, materials) to ensure an efficient and reliable supply is maintained. Be field-based and hands on to ensure operations & activities are on time and to budget. Ensure all operations satisfy safety, regulatory, stewardship and compliance requirements. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you’ll have previous experience in an agronomy-based role and an understanding or interest in plant breeding or agricultural research.. You’ll have a strong focus on detail and enjoy a role with a balance of planning and hands-on operations. You will: Have a degree in Agricultural Science or similar discipline Have 2-10 years of experience conducting field trials Have experience in operating trial equipment and/or farm machinery. Have sound knowledge of canola agronomy. Understanding of hybrid seed production, particularly in relation to canola. Have knowledge of procedures used in agricultural field trials and plant breeding. Show natural leadership in ensuring that people follow guidelines and plan effectively. Demonstrate the ability to collaborate with a diverse range of people. Display strong communication and interpersonal skills. Have a valid driver’s license. A MR or HR license would be beneficial. What We Can Offer You At BASF you get more than just compensation. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements to suit each one of our global team. By creating chemistry with us, you can look forward to: A diverse and inclusive environment, with an open and fair internal promotion process A competitive parental leave policy, regardless of gender, and a supportive return to work plan Give back to your community with our corporate volunteering scheme 4 weeks annual leave, with the offer to purchase additional leave throughout the year Opportunities to apply for international assignments – the perks of a global business! Connect to Create Chemistry If you’d like to join a diverse global business and create chemistry for a sustainable future, we want to hear from you! Click ‘apply’ below. BASF is proud to be a WORK180 Endorsed Employer for all women. If you’d like to know more information about how we are supporting our employees, you can view our policies and benefits here . Offers of employment will be subject to background checks including references, police checks and may include a pre-employment medical. Beware, Job Applicants. At BASF, we are committed to providing a safe and transparent recruitment process. Please be aware of job scams and fraudulent job postings. Only apply through the official BASF Career website to ensure your application is received by us. Be cautious of unsolicited job offers or communications that do not come from official BASF email addresses. Verify any doubtful communications through our HR department. Never provide personal information or make payment as part of the application process. #LI-Jobs

Wir sind ein international erfolgreiches Unternehmen der BASF-Gruppe. Unsere Lösungen sind speziell für verschiedene Anbausysteme entwickelt. Sie verbinden Saatgut und speziell gezüchtete Pflanzeneigenschaften, Pflanzenschutzprodukte, digitale Tools und Nachhaltigkeitsansätze, um Landwirten, Züchtern und anderen Interessengruppen entlang der Wertschöpfungskette bestmögliche Ergebnisse zu bieten. Mit Teams im Labor, auf dem Feld, im Büro und in der Produktion tun wir alles, was in unserer Macht steht, um eine nachhaltige Zukunft für die Landwirtschaft zu schaffen. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth Hier erhältst du nähere Einblicke in unsere Vision bei Agricultural Solutions! ELEMENTE DEINER AUSBILDUNG Mit dem “plus“ bieten wir dir die einmalige Chance, die Inhalte aus zwei Berufen zu erlernen. In deiner Ausbildung als Anlagenmechaniker:in erhältst du bei uns on top auch alle wichtigen Inhalte der Industriemechanik. Du hast dich schon immer gerne mit Werkzeugen beschäftigt und interessierst dich für Technik? Hast du Spaß daran dich aktiv einzubringen, Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen faszinieren dich? Dann werden dir spannende Aufgaben, wie das Bearbeiten von metallischen Werkstoffen, das Herstellen von Rohrleitungen oder Instandsetzen von Pumpen, Getrieben und Maschinen sicher leicht von der Hand gehen. Wenn du Spaß an der Arbeit im Team und an unseren modernen Produktionsanlagen hast, dann ist dieser Ausbildungsberuf genau der richtige für dich. DAS LERNST DU WÄHREND DEINER AUSBILDUNG Metalltechnik von A - Z Planen von Arbeitsabläufen und Umsetzen der erforderlichen Fertigungs- und Montagearbeiten Berechnen von Fertigungsdaten und Festlegen von Fertigungsabläufen an Metallbearbeitungsmaschinen Herstellen von Bauteilen, Baugruppen und Rohrleitungssystemen mit verschiedenen Fertigungs-, Montage-, Zerspanungs- und Schweißtechniken Aktive Mitarbeit bei Themen der Arbeitssicherheit Technische Systeme, Maschinen und Anlagen instandhalten Modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit digitalen Lernmöglichkeiten Kennenlernen digitaler Lösungen und KI-Anwendungen, mit denen Arbeitsabläufe effizienter gestaltet werden können Neugierig geworden? Schau dir hier unser Video an! DAS BRINGST DU MIT mindestens eine Berufsreife / einen Hauptschulabschluss präzises, zuverlässiges und verantwortungsbewusstes Arbeiten körperliche Belastbarkeit, Arbeiten in verschiedenen Höhen und sicheres Farbsehvermögen handwerkliches Geschick gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen und zeichnerische Darstellungsfähigkeit Lust auf eine persönliche Weiterentwicklung Motivation, sich in moderne Technologien wie KI einzuarbeiten und im Arbeitsalltag anzuwenden DAS BIETEN WIR IN DEINER AUSBILDUNG eine hochqualifizierte Ausbildung bei BASF Agricultural Solutions Deutschland GmbH, einem internationalen Unternehmen für landwirtschaftliche Lösungen spannende und vielfältige Ausbildungsinhalte durch die Kooperation mit der BASF SE in Ludwigshafen und der BBS Technik I in Ludwigshafen maßgeschneiderte Schulungsangebote sowie die Möglichkeit zur Teilnahme an EU-Austauschprojekten attraktive Vergütung - du startest mit 1147 Euro pro Monat im 1. Ausbildungsjahr zahlreiche Zusatzleistungen wie zum Beispiel Jahresprämie, Erfolgsbeteiligung, 700 Euro Urlaubsgeld, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Teilnahme am BASF Aktienprogramm, Tablet, Essensgeldzuschuss, Zuschuss Jobticket 30 Tage Urlaub und 37,5 Stunden-Woche Freizeit- und Fitnessangebote sowie Mitarbeiterevents gute Übernahmechancen bei entsprechenden Leistungen AUSBILDUNG GESCHAFFT - WAS DANN ? Du überzeugst mit deiner Persönlichkeit und deinen Leistungen. Mit deinem Fachwissen bist du nicht nur Ansprechpartner:in, sondern auch ein wichtiges Mitglied unseres Teams. Nachdem du weitere Berufserfahrung gesammelt hast, erwarten dich interessante Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungschancen. DEIN WEG ZU UNS: Richtig bewerben - so geht's! Neugierde, Offenheit und Motivation. Für uns steht deine Persönlichkeit im Vordergrund. Noten sind nicht alles. Im ersten Schritt des Auswahlverfahrens bleiben die Schulnoten daher erst einmal unberücksichtigt. Für uns ist der Gesamteindruck entscheidend. Daher LET´S MATCH & BEWIRB DICH JETZT: Bewerbungsstart: ab April 2026 Bewerbungsende: Es gibt keine Frist, du kannst dich bewerben, solange Plätze frei sind! Reiche daher bitte nur Kopien und keine Originale ein. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! ÜBER UNS Die BASF Agricultural Solutions Deutschland GmbH bietet als zuverlässiger Partner der Landwirtschaft innovative, nachhaltige Lösungen speziell für verschiedene Anbausysteme. Unser Unternehmenssitz ist das Agrarzentrum in Limburgerhof, nahe der BASF-Konzernzentrale in Ludwigshafen. In der Metropolregion Rhein-Neckar erwartet dich beruflich wie auch privat ein attraktives Umfeld. Mehr über das Agrarzentrum in Limburgerhof erfährst du unter: on.basf.com/BASFSE_LI​ Mehr über unser Team in Agricultural Solutions erfährst du hier Deine Ausbildung wird in Kooperation mit der BASF SE in Ludwigshafen stattfinden, das bedeutet, deine Ausbildungsphasen oder Veranstaltungen können sowohl in Limburgerhof als auch in Ludwigshafen stattfinden. jobs.name: Assistant Sales Manager, Pharma Solutions
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Job Description: About The Role Drive sales Growth: Plan sales strategy in order to achieve agreed sales target and grow sustainably in the defined territory. Find opportunities: Develop project pipeline with customers, business partners and through partnerships with technical team Close profitable deals Market Research to cover trends, regulation, competitor and growth opportunities How You Will Do It Strategic: Strategy Development, conceptualization and implementation: contribute to the development and drive the execution of the Pharma Solutions strategy. Specific responsibilities include annual and short-termed sales plans, business and market development, market research and planning, strategic direction for local promotion, and partnering with other related management teams, e.g. customer service, supply chain, product management, marketing. Operational: Perform all sales driven activities for Pharma Solutions in the assigned territory Support business growth: Apply the overall sales process, aiming to meet or exceed sales related targets (e.g. volume, cCM1 and net sales, cost, DIV, DSO). Close deals to maximize cCM1. Be responsibile for Planning & Forecasting: Provide accurate sales forecast, supporting efficient planning of products and services. Close coordination with sub regional planner to ensure adequate stocking for the customers in the territory Manage Accounts: Develop lasting customer relationships to identify business trends. Key Account management of defined customers by ensuring that there is defined and documented account plans, distribution evaluation tool, customer specific business and / or technical solutions Drive growth through effective Distribution Management Manage business Development: Develop customer portfolio to grow net sales and profit. Discover and drive opportunities at customers. Strengthen opportunity finding, increase opportunity pipeline value and drive growth opportunities through effective sales pipeline management in close collaboration with the technical service team. Execute of Sales Excellence (Effectiveness of sales), pricing through CPQ, Sales Force usage and BRM compliance. Perform additional Sales related activities in close collaboration with SCM and CSO community to ensure smooth order processing and removing of potential order blocks. Actively contribute to fill innovation pipeline based on interaction and feedback from customers as well as market knowledge. Manage reports – provide regular reports on sales and allied activities as per the requirement What We Look For University degree, minimum Bachelor Degree in Pharmaceutical or Chemical or Science related major, ideally additional MBA Degree. Minimum 5-7 years total professional experience of which at least 5 years in sales related job.  Pharma & Excipients. At least 4 years experiences in commercial roles in pharma business or related industries with a proven track record of developing business. Knowledge in handling technical matters and commercial transactions; knowledge and / or skills in pharmaceutical technology and operations; being familiar with pharma related quality standards (GMP) preferable; ideally, experience in key account management. Dass "Fotosynthese" kein Bildbearbeitungsprogramm ist, war dir schon immer klar. Kurzum: Biologie fasziniert dich und du willst sie zu deinem Beruf machen! Arbeite mit unseren Forschern an der Gewinnung neuer Erkenntnisse und führe Versuche in den Bereichen der Grundlagenforschung, des Pflanzenschutzes und der Diagnostik durch. Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent und hast Spaß daran, Menschen einen unvergesslichen Aufenthalt zu bereiten? Du bist engagiert und hast Lust, in einem einzigartigen Team zu arbeiten? Dann starte deine Ausbildung als Hotelfachmann:frau in unserem Hotel und erlebe, wie vielseitig und spannend der Beruf in der Hotellerie sein kann! DAS LERNST DU WÄHREND DEINER AUSBILDUNG •    Front Office: ein- und auschecken sowie betreuen von internationalen Gästen, abwickeln von Reservierungen, Korrespondenz und administrativen Tätigkeiten •    Einblicke ins Yield Management (strategische Preisgestaltung) •    Veranstaltungsmanagement: Verkaufsgespräche führen, bearbeiten und einbuchen von Tagungsanfragen und Veranstaltungen •    Betreuen von Tagungen und Veranstaltungen mit Vor- und Nachbereitung inkl. Rechnungsstellung •    Housekeeping (professionelle Sauberkeit und Hygiene herstellen und erhalten) •    Servieren von Speisen und Getränken, Barservice, zubereiten einfacher Speisen •    Einblicke ins Marketing und Controlling DAS BRINGST DU MIT •    mindestens Mittlere Reife •    gute Umgangsformen, ein gepflegtes Erscheinungsbild sowie sicheres Auftreten •    gutes Ausdrucks- und Formulierungsvermögen sowie Interesse an fremden Kulturen und Sprachen •    ausgeprägte Kontaktfähigkeit und Kundenorientierung •    Flexibilität und Belastbarkeit •    Freude an kaufmännischen Tätigkeiten sowie am Planen und Organisieren •    erste Erfahrungen in der Gastronomie wünschenswert DAS BIETEN WIR IN DEINER AUSBILDUNG Diese Vorteile hast du während deiner gastronomischen Ausbildung im führenden Chemieunternehmen der Welt: Vergütung: Gehalt im ersten Ausbildungsjahr 1.147 € pro Monat; im Zweiten 1.232 € und im Dritten 1.343 €, Jahresprämie, Zukunftsbetrag und Urlaubsgeld, Feiertags- und Nachtzuschläge sowie Zuschuss zum Jobticket, 2 Tage bezahlte Freistellung zur Prüfungsvorbereitung Urlaub und Arbeitszeit: 30 Tage Urlaub, planbare Arbeitszeiten durch frühzeitig abgestimmte Dienstpläne, elektronische Zeiterfassung, Überstunden werden abgefeiert Zusatzleistungen: Tablet, Arbeitskleidung inkl. Reinigung, Finanzierung der Bücher für die Berufsschule Einarbeitung und Qualifizierung: Start in die Ausbildung Schritt für Schritt mit festen Ansprechpartnern und gleichzeitig direktem Einstieg in die täglichen Abläufe, maßgeschneiderte Schulungsangebote, Kennenlernen der BASF Gastronomie in Ludwigshafen (4-Sterne-Superior Hotel René Bohn und gehobene Gastronomie des Gesellschaftshauses) AUSGELERNT UND BEREIT DURCHZUSTARTEN? jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Join our Trade Invoicing Team as soon as possible and ensure together with us high-quality invoicing services! You serve as a point for contact for different units such as IT, supply chain and customer service regarding trade invoicing activities within the O2C process to find solutions for complex SAP topics. In addition, you perform E2E monitoring activities, providing support in exception handling as well as analyzing technical SAP related topics ensuring invoicing Efficiency, Effectiveness and Compliance. By testing defined concepts in the system and correcting errors, you support us in the conceptual development of invoicing processes in compliance with legal requirements. jobs.name: (Senior) Project Manager Supply Chain Consulting (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Welcome to the global management consultancy of BASF! We focus on strategic projects that drive the effective transformation of our businesses. Our teams work on a broad range of topics such as sustainability, organizational development, efficiency projects, M&A, and profitable growth through all types of innovation. We put people first: We are proud of our strong team spirit, and we cherish diversity. Become part of a great international team where your hands-on approach and desire to leave an impact are truly valued. Together, let’s create new ideas and offer the best solutions to our customers. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As a Project Managing Consultant, you make a real difference for the future of BASF by providing innovative solutions and effective recommendations to BASF's leaders. Our internal customers include the entire value chain of BASF from base chemicals to specialties, each with their unique requirements. You will be focusing on the topics of sustainability, end-to-end supply chain processes, automation & digitalization initiatives and complexity management. End to end project leadership: You lead high impact supply chain consulting engagements from initial problem structuring and value case design through solution development and implementation planning. CORE value chain focus: You drive transformations in large scale, cost critical chemical and consumer care–relevant value chains, with emphasis on planning, S&OP, logistics, inventory, and network optimization. Senior stakeholder engagement: You act as a trusted sparring partner for senior leaders and project sponsors, communicating clearly, fact based, and with a strong value orientation. AI enabled consulting: You leverage advanced analytics and AI supported tools (e.g. scenario modeling, planning analytics, process mining, decision support solutions) to accelerate insights, improve decision quality, and increase consulting impact. Capability building: You coach and develop consultants in modern consulting methods, digital and AI capabilities, and BASF Winning Ways behaviors, ensuring sustainable adoption in the organization. Thought leadership: You continuously monitor external trends and internal priorities to develop new methodologies and scalable solutions for BASF’s future supply chain challenges. WHAT YOU OFFER several years of professional experience in supply chain consulting or transformation roles, ideally in CORE chemical, consumer care, or asset intensive industries proven expertise in areas such as supply chain strategy, planning, S&OP, cost optimization, inventory management, or logistics strong strategic thinker with a hands on, data driven mindset and experience leading teams and complex stakeholder environments exposure to advanced analytics, AI supported planning, or digital supply chain solutions is a strong advantage excellent proficiency in English, good German skills and international work experience are a plus high level of ownership, curiosity, and entrepreneurial drive, aligned with BASF Winning Ways WHAT WE OFFER Attractive location: Your work location is in Monheim (near Düsseldorf), the administrative headquarters of BASF Personal Care & Nutrition GmbH. The Monheim office has a canteen and modern, flexible workspaces designed to accommodate various teams and functions. Hybrid Work: You can combine remote work with up to 3 office days. Regular visits of our headquarters in Ludwigshafen are required, e.g. for monthly team days or unit events. Depending on the project/client, journeys to other BASF sites may be necessary as well. Work-Life-Balance: We offer access to childcare providers, flexible working time models, and cooperations with fitness and health studios, along with numerous other (preventive) offers for your mental and physical health. Personal Growth: We provide a comprehensive training program tailored to your needs. Our unit has a successful track record in employee career development: former team members can be found at all hierarchy levels at BASF globally. Individual support for your professional development is part of our mission. Perks : An attractive salary and a variable bonus, employee stock options, the possibility of special leave, 30 days of paid vacation, canteens with freshly cooked food, job bike, social counselling, and many others. Using natural, renewable raw materials, we develop and produce a large range of ingredients for the personal care sector. Learn more about BASF Personal Care and Nutrition GmbH at on.basf.com/ECareandNutrition Diversity is our greatest strength! jobs.name: Production Manager
jobs.description: O bjectives of the Position Responsible in managing daily production operations to ensure timely, safe, and high-quality production of products, while also focusing on training production personnel, optimizing procedures, and ensuring compliance. Main Responsibilities Ensure all environmental, health and safety rules and guidelines are fully adhered and maintaining high safety standards for a safe working environment. Plan, organize, and manage daily production activities to ensure that production schedules and target quantities are met. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Production Superintendent, Production Supervisors, Boardmen and technicians fostering a culture of teamwork and accountability. Conduct periodic training, performance evaluations, provide feedback, and identify training needs for team members (including succession planning for roles Boardman and above). Facilitate effective communication within the production team and across departments. Perform internal audits to support ISO9001, ISO14001 and ISO 50001 standards. Implement and uphold quality control measures to maintain product quality requirements and consistency within production team. Coordinate production trials, test and implement recommendations from Toray to improve plant operation and product quality as and when required (via MOC process). Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, Polymer Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field At least 7 years of experience in production management within a manufacturing environment, preferably in polymerization and distillation processes. Technical & Professional Knowledge Proven experience leading teams and managing production operations. Strong communication skills, both verbal and written (English & Bahasa Malaysia) Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities. A proactive and results-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement. Commitment to fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture. About BASF in Malaysia BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Site Services & Utilities Coordinator
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission At BASF plc's Widnes site, our Centre of Excellence for Pest Control, we take pride in manufacturing and packing high-quality rodenticides. The site was acquired from Sorex Limited at the end of 2008. The new business, launched in 2009, combined the renowned technical expertise, products, and skills of both BASF and Sorex, creating a powerhouse in pest control solutions. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Own and coordinate all site facilities, services and utilities, ensuring safe, compliant and reliable day‑to‑day operations in line with BASF standards and legal/statutory requirements, with full audit readiness at all times. Oversee the maintenance and integrity of buildings and utilities infrastructure (e.g. electrical, HVAC, water, compressed air), planning and assuring inspections, preventative maintenance and upgrades through competent external contractors. Lead and manage external service providers and contracts (e.g. cleaning, grounds, mobile equipment, inspections), ensuring service quality, SLA compliance, cost control and effective issue resolution. Maintain robust compliance and governance controls, ensuring all inspections, certificates, service reports, RAMS, insurances and close‑out documentation are accurate, traceable, CMMS‑managed and approved before work commences. Support site engineering and infrastructure projects, collaborating with maintenance and engineering teams on utilities planning, improvement works and breakdown response, providing practical technical coordination while minimising operational disruption. WHAT YOU OFFER Minimum of NVQ Level 3 (or equivalent) in a technical discipline, e.g. Electrical, Mechanical, Utilities Management, or a related field. Proven experience managing site services, utilities, and contractors within a DSEAR/ATEX, process‑safety‑led manufacturing environment, with strong compliance awareness. Demonstrable capability in EHS and contractor management, including PTW processes, RAMS review, and contractor insurance and policy compliance, operating to audit‑ready standards. Highly organised with strong planning and scheduling skills, ensuring statutory inspections and routine site services are delivered reliably and on time. Confident communicator with experience managing service level agreements, coordinating internal stakeholders and external service providers, and tracking performance. Competent user of Microsoft Office, maintenance management software and SAP, with a solid mechanical/electrical understanding; hands‑on maintenance experience is advantageous for troubleshooting and operational support. WHAT WE OFFER At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. We offer a total package which includes: Attractive salary Bonus Defined contribution pension scheme 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays Company share scheme Private healthcare Life insurance Flexible working (role dependent) On the job training and development opportunities We believe in empowering our employees with the tools, guidance, and opportunities they need to thrive both professionally and personally. Your success is our success, and we are committed to supporting you in achieving your personal ambitions so that you can help us create chemistry. We believe that diversity and inclusion make the difference. Only when people with diverse backgrounds come together, contribute their various experiences and attitudes, and look at challenges from different perspectives, will creative innovations and ground-breaking solutions be created. We celebrate diversity and we actively promote an inclusive work environment. In the UK we have an active Diversity & Inclusion Strategy Action Group and work closely with external partner Inclusive Employers. We are an equal opportunities employer. All employment decisions shall be made without regard or reference to age, gender, race, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status and other protected characteristics. For more information please visit: https://www.basf.com/gb/en/careers/why-join-basf/basf-locally.html Location: Widnes Closing Date: 27.08.2026 ABOUT US Since 1880, BASF has been a cornerstone of industry in the UK. With locations spanning from Littlehampton on England's South Coast to Callanish on the Isle of Lewis in Scotland, our presence is truly nationwide. Our UK headquarters in Stockport, Greater Manchester, is the hub for our dedicated sales and services teams. From our manufacturing sites across the UK, we supply essential raw materials to a diverse range of industries, including agriculture, automotive, chemicals, construction, energy, and pharmaceuticals. Discover more about our incredible BASF UK team and their contributions to innovation and sustainability here: https://www.basf.com/gb/en/who-we-are/BASF-in-the-United-Kingdom At BASF, our culture is driven by strong core values and winning behaviors. We foster innovation, collaboration, and empower every team member to contribute to our success. Explore Our Winning Behaviors & Our Values to see how we create a dynamic and inclusive workplace.
