jobs.name: Technical Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Now Hiring! Technical Sales Representative If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. Company Description Surventis , is a global expert in the development, production and marketing of innovative and sustainable mobility and refinish coatings, as well as surface treatments for metal, plastic and glass across many industries. We share the skills, knowledge and resources of interdisciplinary global teams through a collaborative network of sites in Europe, North America, South America and Asia Pacific. Roles and Responsibilities Understands the business activities of accounts in the territory and applies knowledge of the customer’s internal operation to tailor sales presentations and sales proposals to the account’s specific needs. Manages territory profitability by reviewing territory compensation margins, providing margin improvement by product selection and optimum pricing.  Assures that technology provided within the territory strengthens the company’s competitive position within the accounts. Calls on established and prospective customers, determines their needs, and sells appropriate products to markets, targeted by the business units of the company. Selects the process and the right material to solve customer cleaning, sanitation or surface treatment problems. Price negotiation: Provide pricing quotes, price and delivery policy within established limits, subject to approval. Attain sales plan by securing new customers, increasing sales to current customers and maintaining up to date opportunity pipeline in CRM (Salesforces). Works closely with customers focusing on building strong business relationships. Maintains contacts with customers in relation to their service requirements. Provides information on new products, methods, techniques and other general information such as safety and disposal. Trains customers and insures proper and safe use of Chemetall materials. Reports competitive activities, that impact sales in the territory, to the supervisor (District Manager). Prepares and submits call reports, exception reports, and in-plant service reports via CRM (Salesforce). Share reports with appropriate colleagues to ensure collaboration with different functions to keep all necessary information on all accounts. Requirements BS Degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Engineering, or Business is required. Minimum of 2 years of relatable experience is required. B2B/outside industrial sales experience, in specialty chemical sales (surface treatment-paint pretreatments, wastewater treatments, metalworking fluids, etc.) preferred. Ability to make sales presentations and follow up with written proposals and manage customer contracts. Well organized with sales planning. Managing customer accounts within the assigned territory. Strong selling skills for customer acquisition and continuous up-/cross-selling opportunities (customer support/account management) Build and strengthen customer relationships. Technical consulting capabilities regarding products and processes; will learn and understand Chemetall product portfolio. Strong business acumen. Strong Negotiation skills Problem solving skills Time management Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Travel up to 50-60%, with occasional overnight travel. Valid driver's license in good standing. [[LEGAL_ENTITY_OBJ]] Notice regarding responsibility and data processing The job offers published on this platform relate exclusively to positions at . jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Join our international financial reporting team as a Financial Accountant. In this role, you are responsible for the general ledger and act as a crucial interface in finance. Business Transactions: As a Financial Accountant you process transactions within general ledger, lease and asset accounting, and reconcile with sub-ledgers. Financial Statements: Moreover, you prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFRS and local GaaP standards, and support income tax calculations. Reporting: You manage monthly group reporting for European BASF Group companies and respond to internal and external reporting inquiries. Central Contact: In addition, you serve as the main contact on accounting matters for subsidiaries, other departments at the hub, central financial units of BASF as well as the external auditor. Project Involvement: You actively participate in projects and collaborate on the technical, procedural and cultural development of our organization. jobs.name: Warehouse Packaging Technician
jobs.description: Now hiring! Warehouse Packaging Technician Bishop, TX - Overtime eligibility. The hourly pay rate starts at $19.10, with a progression plan that rewards skill development and mastery of job functions. We are looking for a Warehouse Packaging Technician to join our Nutrition & Health team in Bishop, TX. Come create chemistry with us! At BASF Nutrition and Health, we develop, produce and market ingredients and solutions for the nutrition and health industries that fulfill the highest safety, regulatory and sustainability standards. We bring our passion and energy to work every day, knowing that through our cutting-edge research and global collaboration, we deliver products that support the health and wellbeing of humans and animals alike across the globe. Our areas of impact include Human Nutrition, Animal Nutrition, Aroma Ingredients, Pharma Solutions and Enzymes. Working in Nutrition and Health offers opportunities for you to develop and grow at every stage of your career. Recently, feedback from BASF employees at our Bishop site revealed that 96% of respondents are proud to work for BASF, 93% indicated they enjoy their work and 93% would recommend BASF to others as a good place to work.  These results reflect a vibrant, supportive, and high-performing environment—exactly the kind of place where you can do your best work. As a valued member of Bishop Site team, you will report to the Packaging, Loading & Shipping Supervisor. You will be responsible for all aspects of personal safety, product quality, and operating of the packaging equipment. Your commitment to workplace safety will be critical as you will be responsible for proper compliance around safety procedures such as Safe Work, Hot Work, LOTO, management of change, and incident reporting/investigation. This position is part of a job family with multiple levels and will be filled at a level that is commensurate with the candidates' qualifications and experience. During your 12-hour shift as a Warehouse Technician, you will Follow Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and general housekeeping guidelines along with rules for FDA manufacturing plant Package active pharmaceutical ingredients and chemical intermediates in accordance with all site procedures and GMP. Perform logistics activities including loading and unloading drums and super sacks from trailers, all necessary paperwork required to ship materials and safe operation of fork trucks; Ensure standards of safety, environmental, team and individual performance are met in a high-performance team-based organization. Train new employees on unit activities. If you... Hold a high school diploma or GED. Preferrably have fork truck driving experience Are able to work a 12-hour rotating shift on an as-needed basis. Are able to lift up to 50lbs, wear a respirator and other physical activities. Preferrably bring at least 6 months of packaging experience in an FDA or ISO regulated environment. Demonstrate flexibility and openness to change; are results driven, detail oriented, dependable, and safety conscious. Have good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills Preferrably possess good understanding of ISO, GMP, and FDA guidelines, and operating PLC experience. jobs.description: Now hiring! 1st Class Mechanic McIntyre GA (Onsite) We are looking for a 1st Class Mechanic to join our Catalyst team in McIntyre GA. Come create chemistry with us! jobs.name: Business Consultant (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME Als je anderen inspireert, verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je impact en streeft naar uitmuntendheid, voel je je bij ons meteen thuis. Tot 1 juli hoorden we bij BASF; tijdens de huidige transitie staan alle vacatures en het sollicitatieproces nog op het BASF-platform en zijn ze in BASF‑branding zichtbaar. Laat dat je niet afschrikken: alle functies zijn voor Surventis en je sollicitatie komt rechtstreeks bij ons terecht. Bij Surventis kijken we verder dan de oppervlakte. We zetten de klant altijd centraal, denken proactief en ontwikkelen slimme oplossingen die echte waarde leveren en langdurige samenwerkingen creëren. We dagen elkaar uit, nemen eigenaarschap en streven continu naar verbetering. Breng je jezelf volledig mee, durf je het voor de hand liggende ter discussie te stellen en wil je groeien in een team dat écht betrokken is? Dan is Surventis de plek voor jou. Als Business Consultant ondersteun je Belgische carrosseriebedrijven bij het verbeteren van hun prestaties en duurzame groei. Je begeleidt klanten bij de optimalisatie van processen, ondersteunt verandertrajecten en helpt hen om nieuwe manieren van werken succesvol te implementeren. Je combineert advies, training en begeleiding: je geeft praktijkgerichte trainingen rond zowel hard skills als soft skills binnen een carrosseriebedrijf en fungeert als brug tussen carrosseriebedrijven en verzekeringsmaatschappijen. Ben jij een bruggenbouwer die organisaties laat groeien in een sector in volle transformatie? Heb je een passie voor innovatie, klantgerichtheid en procesoptimalisatie? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Je adviseert carrosseriebedrijven bij het verbeteren van operationele en organisatorische processen. Je begeleidt verandertrajecten en ondersteunt klanten bij de concrete implementatie op de werkvloer. Je geeft inspirerende en praktijkgerichte trainingen gericht op zowel operationele als gedragsmatige vaardigheden. Je fungeert als aanspreekpunt en verbindende schakel tussen carrosseriebedrijven, verzekeringsmaatschappijen en diverse netwerken. Je werkt samen met interne teams (sales, technisch, consultancy) en externe partners om maximale klantwaarde te creëren. Belangrijkste vaardigheden en competenties Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden: je communiceert helder, overtuigend en empathisch met verschillende doelgroepen. Ervaring of talent in het geven van presentaties en trainingen die inspireren en activeren. Klantgericht en oplossingsgericht: je herkent behoeften en vertaalt deze naar concrete, haalbare verbeteringen. Analytisch sterk: je analyseert organisatiestructuren, werkwijzen en data (o.a. BodyShopManagement‑rapporten) en vertaalt inzichten naar verbeteracties. Innovatief en pragmatisch: je introduceert nieuwe tools en procesverbeteringen, eventueel in samenwerking met externe partners. Teamplayer en bruggenbouwer: je bouwt duurzame samenwerkingen met collega’s en externe partners. WHAT YOU OFFER Je beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, mondeling en schriftelijk. Je hebt ervaring met procesoptimalisatie, consultancy of begeleiding van organisaties. Je combineert analytisch inzicht met een pragmatische en mensgerichte aanpak. Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en bent flexibel ingesteld. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands; kennis van Engels en/of Frans is een sterke troef. Je hebt een goede kennis van MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI). Ervaring in de auto‑ of carrosseriesector is een pluspunt. WHAT WE OFFER Een verantwoordelijke functie in een dynamische, innovatieve en hoogtechnologische omgeving. Een gevarieerde en boeiende job met veel autonomie en impact bij klanten. Flexibele werkmogelijkheden. Een aantrekkelijk verloningspakket inclusief salaris, eindejaarspremie, bonus, groepsverzekering, bedrijfswagen en extra legale voordelen. ABOUT US Surventis biedt hoogwaardige refinish‑lakmerken en bijhorende producten aan carrosseriebedrijven wereldwijd. Onze oplossingen zijn goedgekeurd door toonaangevende autofabrikanten en ondersteunen klanten bij het verbeteren van efficiëntie, kwaliteit en bedrijfsresultaten. Wat ons als werkgever onderscheidt, is onze unieke cultuur: samenwerking, empowerment en persoonlijke groei staan centraal. Bij Surventis krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken, jezelf te ontwikkelen en mee te schrijven aan de toekomst van onze sector. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.description: Now hiring! Millwright Regina, SK (On-site) Annual bonus / Overtime pay eligible We are looking for a Millwright to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Regina, SK. BASF’s Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. As a Millwright, you will perform safe, reliable, and efficient mechanical maintenance activities to support continuous operation of the Regina chemical manufacturing facility. The Maintenance Millwright Technician is responsible for executing planned and corrective maintenance work, troubleshooting mechanical equipment failures, and supporting asset reliability and mechanical integrity. Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills, with working knowledge of pumps, gearboxes, bearings, couplings, conveyors, rotating equipment and mechanical drives, with the ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, technical manuals, and P&IDs. Experience with alignment, rigging, precision measurements, and mechanical installation practices. Experience working with Enterprise Asset Management systems, preferably SAP PM, and demonstrate proficiency in basic computer use, electronic work order systems, and maintenance documentation. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Représentant de Service Technique 1 1 Nous sommes à la recherche d'un représentant de service technique pour rejoindre notre division Agricultural Solutions à l’est de l’Ontario ou au Québec. Venez créer de la chimie avec nous! La division Agricultural Solutions de BASF met en relation l’innovation, les clients, les partenaires et les experts agricoles et intègre des critères de durabilité dans toutes les décisions commerciales. Nous aidons les agriculteurs à obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles, en s’efforçant d’atteindre l’équilibre entre la création de valeur économique, environnementale et sociale pour une agriculture durable et efficace. Le représentant de service technique (contrat de 14 mois) est chargé de s’assurer que le positionnement des produits marketing, commerciaux et techniques est conforme à la région et à l’équipe de spécialistes des cultures qu’il soutient. Comme Représentant de Service Technique 1 1, vous créez de la chimie en... Dispensant une formation technique à la force de vente et aux principaux influenceurs de la région. Cela comprend la formation des représentants commerciaux sur les techniques d’enquête sur le terrain et, le cas échéant, une assistance technique pour les demandes de renseignements sur les produits. Soutenant également les objectifs de vente par une interaction directe avec les ventes et indirecte en influençant les principaux clients externes de la région. Exécutant des activités estivales de création de demandes, y compris des essais chez les producteurs à grande échelle et des sites de démonstration dans la région. Il est chargé de fournir des données utiles pour atteindre les objectifs de vente et répondre aux questions sur l’utilisation des produits. Surveillant et en influençant positivement les principaux centres d’influence tels que les universités, les consultants, le personnel chargé de la vulgarisation provinciale et le commerce de détail agricole en établissant des relations et des contacts réguliers. Il fournit à ces centres d’influence des renseignements sur les produits, des mises à jour de la marque et des résultats techniques. Jouant un rôle clé dans le transfert des connaissances sur les nouveaux produits et les cultures vers d’autres régions de vente, en interagissant régulièrement avec les chefs de marque, les représentants des ventes au détail et des producteurs, les responsables de comptes stratégiques, les responsables du marketing technique, de la réglementation et de la biologie. Si vous avez... Un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en agriculture ou en biologie avec un accent sur la science des cultures, la malherbologie, l’agronomie, l’entomologie, la phytopathologie ou une discipline connexe est recommandé. Les candidats titulaires d’un baccalauréat en sciences et ayant un minimum de 5 ans d’expérience seront également pris en considération. Un professional agrologist, CCA ou CCSC (Certified Crop Adviser ou Certified Crop Science Consultant) avec au moins 2 ans d’expérience relative sur le terrain. Des compétences en développement et enlivraison de présentations aux clients externes et internes. Vous devez avoir d’excellentes compétences informatiques et maîtriser divers logiciels, notamment PowerPoint, Excel et Word. Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale est essentiel. Être efficace pour communiquer avec une grande variété de publics. Être capable d’établir des relations avec les principaux contacts influents sur les attributs techniques des produits et les problèmes agronomiques relatifs aux principales cultures de la région. Capacité à recommander le positionnement d’un produit en fonction de l’évaluation des données et des besoins des clients. Expérience de travail avec des représentants des ventes au détail et des producteurs, des universités ou des consultants serait un atout. Une capacité à fournir un leadership technique au sein de l’équipe de vente est un avantage. Posséder de solides compétences en organisation et en gestion du temps est essentiel. Le bilinguisme est considéré comme un atout. jobs.name: Senior Auditor (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME In the Coatings division, we offer far more than just paints and coatings. Our approach is to put the needs of our customers at the centre and always think one step ahead. Our motto ‘We always go beyond the surface’ makes it clear that we are not only focussed on the products themselves, but also on the reasons why we develop them. We are interested in creating innovative solutions that promote future growth and fulfil the requirements of the market. With our extensive knowledge and experience, we work to provide tailored coatings solutions that create real value and build strong partnerships. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT For our Internal Audit unit, we are looking for a committed and analytically minded Senior Auditor (m/f/d). In this role, you support the unit in enhancing and protecting the organization’s value by providing independent and objective audit services aimed at creating added value and improving organizational processes. In your role as Senior Auditor, you independently conduct risk-based audits at group companies globally. You analyze and assess business processes with regard to compliance, efficiency, and effectiveness. Moreover, you identify key risks and develop appropriate audit programs based on those risks. Furthermore, you document your work steps and audit results in a structured and transparent manner. You prepare audit results concisely and communicate them in a target-group-oriented way to senior management. Finally, you follow up on the implementation of agreed measures and contribute to the further development of internal audit methods and tools. WHAT YOU OFFER successfully completed university degree in business administration, economics, finance, accounting, or a comparable field several years of relevant professional experience, e.g., in internal audit, external audit, accounting, controlling, or risk management strong analytical skills as well as a structured and thorough working style high level of initiative, sense of responsibility, and professionalism strong communication skills and confident interaction across different management levels very good German and English skills; confident use of MS Office, SAP knowledge is an advantage WHAT WE OFFER We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage. We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. As a founding member of the Diversity Charter, BASF stands for diversity – we are proud of our Coatings employee networks WomenInCoatings, ColorPride@EC and CultiConnect. The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback. At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio “Freizeit” with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant “Auszeit” including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center “LackiKids” and a vacation program “LackiKids on Tour”. We have 30 vacation days/year (full-time), additional time off options and a 37.5-hour week. HOW TO REACH US Melissa Amina Rahmani (Talent Acquisition), melissa.rahmani@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005 58073, will be happy to answer any questions you may have about this position. You are also welcome to book an online meeting . You can also reach our recruiting team here . You can find initial information about our application process here . ABOUT US Learn more about our company here. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.name: Senior Officer, Order to Cash (Thai Speaker)
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position The primary function of this role is to provide efficient order management, manage interfaces with customers for order to cash processes and provide improvements to supply chain management. Effectively communicate and resolve order issues with customers and sales. Responsibility of placing replenishment purchase order to supply source and monitor the delivery schedule Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Manage Master Data maintenance process to ensure effective order management and the End-to-End order process by proactively collaborating with multiple functions. Capture market intelligence on the supply chain related topics from daily interaction with customers and share with the business as appropriate and be an integral part of business management. Contribute to development of customer relationships through proactive customer communication related to order management e.g. product availability, order status and delivery tracking. Support Credit Management, Billing and Accounts Receivable Follow-up. Issuing tax invoices for month end closing. Handle customer complaints in BASF’s available system (Non-Conformance Management, tNPS) and actively communicate status, investigation results, corrective actions to customers to ensure on time closure for non-product quality related complaints. Capture customer expectations / requirement and feedback to the business team. Ensure that all operations are carried out in compliant with business rules, internal standards, and local government regulations. Report any areas of concern immediately to Supply Chain Manager. Provide order status report and monitor customers’ order placement against sales forecast and Joint-customer call to customers in case of request by sales team as sales supporter. Job Requirements Bachelor degree in business administration or familiar areas Experience in customer service in an international company for more than 2 years or relevant work experience in SCM/sales/controlling Chemical industry background preferred Technical & Professional Knowledge Experience in using ERP systems such as SAP (at least intermediate level) Experience with data analytics or reporting systems (e.g. PowerBI) is a plus. Understanding of end-to-end OTC process Possess excellent communication, and interpersonal skills Good proficiency in Thai language and English Proactive, can work independently and in teams About BASF in Malaysia BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Head of Group Tax Compliance​ ​(m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems, connecting seeds and traits, crop protection, digital tools and sustainability approaches. We strive to deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions vision & mission ! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We in Agricultural Solutions are preparing to be an independent, pure-play agricultural company within BASF group. To be ready for independence, we are looking for you to join us in our new Corporate roles (see here: build your career on our Standalone Transformation ). In your new position, you are responsible for leading the German tax compliance function for direct and indirect taxes, including the timely and accurate preparation, review, and submission of all German tax filings and related reporting. You oversee tax payments, tax accounts, reconciliations and tax reporting interfaces into statutory and management reporting while owning and monitoring the German tax compliance calendar and all filing deadlines. Together with your colleagues and external partners, you steer and review work performed by internal teams, shared service centers and external advisors, collaborating closely with Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Legal and business stakeholders. You establish and maintain an effective German tax control framework, manage tax audits as well as authority requests and handle tax controversy matters with clear documentation and audit trails. There’s always room for improvement: You translate regulatory changes into operational requirements, drive automation and standardization initiatives, support transactions and reorganizations and communicate compliance status, risks and mitigation actions transparently to management. WHAT YOU OFFER completed university degree in tax, accounting, law, business administration or a comparable field, ideally combined with qualification as a Steuerberater several years of professional experience in German direct and indirect tax, preferably in a multinational corporate environment or a leading advisory firm strong technical expertise in German corporate income tax, trade tax, withholding tax, VAT and tax compliance processes including audits and authority interactions very good German and English language skills, along with solid experience working with ERP systems and tax technology solutions a hands-on, structured and detail-oriented working style combined with strong communication skills, stakeholder management capabilities and a pragmatic, solution-driven mindset WHAT WE OFFER A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. Inspiring networks for the development and implementation of your ideas (e.g. Women in Business) Career paths as professional development into other roles within the company. We actively support with childcare (e.g. company daycare, holiday programmes) and provide a fitness and health studio as well as a medical center with numerous offers for your health. We offer sustainable mobility benefits — a discounted Deutschlandticket for regional public transport, a job‑bike leasing program, and on‑site e‑charging stations for private electric vehicles to make your commute affordable, healthy, and climate‑friendly. HOW TO REACH US Lennart Boudgoust (Talent Acquisition), lennart.boudgoust@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-56521 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. jobs.description:
Consignment Manager Description A chemical structure is only as strong as the bonds between the molecules. At Surventis, the strength of the bonds lies not just in the chemicals but is also mirrored in the links forged between the global companies and employees of the Surventis world. We are a company with highly qualified talent, who give their contribution each and every day across the different sectors to make the Surventis difference. We demonstrate uncompromising ethics and appreciation for our employees, as well as respect for the environment. Surventis is a leading specialty chemical company whose quality, innovation, and service exceed the expectations of our customers. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. Overview: The primary function of the Consignment Manager is to work closely with the business leaders and Sales, Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain and suppliers to manage all consignment accounts for Surventis. Job Duties: Facilitate and oversee contract management processes for consignment accounts with support from Legal Implement and manage processes to collect, measure and track relevant metrics in order to assess contract compliance with key contract terms and conditions for all contracts, including product inventory tracking Develop and manage the contract renewal process evaluating account profitability Develop and manage the expiration notification process for all contracts Develop thorough knowledge and understanding of each contract; act as the single point of contact for all contract inquiries regarding terms and conditions, obligations, compliance, products, services, rights and deliverables for each contract Develop contract portfolio metrics, including key usage and profitability Assist in identification of reporting tools/solutions to automate contract management reporting and tracking Reconcile inventory between customer and SAP Perform inventory audit one per year Requirements: Ability to take ownership of and focus on critical initiatives Strong business acumen, organizational, planning, analytical, negotiation and conflict resolution skills Must have proven ability to gather, extract, organize, analyze, and interpret detailed data from a variety of sources Ability to take ownership of and focus on critical initiatives Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment with demonstrated project management skills Proven ability to collaborate with employees at all levels of an organization Team player with ability to learn quickly, multi-task, self-direct and appropriately prioritize workload Ability to communicate effectively, both in verbal and written communications Warehouse management experience preferred Bachelor’s degree in business or related majors Salary Range- $95,000-110,000 We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We zetten de klant centraal, denken een stap vooruit en ontwikkelen oplossingen die echte waarde en langdurige samenwerkingen creëren. We inspireren elkaar om dieper te denken, verantwoordelijkheid over ons werk en streven er voortdurend naar om het mogelijke te vergroten. Als je jezelf volledig meebrengt, de voor de hand liggende antwoorden uitdaagt en wil groeien met een team dat het meent — dan is dit jouw plek. Als Applicatie Specialist Commercial Vehicles ben je een sleutelpersoon in het ondersteunen van onze klanten op technisch vlak. Je combineert praktijkervaring met commerciële feeling en helpt mee om onze producten en processen succesvol te implementeren en te optimaliseren bij klanten. Je werkt nauw samen met het sales team en draagt actief bij aan klanttevredenheid en business groei. Je bent Nederlandstalig en hebt een goede kennis van het Engels. Je hebt ervaring in het voorbereiden en spuiten van zwaar vervoer (Commercial Vehicles) - ervaring met personenwagens is een extra troef. Je beschikt over basis kleurkennis. Je hebt een basiskennis van MS Office. Je hebt een commerciële mindset en denkt klantgericht. Je hebt een positieve ingesteldheid en bent een echte teamplayer. Je bent flexibel en hebt geen typische 9-to-5 mentaliteit. Je bent bereid om sporadisch te reizen met overnachting. Wat bieden wij jou? Een uitdagende en afwisselende functie binnen een internationale organisatie De kans om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen via interne en externe opleidingen Een dynamische werkomgeving met sterke teamgeest Een competitief salarispakket met aantrekkelijke extralegale voordelen Diversiteit is onze grootste kracht! Maak deel uit van onze succesformule en ontwikkel samen met ons de toekomst -- in een wereldwijd team dat inclusiviteit en gelijke kansen omarmt, ongeacht geslacht, leeftijd, afkomst, seksuele geaardheid, handicap of geloof. jobs.description:
About The Role Our EC/ES Product Stewardship APAC unit plays a crucial role in ensuring compliance with national and international chemical legislation. As the first point of contact for Product Stewardship topics, we actively engage with stakeholders, monitor regulatory developments, and promote responsible chemical management throughout the lifecycle of our products. How You Will Do It • You are together with the Chemical Regulations Manager the primary contact for ECs business units for Asian chemical regulations. This helps us to ensure compliance with the legal regulations for EC operations (ECO, ECR, ECT) for finished products in APAC. • Conducting hazard assessments and risk evaluations of our products from a chemical and regulatory perspective is another important task for you. Sc), preferably in chemistry. • Regulatory affairs experience, specifically in Asian Pacific chemical regulations. • Well-versed in IT applications, with at least 3 years working experience in SAP EHS system in product safety or chemical legislation area, coatings, fine chemical industrial relevant experience preferred. • High level of commitment and teamwork skills, flexibility, customer orientation, as well as independent and structured work approach. • Clear and authentic communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization, translate regulatory/technical information clearly. • Entrepreneurial thinking, pragmatism, and hands-on mentality. jobs.name: Supplier Quality Engineer
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. About The Role Ensure all QM rules in accordance with ISO9001 / IATF16949 / ISO14001 / ISO 45001 / VDA / AIAG procedures Address and resolve quality issues, providing technical input and guidance on process enhancements and improvements at suppliers Drive pro-active QM mindset in BU How You Will Do It Cooperate with Sales and Engineer team on product development and jointly define process parameters and criteria to ensure supplier process capability is effective to meet product and process requirements (Focus on critical products, critical processes or critical suppliers) Work with global team to improve Supplier Quality Management system Drive “Quality Assurance Agreements” (QSV) with Suppliers and execute accordingly Supplier evaluation is based on historical performance together with purchasing and release score to supplier regularly. Supplier audit, including potential supplier audit, annual audit, product and process audit and assess their practices and procedures and identify areas for improvement Take responsibility for the overall quality activities concerning quality assurance of purchased parts, monitor supplier performance, validate supplier 8D report and collect failure cost to support procurement for compensation Project supplier nomination procedure engagement based on supplier quality and capacity assessment. Check and approve product drawing and release to supplier Project APQP support for supplier part, regarding OTS and PPAP work, project audit for supplier. Support on supplier development based on customer and business requirements. Apply quality tools e.g. Cp/Cpk, SPC, R&R, 8D to analyze and improve supplier quality performance Supplier changes are managed and approved based on quality, cost savings, and customer requirements. Cooperate with the other QM functions to improve customer satisfaction Work together with delegated procurement to transfer customer CSR to supplier. Assist in maintaining Quality Management (QM) documents in accordance with ISO 9001-2015 and IATF 16949-2016 standards. This involves ensuring compliance with the quality management system by keeping all necessary documentation and records up to date and accurate. QMS Audit Records: Maintain comprehensive records of both external and internal quality management system audits to demonstrate compliance and facilitate continuous improvement. Assist in compiling customer-specific QMS requirements, including supporting the implementation and maintenance of customer special Quality status related requirements. Participate in Manufacturing Site Assessment audits, monitor and maintain periodic customer audit scores, and fulfill other customer-specific quality requirements. Oversee compliance with the Supplier Quality Assurance Manual. What We Look For Bachelor or above on Mechanical or Production Engineering. At least 6 years of experience in quality functions, including supplier quality and project quality with automotive sector. Certificated auditor for IATF16949, VDA 6.3, VDA6.5 or equivalent knowledge. Familiar with quality tools such as APQP, PPAP, 8D, 5why, SPC, FMEAs, etc. Knowledge of injection molding processes, Casting, Machining, and GD&T is preferred. Ability to work under pressure. Good skills in communication and negotiation. Flexible on business trip Work Location Godrej One - Mumbai

In deiner neuen Position betreust du den Governance-Rahmen für die konzerninternen Verrechnungspreise (Intercompany Transfer Pricing, ICTP) von AP und stellst die einheitliche Anwendung der Richtlinien in allen relevanten Gesellschaften sicher. Du unterstützt die Auswahl, Implementierung und das tägliche Management von IT-Systemen und Tools im Bereich Transfer Pricing und sorgst dabei für Datenintegrität sowie die Automatisierung von Prozessen. Desweiteren überwachst du die ICTP-Ergebnisse, identifizierst Abweichungen und koordinierst Korrekturmaßnahmen gemeinsam mit dem Controlling und weiteren wichtigen Stakeholdern. Darüber hinaus unterstützt du Transfer-Pricing-Betriebsprüfungen, indem du Prüfungsanfragen koordinierst, Antworten vorbereitest und eine konsistente Nachverfolgung der Prüfungsergebnisse sicherstellst. Gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen koordinierst du die Erstellung und Abstimmung von Master Files und Local Files mit den operativen Steuerberater:innen und stellst eine fristgerechte sowie prüfungssichere Dokumentation sicher. jobs.name: Assistant Manager, Insurance Asia Pacific
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group's success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability - the economy, environment and society - into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About the Role Working under the team of Corporate Insurance Asia Pacific , you will: Implement global insurance strategy, mainly on employee benefits with property and casualty insurance in Asia Pacific by working closely with internal stakeholders, country insurance gatekeepers, insurance companies, brokers, insurance related vendors and business partners Provide functional guidance to country insurance gatekeepers and HR How You Will Do It Implement the global employee benefits insurance strategy across Asia Pacific by brokers and insurance companies. Oversee local ancillary insurance lines and related policies within the Asia Pacific region. Gather relevant risk information and insurance data from local countries to ensure it follows BASF insurance guidelines. Maintain the accuracy of internal insurance data systems by updating and verifying information from Asian countries. Review local fronting insurance policies in Asia Pacific to ensure it follows BASF global insurance strategy Manage insurance-related aspects of BASF investment projects within the Asia Pacific region. Coordinate insurance placements with business partners throughout Asia to facilitate effective coverage. Monitor the claims process and collaborate with internal business units and functions, as well as insurance brokers and companies, to ensure efficient handling of claims. Serve as the primary liaison with internal stakeholders, business partners, insurance companies, and brokers to support the implementation of BASF’s Global Insurance Strategy in Asia Pacific. What We Look For A university degree is required, preferably in risk management, insurance, business administration, finance, or legal studies. Candidates must have at least five years of experience in the insurance industry. Experience should include exposure to Employee Benefits insurance, gained from working with an insurance company, captive, broker, or the insurance department of an industrial enterprise. Professional certifications such as FLMI, ACII, ANZIIF, or an equivalent qualification are preferred. Fluency in English is required, and proficiency in other Asian languages is an advantage. Strong communication skills are essential to effectively network and collaborate within large and intercultural teams. The candidate should be willing to travel within the region when necessary BASF has a rich history in Hong Kong, dating back to the 1880s when it began selling textile dyes in the region. Over the years, the company has grown and expanded its presence, establishing its East Asia Regional Headquarters in Hong Kong in 1995. As a multinational company with a long-standing presence in Hong Kong, BASF is committed to the city's continued success as an internationally competitive business and financial center. By the end of 2025, BASF East Asia Regional Headquarters Limited had 240 employees.

jobs.name: Digital Architecture & Design (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We are looking for a Unified Communications Consultant with deep expertise in Cisco Collaboration platforms and enterprise grade Contact Center technologies. This role focuses on steering the UC architecture, defining design standards, documenting complex environments, and ensuring technical alignment across global regions and platforms. The ideal candidate brings a strong architectural mindset: ✔ designs solutions, ✔ validates and governs implementations, ✔ ensures interoperability, ✔ and documents the complete UC ecosystem following enterprise architecture principles. UC Architecture & Strategy Define the end-to-end UC architecture covering CUCM, Unity Connection, CUBE, SIP infrastructure, UCCE, and Webex CC. Drive the UC roadmap aligned with business transformation and cloud migration strategies. Own the dial plan architecture, intercluster routing, numbering plan normalization, and cross regional governance. Lead design decisions for resiliency, HA, clustering, security, and SIP interoperability. Design & Documentation Ownership Produce and maintain HLDs (High-level Designs) and LLDs (Low-level Designs) for UC & Contact Center environments. Document SIP call flows, integrations, trunking models, SBC logic, failover behavior, and overall service dependencies. Ensure alignment with existing design frameworks (SME/ILS, Webex CC routing logic, SBC universal call flow models). Maintain architecture landscapes including CUCM clusters, Unity clusters, voice gateways, SBCs, UCCE components, and Webex CC tenants. Steering & Governance Act as architectural authority for all UC projects, changes, and new deployments. Review engineering designs and ensure consistency with standards and blueprint models. Collaborate with architects, network teams, security, and vendors to ensure integrated design governance. Evaluate new technologies, versions, and upgrade paths (e.g., CUCM, UCCE, Webex CC platform evolution). SIP, CUBE & Interoperability Leadership Define SIP standards, normalization rules, routing logic, and QoS models. Architect CUBE deployments (centralized, distributed, or hybrid) and enforce SBC governance patterns. Specify security requirements, transport settings, encryption models, and interworking design guidelines. Contact Center Architecture (UCCE, Webex CC) Architect integrations between CUCM, CUBE, UCCE, and Webex CC using standardized SIP SBC frameworks. Provide guidance for queueing strategy, routing logic, skill mappings, hours of operations, failovers, and cloud interconnectivity. Technical Leadership Steer engineering teams by providing architectural guidance, design reviews, and implementation oversight. Act as the escalation point for complex design related issues. Ensure documentation, configuration standards, and architectural decisions are respected across regions. REQUIREMENTS OF THE POSITION 10+ years with Cisco Collaboration technologies in enterprise environments. Architecture level expertise with: Cisco CUCM, Unity Connection Cisco CUBE / SBCs SIP protocol (advanced signaling, interoperability, normalization, routing logic) Cisco UCCE/PCCE, CVP, Finesse Webex Contact Center and Webex Control Hub Strong experience analyzing HLD/LLD, design patterns, governance frameworks, and technical standards. Deep understanding of clustering, HA, SRST, multi‑site architectures, QoS, and WAN dependencies. Ability to validate, challenge, and improve designs from engineering teams or vendors. Experience with large‑scale migrations, PSTN transformations, SIP consolidations, or cloud CC adoption. Preferred Certifications CCNP Collaboration ITIL Foundation (for alignment with change/governance processes) Soft Skills Exceptional documentation and understanding skills (HLD/LLD, diagrams, design decisions). Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non‑technical stakeholders. Strategic mindset with focus on standardization, simplification, and long‑term scalability. WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided SALARY RANGE Competitive salary between €60,000 and €70,000 gross per year, depending on experience and fit for the role. At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines. We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance. We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities. HOW TO REACH US If you're interested in the position or know someone who might be and need support on how to take next steps, please send an email to felipe.bianco@partners.basf.com

jobs.name: Graduate Program Start IN Finance & Controlling with focus Finance (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At Corporate Finance@BASF, we do not just focus on figures, but solutions. Our approach is strategic and innovative, we get things done. Doing so, the needs of our business partners are priority and we have the finger on the pulse when it comes to sustainability and digitalization. Topics such as evaluation of mergers & acquisitions and major investments, financing, the preparation of published statements, the management of financial risks and advising the board of directors on economic decisions are all part of our daily job. In collaboration with our globally networked communities, we continuously develop and enhance our processes. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT With our 18-month trainee program, you will gain a comprehensive insight into the various fields of activity in the areas of finance and controlling. From the very beginning, you will work on your own projects in which you can advance topics in the field of finance or controlling. Your three assignment stations of six months each as well as your later target function will be individually coordinated with you. In doing so, we consider your wishes and strengths. In each assignment station, you will familiarize yourself with the corresponding topic area, such as financing or mergers & acquisitions. After a short time, you will take responsibility for exciting projects or initiate them yourself. You will always have a professional contact person at your side. During the entire time of the trainee program, you will receive mentoring that will strengthen you in your professional and personal development. An assignment abroad allows you to get to know a new culture and gain insights into other ways of working. In this way, you will further develop your intercultural competence and expand your global network at the same time. Here, too, we will coordinate the location individually with you. The trainee program prepares you optimally for a career in the field of finance and controlling. After completing the program, you will have a wide range of career opportunities within the company. By working closely with various stakeholders, taking on responsible projects and being in contact with senior management, trainees and alumni, you will build a strong network. In doing so, you will lay the foundation for a successful professional future at BASF. WHAT YOU OFFER We are looking for committed university graduates who set themselves goals and want to leave their comfort zone. We require the following minimum requirements: • Degree in the field of business/economics (Master, PhD, MBA) • At least 3-month internship in Finance and/or Controlling • At least 3 months abroad (in the form of study semesters or internships abroad) A maximum of three years’ work experience. • Fluency in English is a must, German language skills are a plus Additional requirements: • Ability to work in a team: You enjoy working in a team and can quickly integrate into new groups. • Strong communication skills: You can convey complex issues in an understandable and precise way. • Analytical thinking: You have the ability to systematically analyze problems and develop solutions. • Initiative: You proactively show commitment and contribute your own ideas. ABOUT US BASF SE, located in Ludwigshafen am Rhein, is the corporate headquarters of the BASF Group and part of the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region. BASF stands for competence in chemistry since 1865 and is represented today in the world's major consumer markets, with a wide range of products. Leisure, sports, culture and a good infrastructure characterize the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region, in which BASF is also involved with numerous activities. jobs.name: Global Bulk Parcel Operations, Manager
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Objectives of the Position This position will assist bulk parcel operation team lead to perform, execute and facilitate all chartering operation activities  in handling bulk transportation of BASF group of companies’ products by chemical tankers in Asia Pacific region in a way that is cost efficient and in compliance to all the rules, regulations and standards set by BASF as well as the industry. High standard services aim for on-time delivery, cost efficient, seamless operation, compliance, and safety are key objectives of this position. Responsibilities Execute contract of affreightment (COA) and Spot chartering activities, including cargo demand consolidation, demand planning, vessel nomination, cargo nomination and fixture execution in accordance with the applicable charter party clauses. Develop and optimize shipment strategies through cargo bunding and efficient allocation of COA volumes to maximize cost efficiency. Identify suitable vessels by evaluating technical and commercial fit-for-purpose criteria such as vessel space, laycan, tank coating, last three cargo, ship vetting status and jetty acceptance. Work closely with all relevant stakeholders covering shipowners, brokers, shippers, receivers, terminals, and related BASF entities in ensure seamless bulk parcel shipping charactering operations and where necessary lead the coordination of issue resolution where required. Manage critical issues and claims with brokers/ shipowners and affected internal & external business partners, escalate issues further if required and ensure that effective measures are implemented timely to improve customer satisfaction. Monitor and review performance of shipowners to develop KPIs with the objective of having continuous improvement of the operations. jobs.name: Nematologist Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. Come join us on our journey to create solutions for sustainable agriculture at the Innovation Center of BASF Belgium Coordination Center CommV in Ghent, Belgium. We are seeking people who thrive in a culture of creativity, openness, responsibility, and entrepreneurial spirit. In our organization, we encourage and celebrate innovative thinking, where ideas flow freely and are nurtured. We value individuals who take ownership of their work and are accountable for their actions. We foster an entrepreneurial mindset, where taking calculated risks and seizing opportunities are encouraged to drive growth and success. Join our team and be part of an environment that values and rewards creative thinking, collaboration, and a can-do attitude. Within BASF Seed and Traits R&D, Trait Research we focus on the design, creation and testing of candidate leads as gene-based solutions for herbicide tolerance, pest and disease control in key crops including soybean, oilseed rape, wheat and cotton. We are currently seeking a talented, motivated, and inspiring Nematologist to join our Trait Research team at the R&D Innovation Center in Ghent, Belgium. In this role, you will develop and execute research strategies aligned with business goals to successfully commercialize innovative nematode resistant traits and germplasm. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT You propose innovative nematode trait concepts and develop and implement nematode control research strategies using state-of-the-art know-how and technologies including suitable third-party collaborations to ascertain scientific competitiveness of the nematode program. You evaluate scientific progress of nematode control programs with the project leader and with support of team members (technicians and scientists in the lab and GH) and take decisions to ensure the achievement of scientific objectives and critical milestones with optimal use of available resources. You design and oversee the execution of nematode control assays to support program goals. You articulate a clear, innovative and competitive testing scheme to meet these goals and to ensure the efficient delivery of high-quality nematode traits. You proactively report on your scientific progress and new opportunities to all relevant stakeholders as requested. You develop the innovative ability and competence of research teams, and you act as a mentor and give scientific guidance across the organization. You support the program leader to ensure strategy competitiveness by working closely with Intellectual Property colleagues to build a proactive patenting (and, if needed, licensing-) strategy and ensure a competitor IP analysis in the program field. WHAT YOU OFFER You hold a PhD in Nematology with 12-15 years of relevant experience or equivalent. You are internationally acknowledged as a consistent innovator and leading authority in the field of Plant Nematology and have a profound knowledge of GM trait development. You provide innovative solutions for plant parasitic nematode issues and demonstrate knowledge and expertise from working directly with plant parasitic nematodes. You are familiar with crop business strategies and the principles of value creation for growers. You understand the connection between the lab and the field. You have a track record of providing scientific leadership for internal and external program work packages, effectively managing collaborations with partners, and excel in developing innovative research proposals that incorporate novel technology platforms to advance plant parasitic nematode control project objectives. You possess leadership and team coaching skills, motivating and inspiring others, while fostering collaboration in diverse environments through a multi-cultural mindset. You demonstrate proactivity, with well-developed communication skills that enable effective interactions with stakeholders. You build a culture of innovation by creating an environment that supports creativity and by coaching and developing people. You are fluent in English. WHAT WE OFFER A permanent contract within an attractive working environment in a professional and motivated team. Interesting and challenging learning and development opportunities to help you make the most of your talents and your job. An attractive base salary in relation to your diploma and competencies, an annual bonus and extra-legal benefits. HOW TO REACH US If you need more information about the process or the vacancy, you can reach our recruiting team here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.description:
Now hiring! Maintenance Planner Greenville, OH (On-site) If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. We are seeking a professional like you to join our team.  In this role, you will be responsible for planning and scheduling of maintenance, repair, and construction work to ensure 24/7 operation of the chemical manufacturing process. This position will also serve as a backup to the maintenance supervisor at various times throughout the year. Your day-to-day: Troubleshooting operations problems, order repair parts, manage the work order backlog, perform long-range and short-term planning of in-house and contractor labor, as well as cost estimating. Ensuring we have all critical spare parts and materials in inventory, and to ensure that expedited repairs are executed as efficiently as possible. Demonstrating the competency of continuous improvement, you will analyze cost trends, use the techniques of Total Productive Maintenance, track key performance indicators, and maintain equipment histories.  The result will be equipment reliability that allows the production department to meet its goals. Coordinating with the procurement department, in-house and contractor labor, suppliers and technical representatives, and the plant production groups. Using SAP for all the maintenance work order and procurement processes as well as maintaining critical SAP data such as functional locations, material masters, and maintenance plans.  The Microsoft Office suite, including MS Project, is also a key tool for e-mails, databases, and reporting. Planning and scheduling the annual turnarounds of the various production plants. You will also use these skills to coordinate all resources from repair parts to contract labor to rental equipment. Expertise needed includes: High School Diploma/GED required; advanced degree preferred. Experience with chemical plant production equipment highly preferred. At least 3+ years related expertise using SAP PM and MM. In depth knowledge of maintenance systems and equipment, planning, and scheduling. Are able to read piping & instrumentation diagrams, engineering specifications, engineering drawings, wiring diagrams, loop diagrams, and vendor-supplied technical information. SAP knowledge and understanding required.  MSProject, and Avetta software preferred. Understand multiple crafts (mechanical, I/E, scaffolding, rigging, excavation) preferred. Possess a good working knowledge of all crafts and a solid understanding of MPI. Deal effectively with the unknown and unexpected and possess the ability to handle non-routine and emergency activities, such as schedule breakers, plant shutdowns, start-up, commissioning, etc. Privacy statement Surventis takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. jobs.name: Deputy Manager, Technical Sales- PU Footwear
jobs.description: About BASF in Vietnam BASF has been active in Vietnam since the establishment of its representative office in 1994 and celebrates its 30-year presence in the country this year. BASF Vietnam Limited was set up in 2009. The company maintains two sales offices in Hồ Chí Minh City and Hà Nội, offering solutions for Vietnam’s key industries, including Agriculture, Construction, Automotive, Footwear, Paints & Coatings and Electrical & Electronics. BASF’s sales to customers in Vietnam were approximately €238 million in 2023. BASF employed 110 people in Vietnam as of the end of the year. Further information on BASF in Vietnam is available at www.basf.com/vn . Objectives of the Position This role serves as the sales or local key account manager responsible for implementing the Value Chain hunting strategy, engaging with the VN team to identify potential polyurethane (PU) Footwear projects and secure new approvals. It involves establishing relationships with key shoe factories including Taiwanese, Korean and Chinese transplants (TTT/KTT/CTT) and acting as the local contact in VN to drive the PU business growth alongside the global and regional PU key account team. Manage existing sales and develop new business opportunities in the Footwear segments of the Polyurethane (PU) business in Vietnam. Develop & execute sales activities to achieve mid/long-term targets in alignment with SBU strategy. Provides preliminary technical support, troubleshooting, and identify new application for existing product lines for both existing and new customers. MAIN AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITIES AND KEY ACTIVITIES Business/Sales Development: Contribute to profitable growth of Footwear PU business in Vietnam via direct account management Develop sales strategy in alignment with business direction and actively hunt new customers Plan, organize and manage sales activities related to Footwear segments Promote new products and applications to existing or potential customers, drive new business acquisition Organize events (Seminar/Tech Day/Workshop) for strategic customers to gain business opportunities. Define & implement local pricing strategy to reach optimal profitability. Establish relationships with key stakeholders of strategic customers. Ensure customers’ credit management is aligned to company's guidelines and risk management. Organise visits from RBU colleagues to drive business growth. Provide ad hoc and regular management reporting timely. Drive commercialization of projects and document through Sales Force. Support customers’ sustainability initiatives with our portfolio of solutions. Market and Competitor Intelligence: Have in-depth understanding of footwear market and customer needs, industry drivers, unique selling points to recommend the best solution(s), leading to the achievement of value creation for the customers and BASF. Identify and develop new market potential for new applications across product portfolio in coordination with RBU. Conduct studies on market dynamics, industry trends, competitors, products, applications, and technology. Establish database for target market segment, customer, and applications. Technical service: Provide preliminary troubleshooting to support customer, while escalating to Technical Development (TD) team any persisting or more complicated technical issues. Follow-up business development of new customers, applications and relevant processing technologies. Provide necessary technical training/workshop/exchange with customer along with Technical Development team. Job Requirement Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering/Science/Chemical/Chemistry/Materials/Polymer Min 5 years as Technical Sales or Technical Service preferably in the PU and chemical industries. Chinese speaking is required. In depth knowledge of PU products and applications Understanding of key industries (e.g. footwear)

jobs.name: Regional Data & AI Engineer, Operations, Asia Pacific
jobs.description:
About the Role Regional Data & AI Engineer builds and advances a scalable data and AI backbone for smart manufacturing across Asia sites within Coatings business unit. It combines the development of a standardized production data architecture across sites with the ability to translate data into business value through advanced analytics, AI-ML, and agentic AI solutions. The role ensures that production data is consistently leveraged to improve performance, enable better decisions, and drive continuous optimization across the regional manufacturing network. How You Will Do It Production Data Architecture Define and implement the target architecture for the capture, integration, and provision of production and process data across multiple sites, ensuring scalability and alignment with global standards. IT/OT Integration Develop and implement standards and concepts for the integration of production-relevant data sources, including sensors, PLC, SCADA, historian, MES, LIMS, quality, and ERP systems, with a focus on data quality, availability, and cybersecurity. Data Modeling, Analytics and AI Enablement Design and structure production data models to support reporting, root cause analysis, process optimization, as well as advanced analytics and AI applications, establishing the foundation for scalable data products. Technical Leadership and Consulting Provide technical guidance and advisory support to business functions, production sites, and project teams; translate business requirements into robust architectural solutions and support the implementation of data-driven and AI-enabled initiatives. Standards and Governance Establish and maintain regional standards for data models, interfaces, documentation, and governance to ensure consistency, traceability, compliance, and reusability across the organization. Global Collaboration and Continuous Development Collaborate within an international network of sites, experts, and stakeholders; contribute to and drive global roadmaps; continuously advance the production data architecture in line with business and technology developments. AI and Agentic AI Solution Development Drive the design, development, and industrialization of AI-ML based and agentic AI-based solutions tailored to manufacturing operations, including predictive analytics, intelligent process control, and decision-support systems. External Innovation and Partnerships Identify, evaluate, and manage partnerships with external vendors, startups, and technology providers to incorporate advanced, manufacturing-specific AI and digital solutions into the operational ecosystem. What We Look For Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, Data Science / Artificial Intelligence or a comparable scientific or technical field. Working Experience: Min. 5 years of professional experience in data architecture, data integration, industrial data platforms or advanced analytics, ideally in a global production-related environment. Experience in designing scalable data architectures and a good understanding of data quality, governance, information security and standardization. Technical & Professional Knowledge / Others: Strong understanding of production processes and industrial system landscapes as well as solid knowledge of integrating IT and OT systems and relevant standards such as ISA-95, OPC or MQTT. Strong knowledge of data processing, data modeling and data analysis as well as technologies such as Python, SQL, ETL/ELT concepts and modern data platforms. Knowledge of Databricks platform, Agentic AI, Machine Learning techniques, including decision tree learning, clustering, artificial neural networks, etc., and their pros and cons. Strong communication and facilitation skills, confidence in working with global stakeholders, a strong team orientation, as well as a high degree of initiative and structuring capability. Very good written and spoken Chinese and English skills. jobs.name: Assistant Manager - Sales and Sub-Regional Accounts
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Objectives Accountable for achieving key financial performance indicators (KPIs), including Net Sales and cCM1, for distributors across the sub-region and designated accounts, with primary focus on Thailand, Singapore, and Malaysia. Build, expand, and develop direct key accounts and distributor relationships to optimize and strengthen the distribution network, ensuring effective and efficient distributor management. Maintaining up-to-date customer data and account plans and providing accurate sales forecasts to support effective planning. Develop project pipeline with customers partnering with marketing and technical team to achieve future business growth. Main responsibilities Sustainably achieve sales targets encompassing ccM1, volume & sales, costs, working capital and other business targets such as delivery reliability and customer satisfaction. Be accountable and responsible for pricing execution and financials for the assigned accounts. Respond to customer inquiries, provide timely support on quality and technical matters, perform customer assessments and analysis, and collaborate with regional functions to resolve customer issues. Analyze market trends, competitors, product applications, and service needs; execute sales and marketing plans for target customers in alignment with the market development team and collaborate closely with regional marketing on promotional activities and customer projects. BASF in Thailand was established in 1966 and maintains its head office in Bangkok.
