jobs.description: Now hiring! Group Lead, US Tax - Ag Solutions We are looking for a Group Lead US Tax to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Research Triangle Park, NC. Come create chemistry with us! We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems, connecting seeds and traits, crop protection, digital tools and sustainability approaches. We strive to deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth In this role, you will lead the U.S. Tax function for Agricultural Solutions, with full accountability for U.S. direct and indirect tax matters in a complex, multi-national environment. We in Agricultural Solutions are preparing to be an independent, pure-play agricultural company within the BASF Group. To be ready for independence, we are looking for you to join us in our new Corporate roles (see here: Build your career on our Standalone Transformation ). As a Group Lead, US Tax - Ag Solutions, you create chemistry by... Leading the timely and accurate preparation, review, and submission of all U.S. federal, state, and local tax filings, including corporate income tax and indirect taxes. Overseeing tax accounting, tax payments, and reporting processes, ensuring alignment with statutory and management reporting. Owning and managing the U.S. tax compliance calendar, ensuring deadlines are met with strong controls and governance. Leading and developing the U.S. tax organization, driving performance, capability building, and a high standard of execution. Acting as the primary advisor to senior leadership on U.S. tax matters, providing clear guidance on risks, opportunities, and compliance requirements. Establishing and maintaining a robust tax control framework, ensuring audit readiness and leading all tax audits and authority interactions. Partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Legal, and business leaders, as well as global tax teams and external advisors. Supporting key business activities including transactions, restructurings, and strategic initiatives with clear and practical tax guidance. Driving continuous improvement through standardization, automation, and use of tax technology. If you... Have a Master’s degree in Tax, Accounting, Finance, Law, or a related field, with a CPA or equivalent professional certification required. Bring 10–15 years of progressive experience in U.S. corporate taxation, within a multinational corporation and/or leading advisory firm. Have proven experience in a senior tax leadership role with responsibility for U.S. tax operations in a complex organization. Demonstrate deep expertise in U.S. corporate income tax, state and local tax, indirect taxes, and tax accounting. Lead and develop high-performing teams through demonstrated people leadership experience. Work effectively in a global, matrixed environment while partnering across functions and geographies. jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. You ensure high-quality real estate data management, maintain accurate reporting and portfolio documentation, monitor relevant KPIs, and contribute to compliance with internal governance standards. A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. Career paths as professional development into other roles within the company. We actively support with childcare (e.g. company daycare, holiday programmes) and provide a fitness and health studio as well as a medical center with numerous offers for your health. We offer sustainable mobility benefits — a discounted Deutschlandticket for regional public transport, a job‑bike leasing program, and on‑site e‑charging stations for private electric vehicles to make your commute affordable, healthy, and climate‑friendly. jobs.name: Auditor, Corporate Audit
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. About The Role Why does this position exist?  With what permanent objectives? Corporate Audit supports the BASF Board of Executive Directors in its responsibility to perform supervisory, steering and control activities. It is an integral part of BASF’s internal control and risk management system. It has teams spread over 3 continents of the globe. This position will be a part of the Asia-Pacific hub of the global Corporate Audit function. How Will You Do It We are seeking for an experienced Internal Auditor who possesses strong set of internal audit skills including resilience and agility, business acumen, and critical thinking to join our team. Your role will involve conducting audits with a resilient and agile approach to assess the effectiveness of our organization's risk management, control, and governance processes and recommend improvements. You will also be responsible for conducting audits of our organization's financial and operational processes to identify areas for improvement and provide recommendations to enhance efficiency and effectiveness of the process. It is also expected that you actively collaborate with Global experts (Domain Owners/ SPOCs) as regional subject matter expert for specific audit topic/ risk aspect. Main Task : Execute the internal audit plan in accordance with established audit standards and procedures. Evaluate the effectiveness of the organization's risk management, control, and governance processes. Conduct audits of the organization's financial and operational processes to identify areas for improvement. Provide value adding recommendations to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance with policies and procedures. Communicate audit observation and recommendations to management and other stakeholders. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate and engage with stakeholders at all levels. Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and provide guidance as needed. Stay up to date with changes in laws, regulations, and industry best practices. Maintain integrity and ethical behaviour, conduct unbiased audits, ensuring transparency, compliance, confidentiality, professionalism, and teamwork mindset in the role. What We Look For Education: Chartered Accountant, Chemical Engineer, or Data Scientist. Preferable Candidate should have Professional Certifications such as: required CIA (Certified Internal Audit) – or work in progress, optional CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CISA (Certified Information System Audit) Working Experience 4 – 7 Years experience. Preferably worked on international assignments and working in diverse cultures of team members. Exposure to industries that are manufacturing based preferably chemical companies. Travel Requirement Travel requirement would be ~30%. Approx. 6 to 7 audits per annum with fieldwork for each audit ~3 to 4 weeks. Depending on the audit scope, a site fieldwork, may require travel between 1 - 3 weeks. Orther Proven experience in internal auditing, demonstrating resilience, agility, and critical thinking. Strong understanding of business dynamics that comes with complex organization, financial principles, and internal control frameworks. You will need to possess the aptitude to understand the intricacies of business dynamics, enabling you to provide valuable insights that strengthen the organization's management processes. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks and propose effective solutions. Ability to embracing technology and data analytics. With the increasing volume of data and the complexity of business operations, you will leverage data analytics tools to enhance audit efficiency and effectiveness. Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Work Location Godrej One - Vikroli (Mumbai)

jobs.name: Senior Executive, Import Export OVM Malaysia
jobs.description: O bjectives of the Position Own and drive end-to-end Import & Export operations execution for Malaysia, ensuring seamless coordination across all stakeholders. Lead Operational Vendor Management (OVM) for 4PL and 3PL, ensuring delivery of agreed service levels, KPI performance, and operational excellence. Ensure strict governance and enforcement of SOPs, maintaining high discipline in execution by service providers. Provide strong operational control, visibility, and proactive risk management to ensure uninterrupted shipment flow. Drive performance improvement, operational efficiency, and service provider accountability in line with business expectations M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities End-to-End Import & Export Operations Ownership Take full accountability for execution and coordination of all import and export shipments for Malaysia operations. Act as the central control tower managing shipment flows across 4PL, 3PL, and internal stakeholders. Ensure timely and accurate execution of all shipment activities in line with agreed delivery timelines. Proactively monitor shipment status and anticipate risks, delays, and bottlenecks, ensuring early intervention. Ensure high level of operational discipline, tracking, and follow-through across all shipments. Operational Vendor Management (4PL / 3PL Governance) Lead governance and oversight of 4PL and 3PL service providers, ensuring adherence to BASF operational standards. Drive vendor accountability for execution quality, responsiveness, and service performance. Ensure all vendors operate strictly with agreed SOPs, processes, and performance expectations. Act as escalation point for operational issues and performance gaps, ensuring timely resolution. Lead alignment with vendors on process changes, service expectations, and continuous improvement initiatives. 3. KPI Management & Performance Control Own and drive end-to-end KPI monitoring and performance tracking for all IE operations. Ensure timely, accurate, and complete submission of KPIs and operational reports from 4PL and 3PL. Validate data integrity and ensure consistent reporting standards across stakeholders. Analyze performance trends and identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities. Lead performance review discussions with service providers and ensure closure of performance gaps. 4. Reporting, Visibility & Management Updates Ensure strong operational visibility across all shipments and performance metrics. Consolidate and deliver clear, structured, and management-ready reports (weekly/monthly). Provide insight-driven updates, highlighting key risks, issues, and mitigation actions. Establish and maintain transparent reporting frameworks and dashboards for operational tracking. 5. Issue Management, Escalation & Risk Control Take ownership of critical operational issues and disruptions, ensuring coordinated resolution. Drive structured root cause analysis and corrective action implementation with 4PL/3PL. Escalate major risks and issues to management with clear impact assessment and mitigation plans. Maintain robust tracking of issues, actions, and resolution effectiveness. 6. SOP Compliance & Operational Governance Enforce strict adherence to BASF SOPs and operational frameworks across all service providers. Perform regular monitoring to ensure process discipline and consistency in execution. Identify gaps in SOP adherence and drive corrective actions with vendors. Support continuous improvement and refinement of SOPs and operational governance frameworks. 7. Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence Identify and drive process improvements to enhance efficiency, reliability, and execution quality. Lead initiatives to reduce operational delays, errors, and rework across the shipment lifecycle. Promote best practices, standardization, and process optimization. Support digitalization and automation initiatives to improve operational visibility and reporting efficiency. Requirements Education: Min Diploman in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Management, or related field Minimum 3–5 years of experience in: Import & Export operations Logistics coordination and end-to-end shipment execution 4PL / 3PL vendor management Proven experience in: Managing complex operational environments with multiple stakeholders Driving performance management and service provider accountability Strong expertise in: End-to-end Import & Export operations Logistics execution and coordination Vendor management and performance governance Strong capability in: Operational control and execution management KPI tracking, reporting, and performance analysis Issue resolution and escalation management Experience in SAP or equivalent logistics systems preferred

jobs.name: Operator, Packaging II

Follow the instructions of the production supervisor and report abnormal situations. Strictly follow SOPs regarding safety, environment, and occupational health in operations. Take appropriate measures for any safety, environmental, or occupational health incidents and report to the Production Supervisor. Correctly wear and use PPE as required. Monitor process conditions according to process log sheets and quality requirements. To support packaging with implementation audit Integrated Management System (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and IATF 16949 Quality Management System for the automotive industry. Ensure good housekeeping and proper handovers among shift team members. Other packaging-related tasks assigned by Production Supervisor. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. About The Role Support procurement activities for BASF Global Digital (GD) and Global Business (GB) Service Centres being established in Hyderabad. Manage procurement for large and complex offices and sites with multiple production units, businesses, and functions, including Site and Business Services across BASF locations beyond Hyderabad. Contribute to the development, implementation, and monitoring of regional category strategies covering Site and Business Services (e.g., Facility Management, Fleet, HR Services, Marketing & Communications, and Legal). Oversee contract implementation and performance monitoring. Drive category management initiatives to achieve cost efficiencies and value creation. Execute supplier management, including performance evaluation and relationship management. Ensure vendor compliance with human rights practices in line with applicable country laws and regulations. Manage Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes effectively. How Will You Do It Supplier Management: Monitor supplier performance to ensure alignment with BASF standards on quality, quantity, and service responsiveness. Maintain strong supplier relationships through regular communication and drive corrective actions using established performance management tools when required. Provide regular updates to internal stakeholders on market dynamics, including pricing trends, supply risks, supplier performance, and insights. Identify and develop new suppliers through market research and analysis to support business growth, including supplier evaluation, commercial negotiations, contracting, and onboarding. Supplier Qualification: Identify and develop new supplier sources, with a strong focus on local vendors in Hyderabad. Lead supplier audits and qualification processes in collaboration with technical teams. jobs.name: Intern, Regional Projects & Value Chain Analysis, Petrochemicals Asia Pacific

Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group's success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability - the economy, environment and society - into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role Reporting to the Senior Manager, Regional Strategic Marketing Petrochemicals Asia Pacific, you will be responsible to support the team on key strategic regional business unit (RBU) initiatives and drive market analyses to identify additional opportunities in Asia-Pacific How You Will Do It RBU Initiatives: Examine data to identify mid- to long-term market opportunities and develop hypotheses to support business growth Facilitate workshops and strategic discussions with the Petrochemicals Asia Pacific Leadership Team by preparing clear and compelling materials Contribute ideas on workshop structure, objective and documentation Market Analysis: Review and analyse existing market intelligence, highlighting insights relevant to the current organization and business context Provide objective perspectives on market gaps and recommend potential target opportunities for the organization What We Look For Students of Bachelor’s Degree in Chemicals, Science or related disciplines Commitment to a 3-month of internship Proficiency in MS Word, Excel & PowerPoint Excellent communication, interpersonal and organization skills Fluent in English, with proficiency in Mandarin, will be helpful BASF has a rich history in Hong Kong, dating back to the 1880s when it began selling textile dyes in the region. Over the years, the company has grown and expanded its presence, establishing its East Asia Regional Headquarters in Hong Kong in 1995. As a multinational company with a long-standing presence in Hong Kong, BASF is committed to the city's continued success as an internationally competitive business and financial center. By the end of 2025, BASF East Asia Regional Headquarters Limited had 240 employees.

jobs.name: Technical Sales Manager- Advanced Metallization
jobs.description: Now hiring! Technical Sales Manager- Advanced Metallization Hillsboro, OR (Onsite) Come create chemistry with us! The Technical Sales Manager – Advanced Metallization will join BASF’s Electronic Materials team, focusing on driving growth and innovation in metallization solutions for advanced semiconductor manufacturing. This role is responsible for managing customer and equipment supplier projects, identifying new business opportunities, and supporting the development and commercialization of next-generation metallization products (e.g., copper, cobalt, ruthenium, and related chemistries for sub-10nm nodes and advanced packaging). At BASF Electronic Materials, we uphold a relentless passion to innovate the future of electronics with our customers by equipping them with the essential solutions and technologies to continuously succeed in the competitive electronics industry. BASF has been supplying electronic materials for more than 30 years. The experience we have earned and the chemical expertise we possess enables us to offer outstanding products and solutions to our customers. At BASF, we offer high purity and quality process chemicals and specialized solutions for semiconductors, flat panel displays, and lighting such as LED. With our team of passionate, dedicated experts from all facets of the industry fields working closely with our customers worldwide, we are steadfast in our philosophy to deliver the quality excellence, reliable services, and innovative solutions that exceed the highest standards. As a Technical Sales Manager- Advanced Metallization, you create chemistry by... As a Technical Sales Manager - Advanced Metallization, you create chemistry by... Identify industry trends, unmet customer needs, and key growth drivers in advanced metallization for semiconductor devices. Lead cross-functional projects with US customers and equipment suppliers (e.g., deposition tool vendors), ensuring timely execution and alignment with global technical teams. Evaluate business potential and secure new opportunities by launching new products or expanding existing product lines. Initiate and foster strategic collaborations with customers and tool suppliers to accelerate innovation and adoption of BASF’s metallization solutions. Gather and analyze market intelligence on emerging technologies, customer requirements, and competitive landscape. Provide technical support for new applications and product development, working closely with R&D, sales, and manufacturing teams. Translate customer and market requirements into actionable product specifications and project plans. Inspire creativity and manage abstract concepts in a highly collaborative, global environment. If you have... Experience with semiconductor industry standards, advanced node requirements (sub-10nm) and/or advanced packaging. Familiarity with process integration and qualification of metallization materials Management experience in directing, coordinating and managing team activities to accomplish highly technical tasks. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. Minimum 10 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, with a focus on metallization, film deposition (CVD, PVD, ALD), electrochemical plating, or advanced packaging. Proven track record of managing complex technical projects and collaborating with leading semiconductor manufacturers and/or equipment suppliers. Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to convey detailed requirements and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated leadership and influencing skills in cross-functional, multicultural teams. Self-starter with excellent organizational skills and the ability to work independently. Willingness to travel up to 25%. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. jobs.name: Assistant Sample Logistics (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Welkom bij BASF Bij BASF heeft chemie gelijk. Omdat we vertrouwen op innovatie in onze oplossingen, op duurzaamheid in onze acties en op onze verbondenheid in ons denken. En in jou. Word onderdeel van onze succesformule en ontwikkel de toekomst met ons - in een wereldwijd en divers team, dat staat voor gelijke kansen, ongeacht leeftijd, achtergrond, geslacht, seksuele identiteit, handicap, geloof of overtuigingen. In Heerenveen (ca. 230 medewerkers) ontwikkelen en produceren wij watergedragen polymeerproducten en formulation additives voor de Verpakkings- en Coatingindustrie. Met een multidisciplinair team (Marketing, Technical Service, Application & Syntheses Lab, Engineering en Production) werken wij aan marktvragen van de Printing & Packaging industry. Wat je kunt verwachten De afdeling Sample Logistics, als onderdeel van Supply Chain, verzorgt het (her)verpakken en verzenden van ± 50.000 commerciële samples per jaar wereldwijd. Als Medewerker Samples draag je bij aan de klanttevredenheid en kom je tegemoet aan de wensen van de business (snelheid, nauwkeurigheid, flexibiliteit en betrouwbaarheid). Als onderdeel van een klein team zorg je voor de administratieve en fysieke verwerking van orders in samenwerking met in- en externe partijen. Dit betekent: Je zorgt voor tijdige en juiste voorbereiding en uitgifte van materialen om tegemoet te komen aan de benodigdheden van de business. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor alle operationele en administratieve activiteiten met betrekking tot samples. Daarna zorg je voor de juiste ontvangst, opslag en verzending van goederen volgens de wettelijke eisen voor opslag en transport. Bovendien sta je garant voor een hoge kwaliteit van de ERP-data en interne voorraden. Je zorgt voor veilige en efficiënte (her)verpakking naar samplemateriaal. Wat wij verwachten Je hebt minimaal een diploma mbo-3, bij voorkeur in een logistieke richting. Je hebt relevante werkervaring binnen de logistiek en enige aantoonbare ervaring met administratieve werkzaamheden. Je bent een goede netwerker en onderhoudt contact met externe partijen binnen de BASF vestigingen en internationale vervoerders. Je hebt kennis van SAP (ERP systeem). Kennis van het werken met gevaarlijke stoffen en het vervoer daarvan per weg of lucht is een groot pluspunt. Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels. Je bent een teamplayer. Aanbod Verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één in een uitdagende (internationale) werkomgeving en "on-the-job" opleiding als onderdeel van een betrokken team. Daarnaast ontvang je: Een leuke baan voor langere tijd voor 40 uren per week 13e maand, 8,3% vakantiegeld en een variabele bonus 25 vakantiedagen + 6 adv dagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) Uitstekende carrièremogelijkheden in een internationaal bedrijf

jobs.name: Senior Specialist Digitalization Digital Plant (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Our GDD/D – Digitalization of Operations unit implements digital technologies and applications in production plants. This enables us to increase production effectiveness. At the same time, processes become more efficient and safer. RESPONSIBILITIES Our goal is the implementation of digital technologies and applications in chemical plants, to improve work processes and increase the production efficiency. As a part of the global Digital Plant team you will coordinate the creation of a digital, intelligently linked representation of a real asset – the so-called digital twin. The digital twin will therefore enable many future use cases in other products like augmented reality or artificial intelligence. Your activities will include the digitalization of a real plant, by following a standardized and proven procedure create validated 2D- and 3D-data. The implementation of the necessary technology, digital workflows and roles within the whole organization of a plant and the respective service providers will be part of your activities, too. You will guide users how to use digital methods and processes during the asset lifecycle, to raise the potentials of cost and lead time reduction combined with quality increase in engineering, construction, brownfield projects, plant modifications, maintenance, TARM and operations. On the way to the digital asset lifecycle, you will offer change management support, accompanied by training and coaching on easy-to-use tools and enhanced digital processes. QUALIFICATIONS Master Degree in Chemical/Process Engineering or Mechanical Engineering Minimum 3+ years’ experience in planning or construction of or in chemical plants Experience in usage of digital tools and methods in data driven engineering projects Very good project management and coordination skills Ideally working Experience in international projects and agil methods The will and ability to drive change and an entrepreneurial spirit Creative and motivated working style with a strong focus on innovation Ability to work in a multicultural and virtual team Excellent communication skills in English WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities

jobs.name: Production Engineer
jobs.description: Objective of the Position Responsible for ensuring day-to-day plant operations run smoothly, with a strong focus on daily production safety, process reliability, quality, and regulatory compliance, while optimizing asset utilization and production efficiency. Assist the Production Manager in ensuring the operation of the production section is carried out on time according to EHS, quality and other agreed requirements. Key in driving continuous improvement, cross-shift standardization, and effective problem-solving to sustain high-performance operations. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activies EHS Strictly comply with and implement the company's EHS policies and ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certification requirements. Guide and ensure shift operations to strictly follow SOPs regarding safety, environment, and occupational health in their operations. Take appropriate measures for any safety, environmental, or occupational health incidents and report to the Production Manager as per procedures. Using personal protective equipment (PPE) according to the Safe Work Guidelines or PPE Matrix Carry out emergency actions as required by procedures during emergency response events. Operations Ensure all environmental, health and safety rules and guidelines are being adhered to and maintained by the production personnel. Providing technical and operational leadership to support day-to-day plant operations, ensuring safe execution of production plans in full compliance with BASF Process Safety standards, and applicable environmental regulation. Acting as a technical authority and trusted advisor to Operations, leading complex troubleshooting efforts and guiding Daily Operations teams toward effective, sustainable solutions for process, production, quality, and EHS challenges. Driving continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Six Sigma methodologies to improve asset efficiency, optimize equipment cycle times, reduce waste, and sustain nameplate production capacity. Influencing cross shift standardization, cost optimization, and asset performance by working collaboratively with Operations, Maintenance, and Asset Effectiveness teams to align priorities and maximize plant utilization. Leading cross functional coordination and technical input for inspections, outages, capital projects, and investigations (RCA, NCM), partnering with Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Regulatory teams to prevent repeat incidents and improve first pass quality. Lead production team in trial production of new products and internal test products (PTO). To check and revise if necessary; HIRA, Procedures, Working Instructions, and Work Checklists. Manage the inventory of materials and tools, including staging materials for production and packaging by conducting periodic stock counts. Support on evaluating training needs for the operation, to ensure they are provided the adequate training for operation and continuous improvement. Responsible as 5S leader coordinator for Production Department. Review process condition and downtime report, GAP reporting and propose for improvement. Represent the Production Manager on production matter during the Production Manager absence. Ensure effectiveness of the implementation audit for Integrated Management System (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and IATF 16949 Quality Management System for the automotive industry. Ensure good housekeeping and proper handovers among shift team members. Other production-related tasks assigned by superiors. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Polymers Science or Chemical Engineering. At least 5 - 8 years’ of experience in delivering technical expertise in a plastics compounding manufacturing plant. Posses demonstrated track record of leading through influence, providing expert technical guidance, and partnering with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and EHS teams to achieve safe and reliable plant performance. Proficient in production management software (e.g., ERP systems, MES). Hold strong production and operations background with the ability to independently support troubleshooting, root cause failure analysis, and investigations across Production, EHS and Quality. Have proven continuous improvement capability, including practical application of Lean Six Sigma methodologies to drive efficiency, waste reduction, asset utilization, and sustained nameplate performance. Highly effective collaborator with strong attention to detail and communication skills, able to coordinate complex activities and influence priorities across cross functional teams without formal supervisory authority. Knowledgeable on ISO 9001, ISO 14001, TS 16949 and ISO 45001 requirements. BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

The purpose of this role is to be the first contact for EDM North America (NA) customers to handle quality relevant topics with including NC handling, quality inquiry, customer audit coordination, CoA upload, and white paper/PCN communication. Providing local QM support in NA for business growth and customer satisfaction enhancement. Being local quality contact in NA for 3rd party QC lab evaluation and qualification and providing support for supplier management. As a Quality Management Lead, you create chemistry by... Maintain internal/external contact window for EDM NA customers on quality related inquiries/survey/quality audit/complaints / troubleshooting, etc… Customer relationship management with EDM US customers and take the responsibility to provide initial response to EDM US customers Collaborate with NA business team to meet quality requirements from EDM NA customers and maintain customer satisfaction Collect correct and necessary information to coordinate customer quality request internal/external communication, and implementation follow-up Coordinate customer inquiry/complaint investigation with internal cross function team and provide on-time response to customer including Kuanyin site in Taiwan and Ludwigshafen in Germany Process Change Notice (PCN) report and white paper preparation, communication and follow-up for on-time implementation Collaborate with production site CQM team to finish OCAP, worse chart, BKM, related quality requirements investigation, etc… Collaborate with production site CQM team in preparing regular PCS review, customer audit, and quality inquiring. Take the ownership for CoA and production resume upload for customer system and collaborate with Taiwan/LU team for COA/Production resume upload working model optimization for all batches shipped Being local quality staff in NA to evaluate/qualify 3rd party QC lab by closely working with the production site QC lab. Provide local support in NA for supplier management like supplier audit, visit.. If you have... 5 + years of experience in semiconductor or quality field (customer quality experience or supplier quality experience is preferred) Strong interpersonal/customer dealing skill/coordination, open-minded and positive thinking, value selling, and hands-on skill Master degree in Engineering, Industry Engineering, Chemical engineering, Chemical, Statistic, MBA..etc. Strong English speaking/writing/listening/reading skills are essential and Mandarin is nice to have Proficient at Microsoft Office, Statistic Software (JMP, statistic..), Digitalization, Database Programing is plus Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Global Customs Operations (Executive)
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position Global Customs Operations (Executive) is responsible for customs related activities served out via Kuala Lumpur Asia Pacific Service Centre (Hub). The role’s objectives: To enable business focus and delivery of service excellence from the hub to support business needs. To support hub customs operations related service requests. To support compliance within BASF supply chain operational processes regarding Foreign Trade (Customs and Trade Control). To support any improvement and process implementation to ensure an agreed service level and in compliance with governmental regulations and BASF company policies. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities . Delivery of Customs service to business Collaborate cross-functionally with internal working partners in support of trade compliance, supply chain, and general company objectives and projects Support business unit queries related to customs relevant activities. Respond promptly to requests and urgent issues. Hub Customs operational responsibilities: Support hub operational service activities including customs import/ export related documentation, issuance and verification, and duty rate maintenance in SAP or customized database Perform Customs Documentation review and validate all import and export documentations to ensure data accuracy and comply with customs laws and regulations regardless of whether from global or local country perspective Support process improvement projects Monitor regulatory changes and take prompt action to comply with the latest requirements. Support the data preparation required for dashboards Support the standardization of reporting of departmental and organizational measurements Support the automation of routine data collection Support the process documentations (Standard Operating Procedure, Work Guide, Work Instruction) for customs hub operations Proactively address and resolve any discrepancies or customs-related issues (e.g., delayed shipments, missing documentation, tariff classification mismatch, etc.) by troubleshooting the root cause and communicating clearly with relevant parties Customs Compliance responsibilities: Support Customs Compliance related assessment, health checks, audit and its documentation Support operational and service documentation including Standard Operating Procedure, Work Instructions, Work Guide Ensure all activities comply with relevant customs regulations, trade laws and tariff schedules Process and system improvement responsibilities Support any digitalization initiatives or automation for customs process and operations Support any system upgrade or enhancement related review and testing Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in any technical discipline, preferably Supply Chain Management Minimum 1-2 years relevant experience in Customs and Foreign Trade; familiar with Supply Chain operations Experience in customs, trade law and practices of chemical and non-chemical products is desirable Must be able to be flexible with EMEA working hours

jobs.name: Global Customs Performance Management (Senior Executive)
jobs.description: O bjectives of the Position The Global Customs Performance Management (Senior Executive) monitors operational performance of global Customs Operations via Kuala Lumpur Asia Pacific Service Centre (Hub). The role’s objectives include: Measuring service execution, quality of service as well as adherence to standard processes as per global Guidance documentation to ensure adherence to local, national or global regulations. Support Export & Import customs declarations, Inward processing or similar saving programs, handbook procedures, Preferential Origin declaration and all other customs processes. Closely collaborate with the global Steering unit to initiate process-oriented risk assessments to check compliance with the agreed strand procedures and initiates mitigation measures if applicable. Incorporates the ability for deep diving process analysis and deep understanding about Customs & Foreign Trade regulations. To support any improvement to ensure an agreed service level with cost control and in compliance with governmental regulations and BASF company policies. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Initiates and defines global, regional and local monitoring processes on operational Customs Performance as defined Support organizing meeting with countries and any business review as necessary Deep dive into and analyses of BASF internal & external customs data and presentation in a visual standardized format Prepare monthly statistics and KPI report for service recipient Support the data preparation required for dashboards, including alerts and analysis Support the standardization of reporting of departmental and organizational measurements Support the automation of routine data collection and develop reporting processes that aid operational performance management Job Requirements Must have degree/diploma in supply chain or related field Must have experience in customs, foreign trade and performance management in customs related topics Strong communication and argumentation skills SAP is preferred Must be flexible to work in EMEA timezone Excellent analytical thinking

jobs.name: Global Customs Operations & Performance Management (Manager)
jobs.description: O bjectives of the Position Lead and oversee the team in delivering customs services, including customs verification and documentation review, ensuring alignment with service expectations. Foster strong relationships with internal business partners by understanding their requirements and delivering high-quality, collaborative, and responsive support. Coordinate effectively with external service providers to ensure seamless operations and alignment with service standards through proactive engagement and collaboration. Manage quality assurance related to overseas delivery services, ensuring timely resolution and continuous improvement. Oversee risk management activities for the team, including access control, data protection, business continuity planning, and regular risk assessments. Drive knowledge management initiatives by maintaining up-to-date documentation, facilitating structured reviews, and assigning clear process ownership to ensure knowledge retention. Monitor team performance, provide regular coaching and guidance, and support professional development to achieve operational excellence. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities 1.  Customs Services Define goals and target for the team to support business as usual Stay updated on changes to country-specific regulations and requirements to ensure compliance with all services. Collaborate with Functional Expert team to promote automation and process enhancement Ensure all import/export activities comply with local customs laws and international trade agreements. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional customs regulations and free trade agreements (FTAs). 2. Project Management Lead/ Support and coordinate customs-related projects such as system implementations, process improvements, and regulatory change initiatives. Develop project plans, timelines, and deliverables in collaboration with cross-functional teams. Monitor project progress, manage risks, and ensure timely completion of milestones. Report on project outcomes and recommend continuous improvement strategies. 3. Risk Management & Enforcement Identify and mitigate risks related to miscalculations, undervaluation, or non-compliance. Support internal audits and investigations related to customs activities. Implement corrective, preventive actions and process improvements as needed. 4. Stakeholder Engagement Act as the point of contact to support customs authorities’ inquiries. Provide training and guidance to internal teams on customs procedures and regulatory updates. Collaborate with cross functional team, business unit, supply chain, legal entity, and order management teams to ensure end-to-end compliance. 5. Reporting & Analysis Prepare regular reports on customs performance (quantitative & qualitative) and compliance metrics Analyze data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for optimization. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in international Trade, Customs Administration, Supply Chain, or related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in customs operations or trade compliance and customs performance management Proven experience in managing cross-functional projects or process improvement initiatives. Good understanding of Preferential Rules of Origin, COO processes, and FTA frameworks. Familiarity with HS classification, customs valuation, and import/export documentation. Excellent project management, analytical, and communication skills. Must be able to work in EMEA timezone

jobs.name: Account Manager (m/f)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF The world needs innovation – and we need you! At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future and are looking for talents who can help answer tomorrow’s challenges. Join BASF’s Industries and Services division, where we market around 8,000 products produced by the Group, all aimed at improving everyday life. Are you ready to take the next step in your career and contribute to a more sustainable future in chemistry within our teams? WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As an Account Manager within BTC France (the internal distributor of the BASF Group in France), you will be responsible for a portfolio of existing and prospective customers in the paints & coatings, adhesives, and construction markets. In this role, you will: Analyze customer needs, provide first-level technical support, and propose both commercial and technical solutions tailored to identified challenges; Proactively develop customer strategies through in-depth market and product knowledge; Lead and optimize commercial negotiations to ensure continuous growth in market share and results; Prospect and retain new customers; Actively contribute ideas to integrate new product ranges to broaden the offering for your industries, whether BASF products or third-party products; Contribute to the updating of market and customer data through reporting systems. WHAT YOU OFFER You hold a Master’s degree in Chemistry; You have at least 3 years of experience in a technical sales role; You have experience in the paints & coatings market; knowledge of adhesives is a plus; You are comfortable using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools in your daily work; You are fluent in French and English; knowledge of German is an additional asset; You are a dynamic, flexible, and enthusiastic team player; You are results-oriented and enjoy working on varied tasks; You see complex organizational structures as an interesting and motivating challenge. WHAT WE OFFER An attractive compensation package; Personalized support to help develop your professional skills; A stimulating and empowering work environment. ABOUT US Located in the heart of Paris, in the Bourse district, the Industries and Services site is the headquarters of BASF France SAS and employs more than 200 people. This site brings together various support and commercial functions covering different business areas. Our main customers operate in automotive, construction, cosmetics, hygiene, healthcare, food, packaging, and electrical engineering industries. Diversity is our greatest strength! Join our winning formula and help shape the future with us—within an international team that promotes inclusion and equal opportunities regardless of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability, or beliefs.

jobs.name: Technical Account Manager FCC Catalysts
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF The Catalysts Division is the world's leading supplier of environmental and process catalysts. We develop technologies for air protection, fuel production and for efficient manufacturing of chemicals and other products, including battery materials. We help our customers to be even more successful with our knowledge of precious and base metals and our passion for innovation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Serving as the priary technical expert for FCC catalyst applications at customer sites, providing hands-on technical support, troubleshooting, unit optimization, performance improvement, and advising refinery operations and technical teams on catalyst selection and operational strategy. Conducting FCC technical evaluations, simulations, and modeling to support recommendations, customer proposals, and performance improvement initiatives. Owning full P&L responsibility for assigned FCC accounts, including volume, margin, pricing, receivables, sales forecasting, CRM management, and account planning. Developing and executing account strategies aligned with BASF’s FCC business objectives, including pricing, contract negotiations, and commercial terms with refinery customers. Identifying and capturing new FCC business opportunities within existing and new refinery accounts, expanding account penetration through relationship mapping across technical and commercial stakeholders, and positioning BASF’s FCC catalyst portfolio to maximize market share in the region. Building strong relationships with refinery engineers, operations teams, and decision-makers, acting as the interface between customers and internal BASF technical, R&D, and business teams, and representing BASF in customer meetings, technical reviews, and industry engagements. Location: Fully remote role, ideally based in Southern Europe or the Mediterranean region to ensure proximity to key refinery customers. Territory: Responsible for refinery accounts across Southern Europe and the Mediterranean area, with a dedicated focus on FCC catalyst applications. Travel: Expected travel of approximately 30–50% to visit customer sites, support technical discussions, and strengthen business relationships across the assigned region. WHAT YOU OFFER Degree (BSc/MSc/PhD) in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or related discipline. Strong experience in refining with deep expertise in FCC operations and catalysts (mandatory). Proven track record in a customer-facing FCC technical or commercial role. Ability to perform FCC process analysis, modeling, and technical evaluations. Experience managing multiple refinery accounts in an international environment. Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated success in pricing and contract negotiations. Familiarity with Southern Europe / Mediterranean refining landscape. Expertise in FCC technology and refinery processes. Strong analytical, problem-solving capabilities and strategic thinking. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to operate independently in a remote, regional role. WHAT WE OFFER CCNL (National Chemical Collective Agreement). Gross annual salary (RAL) between €70,000 and €85,000, to be assessed based on the candidate’s skills and relevant experience. Variable bonus. Corporate welfare program. Company car for both business and personal use. High-impact regional role focused purely on FCC catalysts. Combination of technical leadership and commercial ownership. Flexible remote working within Southern Europe. Opportunity to work with leading refinery customers in the region. HOW TO REACH US Do you have questions about the selection process or the position? You can contact: talent-acquisition-italy@basf.com Initial information about the application process is available here: http://on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US Join a global FCC leader and contribute to advancing refinery performance through technical excellence and strong customer partnerships.

jobs.name: Senior Engineer, EP Material Testing (ID & Failure Analysis)
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Objectives of the Position Take the functional leadership of the sub-team of ID Analysis (FTIR, DSC and TGA) and failure Analysis to assist lab leader of EP Material Testing lab to manage EP material testing lab, and thus to assist head of Materials & Parts Testing to provide ID analysis and failure analysis supports to Research & Development, production, sales and marketing, business development, technical research & development and strategic objectives for company’s Engineering Plastics related PM business in China and Asia Pacific in an effective way. How You Will Do It Be responsible for operation of ID analysis (FTIR, DSC and TGA) and failure analysis related part of EP Material testing lab. Review test results; monitor progress of testing requests; participate in the process changes to be made; contribute to customer on-site audit; participate in the investigation on customer complaints on EP Material mechanical tests. Lead the execution of testing tasks and make the routine maintenance plan of equipment related to ID analysis and failure analysis of EP materials. Devise tests, procedures and apparatus required to achieve experimental results, help to develop new testing methods to meet requirements, and lead the training for new employees on ID analysis and failure analysis of EP materials. Write comprehensive reports and evaluations on the data obtained relating to ID analysis and failure analysis of EP materials. Participate in the CAPEX plan relating to ID analysis and failure analysis of EP material and execute the plan accordingly. Oversee the new equipment purchase for related tests and contact from the negotiation period of the deal. Contribute to the Asia Pacific part of global testbox program and the discussion for improve testing procedures relating to ID analysis and failure analysis. Contribute to the Asia Pacific part of testing harmonization and the global testing harmonization relating to ID analysis and failure analysis of EP materials. Contribute to the management of external resource of EP material testing relating to ID analysis and failure analysis, conduct external resource screening, audit, negotiation and monitoring. Co-operate with development/technical service/manufacturing/sales & marketing in providing technical assistance to demonstrate company products, and to solve field problems. Contribute to safety, health and environmental standards of EP & FR lab. Coordinate to maintain EP Material Testing lab to fulfil Quality Management System (ISO/IEC 17025, ISO 9001, ISO/TS 16949, etc.). What We Look For Education: Master or Bachelor in polymer chemistry, analytics chemistry, material science or other polymer or chemistry related. Working Experience: Master with more than 5 years’ experience or bachelor with more than 8 years’ experience in material analysis (more than 3 years’ experience on FTIR, DSC and TGA of EP materials) and material testing of polymer materials. Over 3 years’ supervisor or leadership experience. Over one year’s ISO 17025 experience will be plus. Technical & Professional Knowledge: Knowledge and hand-on experience on material analysis and material testing of polymer materials. Ability to deliver technical presentations in Mandarin and English. Ability to write comprehensive technical report by English. Knowledge on ISO 17025 system management will be a plus. Language: Ability to communicate with written and spoken English smoothly. 请时刻警惕任何可能的招聘欺诈行为！请注意，巴斯夫绝不会在任何情况下向候选人以任何形式收取任何费用

jobs.name: Assistente Técnico Pleno
jobs.description:
Assistente Técnico Pleno - Curitiba PR Objetivo do cargo: Prestar suporte técnico aos clientes, assegurando a correta utilização dos sistemas de repintura automotiva das linhas Glasurit e Baslac, promovendo a na aplicação dos produtos, o aumento da produtividade das oficinas e a satisfação dos clientes. Sobre a vaga: Realizar instalação, ativação e acompanhamento de sistemas de pintura nas oficinas de repintura automotiva. Ministrar treinamentos técnicos sobre produtos, processos de aplicação e melhores práticas das linhas Glasurit e Baslac. Realizar visitas técnicas periódicas para acompanhamento da performance dos clientes. Prestar suporte técnico para resolução de problemas relacionados à preparação, aplicação, secagem, acabamento e colorimetria. Elaborar relatórios técnicos de visitas e registrar planos de ação para acompanhamento dos clientes. Auxiliar no desenvolvimento técnico de novos clientes e na implantação de oficinas. Suportar equipes comerciais em demonstrações técnicas e apresentações de produtos. Acompanhar indicadores de consumo, produtividade e qualidade dos processos de pintura. Garantir a correta utilização dos softwares de gerenciamento de cores e formulação. Zelar pela correta utilização dos equipamentos fornecidos aos clientes. Atuar como multiplicador de conhecimento técnico, promovendo treinamentos internos e externos quando necessário. Conhecimentos indispensáveis: Processos completos de repintura automotiva. Preparação de superfície. Aplicação de primers, bases, vernizes e acabamentos. Colorimetria e ajuste de cores. Polimento e acabamento. Equipamentos de pintura. Sistemas de mistura. Interpretação de fichas técnicas e boletins técnicos. Pacote Office. jobs.description:

We share the skills, knowledge and resources of interdisciplinary global teams through a collaborative network of sites in Europe, North America, South America and Asia Pacific. Roles and Responsibilities: Account and relationship management Take ownership of the assigned account(s), sales, and pricing processes according to the company’s pricing guidelines and marketing pricing strategy for the industry. Develop and maintain accuracy of assigned customers to include organizational Power Map- and decision-making hierarchy. jobs.name: Technical Account Manager - Refinery Catalysts (m/f/d)
jobs.description: The world needs innovations, and our team needs you! BASF is the world's leading chemical company #WeCreateChemistry and one of the best places to work and develop your career. We are looking for diverse, passionate, and creative talent who wants to make a difference. BASF Española S.L. markets more than 5,000 products to meet the needs of our customers and society across a wide variety of sectors. The chemical industry is changing; and so is BASF. Discover our new strategy: #WinningWays Do you want to boost your career to the next level and create chemistry with us? WHAT YOU WILL DO By joining BASF’s Catalysts division, with exclusive focus on Fluid Catalytic Cracking (FCC) applications within refinery customers across Southern Europe and the Mediterranean region, you will be: Serving as the primary technical expert for FCC catalyst applications at customer sites. Providing hands-on technical support, including troubleshooting, unit optimization, and performance improvement. Conducting FCC technical evaluations, simulations, and modeling to support recommendations and proposals. Advising refinery operations and technical teams on catalyst selection, performance, and operational strategy. Owning full P&L responsibility for assigned FCC accounts (volume, margin, pricing, receivables). Developing and executing account strategies aligned with BASF’s FCC business objectives. Managing pricing, contract negotiations, and commercial terms with refinery customers. Delivering accurate sales forecasts and managing CRM tools for account planning. Identifying and capturing new FCC business opportunities within existing and new refinery accounts. Expanding account penetration through relationship mapping across technical and commercial stakeholders. Positioning BASF’s FCC catalyst portfolio to maximize market share in the region. Building strong relationships with refinery engineers, operations teams, and decision-makers. Acting as the interface between customers and internal BASF technical, R&D, and business teams. Representing BASF in customer meetings, technical reviews, and industry engagements. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU University degree (BSc, MSc or PhD) in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or related disciplines. Strong background (at least 5 years of experience) in refining with deep expertise in FCC operations and catalysts. Proven track record in a customer-facing FCC technical or commercial role with demonstrated success in pricing and contract negotiations. Ability to perform FCC process analysis, modeling, and technical evaluations. Familiarity with Southern Europe / Mediterranean refining landscape. Strong communication skills in English, both verbal and written. Knowledge on any Mediterranean language is a plus. Availability to travel ~30–50% of your working time. WHAT WE OFFER Healthy work environment : where your safety and health (both physical and mental) are always our priority. Attractive salary package : based on a fixed salary and a bonus based on performance. Flexible working model : you will be able to work remotely within the country and adjust your schedule. Flexible compensation plan : to take advantage of ser vices such as Health Insurance, Childcare, Transportation Card, and Training, among others. Professional development : we promote continuous training and access to internal vacancies to keep growing at BASF. Investments for your future: with a Pension Plan, Accident Insurance, Life Insurance, and even the opportunity to participate in the Stock Program after one year in the company. Work-life balance measures : as well as financial assistance for the schooling of children. Sports sections : where you can connect with colleagues and play football, paddle, basketball, cycling, yoga, etc. And much more. HOW TO PARTICIPATE IN THE PROCESS Send your CV through the job offer so we can get to know each other. If your profile is a match, we will call you from the Spanish Talent Acquisition team in Germany (prefix +49) and support you throughout the process. With each step, you will be closer to meeting your future team! If you have any further questions about this process, please contact: talent-acquisition-spain@basf.com * *Please note that we will not be able to accept your resume via this email. MORE ABOUT BASF We celebrate diversity and actively promote an inclusive work environment where every voice is heard, and every idea is valued, regardless of age, gender, marital status, ethnicity, religion, physical/mental condition, or sexual orientation. #BeYourself We are C reative, O pen, R esponsible and E ntrepreneurial people. This are o ur values , they guide us and describe who we are and how we act. If you identify with them, BASF is the place for you! Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional customs regulations and free trade agreements (FTAs). 2. Project Management Lead/ Support and coordinate customs-related projects such as system implementations, process improvements, and regulatory change initiatives. Develop project plans, timelines, and deliverables in collaboration with cross-functional teams. Monitor project progress, manage risks, and ensure timely completion of milestones. Report on project outcomes and recommend continuous improvement strategies. .3.  Risk Management & Enforcement Identify and mitigate risks related to miscalculations, undervaluation, or non-compliance. jobs.name: Senior Specialist Digitalization Digital Plant (m/f/d) 1
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Digitalization is a true part of BASF's DNA — creating new customer experiences, driving business growth, and making processes more efficient. Global Digital Services drives BASF's digital transformation through innovative, global, high-quality digital products and a strong agile culture, and the Digital Hub Madrid is one of our key global delivery locations. We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer for BASF's DevHub — the Internal Developer Platform (IDP) used by thousands of engineers and product teams across BASF. DevHub already ships an enterprise AI Gateway (50+ governed models, Entra ID, EU data residency, per-cost-center billing, Grafana observability) and a catalog that is a schema-validated knowledge graph of every product and its infrastructure. Your mission is to make AI a first-class platform capability: build reusable, production-grade AI services and developer experiences that help users discover, create, configure, operate, scale and govern their products, surfaced where they already work — the portal, the IDE (GitHub Copilot/MCP) and Teams. You will treat the platform as a product — shipping paved-road components other teams reuse, serving both humans and agents, with the multi-tenant scoping, cost-tracking, guardrails and governance an enterprise platform demands. RESPONSIBILITIES Treat the platform as a product. Build paved roads and self-service: reusable AI building blocks (shared retrieval/"context engine," guardrail & evaluation libraries, an MCP/tool layer), scaffolder templates, SDK/API access and stable, versioned interfaces — built once, reused across features. Ship AI experiences that delight developers. Grounded, well-cited assistants, copilots and wizards across the product lifecycle (e.g. a conversational knowledge assistant over our docs and catalog), meeting users on the portal, IDE (Copilot/MCP) and Teams via one shared API. Serve humans and agents. Expose platform capabilities through an MCP / SDK / API surface — read-first, RBAC- and tenant-aware — so internal and external AI clients can query and (later, gated) act on the platform. See the AI-Assisted Platform Strategy RFC. Own evaluation and quality. Build eval harnesses, golden tests and retrieval-quality metrics so features are correct, grounded and regression-tested in CI; invest in context engineering over model-shopping — the Gateway already solves model choice. Pick the right pattern. Prefer deterministic pipelines + structured outputs + human-in-the-loop where outcomes are structured; reserve multi-step/multi-agent orchestration (Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, LangGraph / Microsoft Agent Framework) for genuinely open-ended tasks, keeping state-changing actions gated. Strengthen MLOps / LLMOps. Improve prompt/version management, model adaptation, CI/CD and the path from experiment to production; treat prompts and retrieval as versioned, tested production assets. Build for multi-tenancy. Default to per-product / per-tenant scoping of context, tools and actions; bake in observability (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, distributed tracing) and per-product cost/FinOps visibility. Help advance security, safety & governance. Inherit platform RBAC (Entra ID / AccessIT), defend against the OWASP LLM Top 10, keep AI usage auditable, and respect BASF / EU AI Act and data-residency requirements. QUALIFICATIONS BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or related field. 4+ years in Software Engineering or Platform Development, with demonstrable recent experience in Generative AI and/or Agentic Systems. You don't need to tick every box. Strong Python + hands-on LLM application experience + a platform/developer-experience mindset matter most; we expect you to grow into the rest. AI / LLM engineering. Practical experience building LLM-powered applications; familiarity with RAG and agentic patterns (ReAct, plan-and-solve, multi-agent) and a clear sense of when not to use an autonomous agent. Evaluation & quality (core). Designing eval harnesses, golden tests and retrieval-quality metrics for LLM/RAG systems (grounding, retrieval precision, hallucination control); context engineering over model selection. Backend & API development. Python proficiency is highly desired (FastAPI, Pydantic, async); designing and operating production backend services and well-versioned APIs. Platform / Developer-Experience engineering. Building reusable, self-service components and paved roads (templates, SDKs, golden paths) and operating multi-tenant services in production (SLOs, observability, "you build it, you run it"). Software development across the stack. Enough context across frontend, backend, and infrastructure to contribute across DevHub's stack (with AI-assisted coding) — no need to be a full-stack expert in every layer. Cloud & infrastructure. Hands-on Azure and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS); infrastructure-as-code (HCL/Terraform, modular). Data & state management. Relational/non-relational databases (PostgreSQL) and vector stores (e.g. Azure AI Search); managing context and state at scale. DevOps & production operations. CI/CD (Git, GitHub Actions), monitoring/observability, and security best practices in production. AI / LLM ecosystem. LLM providers/APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral), managed AI services (Azure AI Foundry, Databricks), and the MCP standard. (At DevHub, models are consumed through the internal AI Gateway, not provider SDKs directly.) Security & multi-tenancy. Authentication/authorization, RBAC, tenant isolation, guardrails, auditability; awareness of the OWASP LLM Top 10. Agentic standards beyond MCP (e.g. A2A); spec-driven ("spec-kit") agentic development with AGENTS.md / skill conventions. Nice to Have Databricks / Unity Catalog — DevHub's core data platform; DevHub governs the Databricks account and environments (workspaces, Unity Catalog, blueprint lifecycle), not the Enterprise Data Lake or data distribution. Familiarity is a strong plus. TypeScript alongside Python; Grafana; MLflow and data pipelines. FinOps / cost attribution for AI features. Message queues / event-driven & data-intensive architectures (e.g. RabbitMQ, Azure Event Grid). Workflow engines / state machines; OpenTelemetry & distributed tracing. Experience with EnvoyProxy WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities
