jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Objectives of the Position Monitoring import export operations that are aligned with Company SOP and Working Instructions Managing operations and performance of Lead Logistic Provider (LLP) and Logistic Service Providers (LSPs) Supervision daily operation and communication of export process in BASF Indonesia to meet agreed performance requirement as per agreed target Meet performance targets and service levels and any assigned qualitative requirements relevant to import export Monitor and evaluate transport service provider’s performance referring to agreed KPIs and conduct periodic quality reviews. Ensure proper process and documentation in accordance to company and regulatory guidelines Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Export Operation Manage and monitor the daily export operations of LLP / LSP. Check the quality of import export orders and if required ensure adequate correction is in place Monitor box and ISO tank usage as per approved tender in monthly basis for each Business Units (BU) against the forecast from BU, analyze, provide inputs and mitigation if any deviation occurs. Monitor the carrier utilization by lane (port of loading/POL & port of destination/ POD) as per approved tender in monthly basis for each Business Units (BU) against the forecast from BU, analyze, provide inputs and mitigation if any deviation occurs. Fill in carrier issue log based on the actual event in timely manner. Managing the SPOT process in export activity, timely escalation to OVM lead for deviations and support Explore tools for digitalization for process improvement Continuous improvement for the export operation and process Manage the TM activity of pre-leg and overall export cost, ensure that the cost reflected in the system is correct and tally as per contract. Do analysis and solve if there is any discrepancy occurs. Support as back up to OVM Lead in absence or when required – as assigned by import export and customs manager etc. Import Operation Manage and monitor the daily import operations of LLP / LSP. Check the quality of import orders/documentations and if required ensure adequate correction is in place Continuous improvement for the export operation and process Monitoring daily report for import activities Liase with CnFT regarding permit, licences etc Documentation Support OVM Lead in knowledge management topics Ensure the document for export process are complete and accurate as per SOP and guidelines Ensure proper documentation and archiving process Managing of Lead Logistic Provider (LLP) and Logistic Service Providers (LSPs) Support OVM Lead in managing LLP and LSPs by providing data, analysis Facilitate Daily Performance Meeting (DPM) with LLP and LSPs and share Export related topics Monitor the performance and KPIs of the LLP and LSPs Raise NCM in timely manner to record any non-conformance from LLP and LSPs Check and verify the NCM closure with proper documentation, root cause analysis and CAPA (corrective and preventive action), monitor of recurrence of cases. Managing Vendor Performance Support OVM Lead during the performance review with vendors (Carriers, TCOs, etc.) by providing data, analysis and lead the meetings in the absence of the OVM Lead. Support OVM Lead during the vendor tendering and onboarding process. Monitor the performance of vendors (Carriers, TCOs, etc.) in monthly basis, document any deviation in carrier issue log and other tools provided, analyze and provide inputs to OVM Lead as well as Hub colleague. Communication Effectively communicate to the respective parties and stakeholders (BU, CSO, LLP, LSPs, Carriers, TCO, hub, regional / global SCM) in daily activities to ensure smooth operation in export area. Escalation of topics in timely manner to OVM lead, Import Export and Customs Manager to ensure smooth operation in export area. Job Requirements Education Degree in business management, supply chain management, international trade, transportation managements are preferred Working Experience and requirement Minimum 2-3 year’s experience in Import Export Operations are mandatory Working in chemicals industries or manufacturing is an advantage Required Language: Bahasa Indonesia and English Technical & Professional Knowledge Customs Certificate / Customs Training experience will be an advantage Working Independently with minimum supervision Strong logical thinking to understand process flow of import export Advance knowledge of Microsoft tools and experience using ERP SAP TMS

jobs.name: Officer, Order Management (Mandarin Speaker) - 1 year leasing
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Objectives of the Position This position aims to provide end-to-end delivery services by efficiently handling customer service and logistics management to maintain business continuity, enhance service level and safety continuity in business. Job Responsibilities: - Manage end-to-end daily order process and operation By collaborating with multiple functions (internal and external) including but not limited to customers, sales, GB, suppliers, finance, controlling. The operation includes but not limited to: Sales order creation PO transaction. Payment following up and order release. Delivery schedule coordination. Delivery order creation. Shipment creation. Transportation arrangement. Billing and invoice management. Documents collection. Month end reconciliation. Import/export related coordination and operation. Monitor shipping and import/export status for overseas supply & delivery. Escalate any issues for on-time fulfillment. Capture market intelligence on supply chain related topics. From daily interaction with customers and sharing with the business as appropriate, includes but not limited to: Provide best possible service to customers and promote the establishment of long-term customers relationships to ensure a sound profitable future customers base. Ensure best logistic cost execution through daily transportation management operation. Continuously improve end-to-end efficiency with creative ideas and digital tools’ support. Complete any unstated end-to-end officer-related tasks assigned by the manager Manage customers’ complaints NCM operation and communication according to defined procedures / system. Escalate critical NCMs when needed for appropriate resolution. Operational Compliance Ensure that all operations (also at customer premises) are carried out in accordance with internal standards and local government regulations. Report any areas of concern immediately to Supply Chain Manager. Job Requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in International Trade, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Work Experience: Minimum 2–3 years of experience in order-to-cash processes; experience in the chemical industry is an advantage. Language Skills: Proficient in Mandarin (both written and spoken) for communication with customers in China, as well as fluency in English. Technical Skills: Strong SAP competency is required. Personal Attributes: Thrives in a dynamic environment, maintains a positive and solution-oriented mindset, adapts well to change, collaborates effectively across teams, and consistently demonstrates strong professionalism and work ethic. Note: This position requires flexibility to work according to China holiday arrangement About BASF in Malaysia BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.description:
Objectives of the position: The Customer Service Officer, SEA is responsible for executing end-to-end customer service and order management activities to ensure efficient and accurate order fulfillment, export shipment coordination and high customer satisfaction across the SEA region. The role supports both inter-company and third-party customer operations while ensuring compliance with trade regulations, operational procedures and customer service standards. Core responsibilities : 1) To execute end-to-end Order-To-Cash (OTC) processes including order entry, order processing, delivery coordination, invoicing support and shipment tracking 2) To manage both inter-company orders and third-party customer orders to ensure timely and accurate fulfillment 3) To coordinate export shipments including shipping documentation, booking arrangements and delivery follow-up activities 4) To maintain proactive communication with customers regarding order status, product availability, shipment schedules and delivery updates 5) To perform regular checks on customer orders, pricing, credit blocks and compliance requirements within SAP systems 6) To ensure compliance with export control regulations, trade compliance requirements and company operational Non-Conformance Management (NCM) cases where required, ensuring timely follow-up and closure with relevant stakeholders 9) To monitor order fulfillment performance and support continuous improvement initiatives to improve service efficiency and customer satisfaction 10) To maintain accurate master data, customer information, and operational documentation within SAP systems 11) To support preparation and verification of shipping and export documents including invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and insurance documentation 12) To act as backup support for other Customer Service team members during leave or absence periods to ensure business continuity and uninterrupted customer support operations Job requirements and qualifications : Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Business coordination and order management within a regional environment is preferred Has a strong knowledge of Order-To-Cash processes, export shipment coordination and customer service operations Experience jobs.name: Shift Supervisor - Hannibal, MO (Palmyra)
jobs.description: Now hiring! Shift Supervisor - Hannibal, MO (Palmyra) Palmyra, MO (On-site) Annual bonus / Overtime pay eligible We are looking for a Shift Supervisor to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Palmyra, MO. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental, and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. As a Shift Supervisor you will lead others toward the accomplishment of production targets in a safe and environmentally conscious manner. You also may be assigned to any one of five production units at the Hannibal Plant that produce insecticides, herbicides, or intermediate chemicals used in the production of insecticides and/or herbicides. As a Shift Supervisor - Hannibal, MO (Palmyra), you create chemistry by... Leading others toward the accomplishment of production targets in a safe and environmentally conscious manner. Safety of all personnel in his or her plant is the foremost concern of our supervisors and only individuals with the highest commitment to common safety will be considered for the role. Being a results-driven leader who can get things done by working through others. Initiating work orders, enters them into the maintenance work management system (SAP), and working with maintenance to reduce cost and minimize downtime. Working closely with engineers to recommend process improvements and to troubleshoot the manufacturing process and managing the daily activities of the chemical operators in the assigned area, while building a sustainable culture of safety awareness and responsibility. Ensuring that proper documentation is maintained, procedures for material and product handling and storage are observed, and that production reports are completed in a timely manner. Additionally, you will manage the job setup procedure for contractors, including confined space entry, lock-out, tag-out and the safety work permit systems. Conducting safety meetings, ensuring that subordinates are trained properly, developing unit staffing schedules, and administering discipline according to company policy and the collective bargaining agreement. You will also participate in emergency response teams and receive special training on hazardous materials, regulatory compliance, or other aspects of chemical plant operations. If you... Hold a High school diploma or equivalent education. Possess 3 years’ experience as an operator in one or more of the operating units at the BASF Hannibal plant OR 3 years supervisory experience in an industrial manufacturing environment outside of BASF. Show strong personal commitment to building and maintaining a safety culture. Demonstrate coaching and leadership skills, tact, and the ability to communicate effectively and build strong relationships with individuals at all levels of the organization. Have computer literacy and familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite, as well as commitment to continuous improvement of computer skills when required. Possess good problem solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to quickly address and resolve equipment, process, and people issues. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. About The Role A DevOps Engineer is responsible for streamlining and automating the processes involved in software development, deployment, and maintenance. This role emphasizes collaboration, integration, and communication between software developers and IT operations professionals to enhance the efficiency of development and operational workflows. The DevOps Engineer focuses on building and maintaining the infrastructure and tools that facilitate continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), ensuring high-quality software delivery with minimal downtime How Will You It Infrastructure Management : Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure and on-premises systems. Utilize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (such as Terraform or CloudFormation) to automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration. CI/CD Pipeline Development : Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate the software build, test, and deployment processes. Streamline workflows to ensure quick and reliable software releases while minimizing errors and manual interventions. Monitoring and Performance Optimization : Implement monitoring and logging solutions to track system performance, application health, and user experience. Analyze metrics and logs to identify issues and optimize system performance for reliability and scalability. Collaboration and Communication : Foster a culture of collaboration between development, operations, and other stakeholders. Act as a liaison to facilitate communication and ensure alignment on project goals and timelines. Configuration Management : Use configuration management tools (such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef) to automate the deployment and management of applications and services across various environments. Security and Compliance : Integrate security practices into the DevOps processes (DevSecOps) to ensure that applications and infrastructure comply with security standards and best practices. Conduct regular security assessments and vulnerability scans. Incident Management : Respond to and troubleshoot production incidents, working collaboratively with development and operations teams to resolve issues quickly. Conduct post-incident reviews to identify root causes and implement preventative measures. Documentation : Maintain comprehensive documentation of processes, configurations, and system architecture. Ensure that knowledge is shared within the team to support onboarding and continuous improvement. Continuous Improvement : Advocate for and implement best practices for DevOps processes, tools, and methodologies. Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies to enhance the organization’s DevOps capabilities. What We Look For Education -  BE, BTech, MCA Experinece - Min 5yrs of exp required Skills - Azure Clould, Azure Devops (CI/CD), Kubernet, Terraform, Keycloack, Finops, Azure Networking. Communication Skill -  Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with stakeholders across all levels.

jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As a newly standalone business, we are also adapting our Controlling organization with a strong focus on value creation. As Controlling Manager – Value & Cost Controlling, you will build and lead a team that ensures financial transparency, drives performance management, and supports value-oriented steering across our global business. Your team owns three key areas: functional cost controlling, the financial steering of the company's value creation initiatives, and the controlling of our Transitional Service Agreements (TSAs) and other external service providers during the first phase of our standalone journey. As the direct finance partner for senior management on all cost and value creation topics, you play a key role in achieving the company's financial targets. In your new role, you lead and develop the Value & Cost Controlling team, foster a collaborative, business-partner-oriented culture, and ensure the delivery of accurate, timely, and decision-relevant financial insights to senior management. You further enhance reporting on primary cost controlling, implementing new allocation models and driving process automation. In addition, you oversee the financial steering of value creation initiatives, ensuring transparency on the financial impact, milestones, and progress of the company’s strategic initiatives portfolio and providing management with clear insights into status, risks, and opportunities. Furthermore, you steer the controlling of all Transitional Service Agreements (TSAs) and other external service providers, ensuring transparency on scope, costs, service levels, and timelines while supporting a smooth and timely transition into the target setup; always in close collaboration with internal stakeholders. You design and implement a robust performance management framework, including KPI definition, target setting, variance analysis, and continuous monitoring of profitability and efficiency initiatives, and you play a key role in budgeting, forecasting, and long-term planning cycles, ensuring consistent alignment between corporate strategy, financial planning, and execution. Last but not least, you partner closely with finance leadership, business units, and operational functions to identify performance improvement opportunities, support strategic and operational targets, and drive the standardization, automation, and digitalization of controlling processes to enable data-driven decision-making. jobs.name: AI Data Architect (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Digital Hub Madrid attracts, grows, and develops passionate people who will meaningfully impact the digital future of BASF. Come join us and be a part of our digitalization journey. Describe your Product Mission here / objective of the role: The AI & Automation Enablement team designs and engineers scalable AI and automation solutions that deliver measurable business value. By combining strong architecture, engineering excellence, and industrialization capabilities, we enable BASF to turn opportunities into production-ready systems – consistently, reliably, and at scale. About the Job: AI Data Architect in a project-oriented team who designs scalable, enterprise-grade data architectures and leads the engineering of robust data platforms, collaborating across domains and teams to enable the development and industrialization of AI solutions that deliver measurable business value. RESPONSIBILITIES Define and own the end-to-end data architecture for AI solutions, from ingestion and storage to serving layers powering models and analytics (e.g., batch pipelines, real-time APIs). Design the data foundations for compound AI systems, including retrieval architectures (e.g. RAG), vector and knowledge stores, and feature/embedding layers. Establish data modelling standards, semantic layers, and reusable reference architectures across workloads (batch, streaming, real-time, analytical, AI-driven) across the organization. Define and enforce governance frameworks for data quality, lineage, security, and compliance, ensuring trustworthy and well-managed data products. Set architectural guidelines and best practices for scalable data platforms and pipelines, and ensure their consistent adoption Provide technical leadership and guidance to data engineers, data scientists, and business partners on data and AI architecture. Evaluate emerging technologies and define the strategic roadmap for the data and AI platform. Stay current with trends and best practices in data architecture, AI, and cloud platforms. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree or Master’s in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture, including designing data models, platforms, and end-to-end data pipelines. Proven experience defining data architecture for AI/analytics solutions on a major cloud platform (Azure preferred; AWS a plus) and Big Data architectures. Data architecture and modelling for relational and NoSQL systems, including modern storage paradigms (e.g., object storage, lakehouse, warehouse). Design of scalable data platforms and architectural patterns (e.g., Lakehouse, Data Mesh, Medallion), including governance, lineage, and quality considerations. Architecture of compound AI systems, including data layers for AI solutions (e.g., RAG, GraphRAG), vector stores, graph databases, and embedding pipelines. Strong programming skills in Python, including asynchronous programming (asyncio) and data processing. Apache Spark and Databricks platform Cloud data platform expertise, preferably Azure Could and Azure data platform services. Streaming and event-driven architectures, using streaming services such as RabbitMQ or Apache Kafka Big data and large-scale compute architectures, including batch and real-time processing patterns. Design of microservices and distributed systems, including API-based data services. Containerization and deployment practices using Docker (and Kubernetes as a plus) Data security, privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR), including encryption, access control, and data masking/anonymization Software engineering practices, including Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and DevOps (CI/CD with GitHub Actions) Container orchestration platforms: Kubernetes Graph database technologies and data modelling Workflow orchestration and task management frameworks such as Apache Airflow and Celery AI/ML platforms and cloud AI services LLM and agentic solution patterns, including prompt engineering and orchestration of AI agents. MLOps practices, including model lifecycle management, CI/CD for ML, deployment, monitoring, and retraining pipelines. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical architectures and influence decision-making across teams. WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities

jobs.name: Technician, Wastewater Treatment Plant
jobs.description: Objective of the position To serve as the technical authority and competent person for the wastewater treatment plant (WWTP), ensuring stable, optimized and compliant operation, To ensure proper management of sludge and related scheduled waste, in PGD Site in accordance with regulatory requirements. Safeguard site Watergate 3 & 4 discharges by ensuring only compliant effluent is released and promptly addressing any abnormal conditions. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities 1) Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Follow all EHS procedures, work instructions, and permit requirements. Utilize appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Support spill response, emergency preparedness, and waste-related incident investigations. Promote safe work practices and environmental awareness across the site. 2) WWTP Process Ownership & Optimization Own the overall performance and stability of the WWTP, including biological, chemical and physical treatment processes. Monitor, analyse and interpret process and laboratory data (e.g. COD, BOD, TSS, TN, NH3, pH, flow, MLSS and sludge characteristics) to optimize treatment performance, identify trends or deviations, and support proactive measures to prevent process failures. Establish operating limits, control strategies and performance benchmarks, and implement process improvement initiatives to enhance plant reliability and efficiency. Act as the Competent Person for the WWTP and ensure final effluent discharge complies with DOE standards and regulatory requirements. Ensure compliance with Scheduled Waste Regulations related to WWTP operations, including sludge handling and disposal activities. Maintain and verify the integrity, accuracy and completeness of process data, regulatory records and documentation, including effluent and sludge reports. Assist in troubleshooting process upsets, treatment inefficiencies and abnormal operating conditions. Act as the area owner for WWTP equipment and monitoring instruments, ensuring operational readiness, reliability and calibration compliance. Monitor equipment performance, identify recurring issues, coordinate corrective actions with the Maintenance team, and support predictive and preventive maintenance programs . 3) Sludge & Scheduled Waste Management Optimization Manage sludge generation, dewatering, handling and disposal activities arising from WWTP operations. Ensure proper classification of sludge and scheduled waste in accordance with regulatory requirements. Coordinate the storage, handling, collection and disposal of scheduled waste in compliance with regulatory and company requirements. Support initiatives to optimize sludge reduction and disposal efficiency. Maintain accurate sludge and scheduled waste inventories, records, logbooks and regulatory reporting. Coordinate with licensed contractors for scheduled waste collection and disposal activities. Monitor and inspect scheduled waste storage areas to ensure compliance with regulatory and safety requirements. Ensure proper segregation, labelling, storage and safe handling of scheduled waste. Identify, report and follow up on any non-compliance or safety concerns related to sludge and scheduled waste management. 4) Watergate Controls Control water gate releases based on the assessment of drainage water conditions, including COD and pH parameters. Report any abnormal drainage conditions that may result in non-compliance with DOE requirements. 5) Others Provide technical oversight for contractors involved in WWTP operation and maintenance. Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Production, EHS, and Maintenance). Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and the sharing of best practices. Participate in internal and external audits and inspections. Perform any other ad hoc tasks and projects as assigned by management. Job Requirements Minimum Diploma in Environmental Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Occupational Safety & Health, or related disciplines. 1–5 years of experience in scheduled waste management, environmental operations, or EHS-related functions. Experience in a manufacturing or chemical industry environment is preferred. Certified Environmental Professional in the Operation of Industrial Effluent Treatment Systems Physical- Chemical Processes ( CePIETSO-PCP) Certified Environmental Professional in the Operation of Industrial Effluent Treatment Systems Biological Processes ( CePIETSO-BP) Certified Environmental Professional Course in Scheduled Waste Management ( CePSWaM) Strong knowledge of industrial wastewater treatment processes, including biological (activated sludge, nitrification/denitrification), chemical and physical treatment systems Good understanding of process control principles and parameter optimization (e.g. COD, BOD, TSS, TN, NH3, pH, flow, MLSS) Ability to analyze, interpret and apply laboratory and operational data for process optimization and troubleshooting Good knowledge of sludge treatment, dewatering and handling processes, including characteristics, performance factors and optimization approaches Understanding of scheduled waste classification and regulatory requirements related to WWTP sludge management BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.description:
Now Hiring! Customer Site Service Representative II, Casa Grande, AZ Customer Site Service Representative II Job Location: Casa Grande, AZ If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. We are looking for a professional like you to join our team! As a Customer Site Service Representative, you will support the daily operation of Surventis products in Customer Automotive Assembly Plants by providing on-site technical and application knowledge. The role responds to customer requirements, enforces product quality/performance specification, and supports new product/application development. You will provide on-site expertise of product performance including color management, defect identification, and corrective action if necessary. S/he will develop and support customer relationships. This role supports the efforts of a Surventis sales/technical team to assure value to the customer for product technical support, problem investigation, analysis and resolution. The position assures product performance meets or exceeds customer expectations and supports business objectives to be our customer’s supplier of choice. The incumbent will demonstrate technical and professional expertise to enhance the Surventis reputation with the customer. S/he will integrate within the business and technical community to bring additional value to ECO coatings customers. The role controls key performance indicators within product service environments to drive problem resolution and product improvement initiatives critical to customer performance expectations. As a Customer Site Service Representative II, Casa Grande, AZ, your responsibilities will include... Supporting the daily operation of Surventis products in Customer Automotive Assembly Plants. Providing on-site technical and application expertise of product performance including defect identification, system maintenance, and corrective action if necessary. Assuring product performance meets or exceeds customer expectations and supports business objectives to be our customer’s supplier of choice. Responding to customer requirements, enforcing product quality/performance specification, and supporting new product/application development. Supports the efforts of a Surventis sales/technical team to assure value to the customer for product technical support, problem investigation, analysis, and resolution. Managing existing relationships and developing new ones. Acting as a capable leader and mentor to coach and develop team members as well as providing ready support for other facilities and customer locations. Being a subject matter expert in at least one technology of the coating process i.e.. Ecoat, prime, basecoat or clearcoat. Working in collaboration with e-coat tenders to maintain bath quality / parameters. Providing weekly samples to E-coat lab to meet targets. Maintaining material inventory and forecasting. Identifying opportunities for continuous improvement for presentation to management. If you have... Ability to develop and grow customer relationships, focusing on building a positive rapport with customers. jobs.name: Junior RCA Archer  (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. As a security expert in the Cyber Security Applications unit, you process complex requirements and changes and support end users in solving problems while taking into account and complying with existing SLAs, KPIs and OLAs. RESPONSIBILITIES You plan, install, configure and operate complex IT systems, support your Team members during error analysis and advise end users on problem solving. The security application systems used are in your area of responsibility, e.g. GRC RSA Archer, SIEM QRADAR, Stack Storm and OTRS. You take care of the lifecycle, patching the systems and fixing IT security gaps yourself. You are responsible for the connected quality assurance as well as a complete documentation of the changes within the knowledge base of the IS community. In addition, you participate in current customer projects and, if appropriate, also take on the management (sub-)projects or act as work stream lead. One challenge is to adapt the services to the changing IT landscape and to be ready for the cloud. QUALIFICATIONS You have a degree in (business) computer science or a technical education successfully completed in the IT area and subsequently gained professional experience in the support / development environment. You can demonstrate your ability to communicate within projects in English. You would also like to work in an international team and have strong analytical Skills as well as a high level of service and customer orientation that are complemented by your project management skills. BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided SALARY RANGE Competitive salary between €35,000 and €45,000 gross per year, depending on experience and fit for the role. At BASF, the chemistry is right. Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines. We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance. We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities. Vores produkter anvendes globalt i fødevare-, kosttilskuds- og medicinalindustrien, og vi beskæftiger ca. 130 engagerede medarbejdere. For at styrke vores produktionsteam søger vi nu en assisterende skiftholdsleder, der med både faglighed og personlighed kan være med til at holde vores høje kvalitet og sikre en stabil produktion. Vores værdisæt, Winning Behaviors, handler om ejerskab, fremdrift og et mindset præget af forbedringer – og vi leder efter en kollega, der deler disse værdier. HVAD DU KAN FORVENTE Som Assisterende Skiftholdsleder rapporterer du til Skiftholdslederen. Dine arbejdstider vil være i skifteholdsrotation. Jobbet indebære operatørarbejde der bidrage direkte til produktionen og du vil være en aktiv del af produktionsteamet. I fraværet af Skifteholdslederen påtager du dig rollen som funktionel leder, sikrer kontinuitet i produktionen og fungerer som det centrale koordinationspunkt under vagten. I denne situation vil dit fokus være på operationel udførelse og funktionel styring af teamet, mens personaleansvar og langsigtet udvikling forbliver hos Skiftholdslederen. Denne rolle giver en unik mulighed for at kombinere praktisk produktionsarbejde med operationelt ansvar og bidrage til høje standarder inden for sikkerhed, kvalitet og ydeevne. Jobbet er en oplagt karrierevej på vejen til jobbet som Skifteholdsleder. Arbejdstiden er skifteholdsarbejde efter en 3-holdsplan med dag-, aften- og nattevagter. Hverdagsvagter er på 8 timer, mens weekendvagter er på 12 timer. Ansvarområde Når du fungerer som Assisterende Skiftholdsleder, vil du have ansvar for at: •    Ansvarlig for de daglige produktionsoperationer under din tildelte vagt •    Sikre korrekt dokumentation og struktureret overdragelse mellem vagtskift •    Udførelse og opfølgning af produktionsplanen (output, timing, ressourceallokering) •    At tage øjeblikkelig handling ved afvigelser og sikre korrekt eskalering ved behov •    Fungere som bemyndiget udsteder af arbejdstilladelser og sikre korrekt udførelse af vedligehold og ikke-rutineopgaver •    Koordinere korrigerende og forebyggende vedligeholdelsesaktivitet under vagten •    Oprettelse, opfølgning og eskalering af vedligeholdelsesnotifikationer via SAP •    Tæt samarbejde med værkstedet og anvende tilkalde support efter behov •    Samarbejde med værkstedet og anvende tilkalde support efter behov Operatøransvar (når du ikke fungerer som Assisterende Skiftholdsleder) Når du arbejder som operatør er du en del af et engageret produktionsteam, der hver dag arbejder for at sikre en stabil og effektiv produktion af vitaminer i høj kvalitet. Efter oplæringsperiode vil du gradvist opbygge kompetencer til at kunne arbejde på tværs af produktionsområderne lager, fremstilling, blanding og pakning. Dine primære opgaver vil være at: •    Drift, overvågning og betjening af processen •    Klargøring af udstyr og procesområder •    Prøveudtagning og proceskontrol •    Skriftlig dokumentation og rapportering •    Rengøring af anlæg, udstyr og lokaler •    Tværgående samarbejde med kolleger om drift og optimering Supplerende ansvarsområde som Assisterende skifteholdsleder Ud over dine operatøropgaver forventes det, at du: •    Er en synlig rollemodel inden for sikkerhed og efterlevelse af gældende procedurer •    Understøtter gennemførelsen af produktionsplanen på dit skift •    Bidrager til et sikkert, effektivt og kvalitetsorienteret produktionsmiljø •    Går forrest i forhold til samarbejde, kommunikation og god adfærd på skiftet HVAD DU TILBYDER •    Du har erfaring fra et produktionsmiljø og med skifteholdsarbejde. Du har en solid forståelse af operationelle processer og sikkerhedsstandarder. •    Du er en proaktiv og pålidelig teamplayer, der er tryg ved at tage initiativ og træde ind i en koordinerende rolle, når det er nødvendigt. Du kan bevare overblik, prioritere opgaver og handle beslutsomt i dynamiske situationer. •    Du har stærke kommunikationsevner og kan vejlede og støtte kolleger under operationelle aktiviteter, hvilket sikrer klarhed og sammenhæng i udførelsen. •    Du har en solid forståelse for overholdelse af sikkerheds-, hygiejne- og kvalitetskrav i et GMP-reguleret fødevare eller farmaceutisk produktionsmiljø. •    Erfaring med SAP eller lignende systemer er en fordel. •    Gode dansk og engelsk kundskaber i skrift og tale •    Kørekort B (truckkort er et stort plus) •    Du trives i et aktivt job og er i god fysisk form, da en del af opgaverne kræver fysisk arbejde, f.eks løft, bevægelse, opgaver både i højder og mindre rum (confined space) HVAD VI TILBYDER Hos BASF får du: •    Ansvar og indflydelse fra første dag i et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø •    Mulighed for udvikling i jobbet •    Konkurrencedygtig løn og bonuspakke •    Bruttolønsordning og DSB erhvervskort •    Sundhedsordning, sundhedstjek, fysioterapi og adgang til træningsfaciliteter •    Et engageret team, hvor vidensdeling og samarbejde er centralt •    Kantineordning med varieret og lækker buffet •    En røgfri arbejdsplads SÅDAN SØGER DU JOBBET OG ANSØGNINGSFRIST Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig. Vores produkter anvendes globalt i fødevare-, kosttilskuds- og medicinalindustrien, og vi beskæftiger ca. 130 engagerede medarbejdere. For at styrke vores produktionsteam søger vi nu en skiftholdsleder, der med både faglighed og personlighed kan være med til at holde vores høje kvalitet og sikre en stabil produktion. Vores værdisæt, Winning Behaviors, handler om ejerskab, fremdrift og et mindset præget af forbedringer – og vi leder efter en kollega, der deler disse værdier. HVAD DU KAN FORVENTE Som Skiftholdsleder vil du rapportere til Produktionschefen og være en vigtig rolle i den daglige drift af vores produktionsanlæg. Du vil være leder for vores skiftholdsteams og sikre en stabil, sikker og effektiv produktion under dine tildelte vagter. Dine arbejdstider vil være i skifteholdsrotation og du vil have det fulde operationelt ansvar inden for dine arbejdstider, hvilket sikrer kontinuitet i produktionen og hurtig beslutningstagning, når det virkelig gælder. Jobbet kombinerer operationel ledelse med personaleledelse. Du vil fungerer som det centrale koordinationspunkt under din vagt og sikrer at produktionsplaner bliver udført, standarder overholdes, og afvigelser håndteres effektivt. Du vil bidrage direkte til at opretholde de høje standarder inden for produktion- og personalesikkerhed, kvalitet og udnyttelse af anlægskapacitet, samtidig med at du støtter den løbende udvikling af operatører og processer. Arbejdstiden er skifteholdsarbejde efter en 3-holdsplan med dag-, aften- og nattevagter. Hverdagsvagter er på 8 timer, mens weekendvagter er på 12 timer. Ansvarområde Som Skiftholdsleder vil dine ansvarsområder omfatte følgende: Operationelt ansvar: •    Ansvarlig for de daglige produktionsoperationer under din tildelte vagt •    Sikre korrekt dokumentation og struktureret overdragelse mellem vagtskift •    Udførelse og opfølgning af produktionsplanen (output, timing, ressourceallokering) •    Overvågning af kvalitet, sikkerhed, produktionsoutput og asset efficiency (AE) •    At tage øjeblikkelig handling ved afvigelser og sikre korrekt eskalere ved behov Personaleledelse: •    Lede og udvikle operatører i dit team •    Sikre kompetanceudvikling af operatørteamet •    Håndtere performance-, samarbejds- og adfærdsudfordringer konstruktivt og rettidigt Sikkerhed og overholdelse: •    Være en synlig rollemodel for sikkerhed og bidrage til en stærk sikkerhedskultur på tværs af skift •    Sikre overholdelse af GMP, fødevaresikkerhed, EHS-regler, procedurer og arbejdstilladelser •    Fungere som bemyndiget udsteder af arbejdstilladelser og sikre korrekt udførelse af vedligehold og ikke-rutineopgaver •    Gribe aktivt ind og stoppe arbejde ved usikre eller ikke overholdende situationer Vedligeholdelse og teknisk koordinering: •    Koordinere korrigerende og forebyggende vedligeholdelsesaktivitet under vagten •    Oprettelse og opfølgning af vedligeholdelsesnotifikationer i SAP •    Tæt samarbejde med værkstedet og anvende tilkalde support efter behov •    Sikring af rettidig respons på tekniske problemer, der påvirker produktionen HVAD DU TILBYDER Du har erfaring fra et produktionsmiljø med skifteholdsarbejde og trives i en hverdag med mange bolde i luften, hvor prioritering falder dig naturligt •    Du har erfaring med teamledelse og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem andre. •    Du er en hands-on leder, der tager ejerskab og handler beslutsomt– også i dynamiske og pressede situationer. •    Du arbejder struktureret, bevarer overblikket og formår at prioritere effektivt, selv når tempoet er højt. •    Du kombinerer stærke kommunikationsevner med evnen til at engagere og motivere folk. Du skaber klarhed, sætter forventninger og sikrer opfølgning, samtidig med at du bidrager til et positivt og samarbejdende teammiljø. •    Du har en solid forståelse for overholdelse af sikkerheds-, hygiejne- og kvalitetskrav i et GMP-reguleret fødevare eller farmaceutisk produktionsmiljø. VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES En tant que Préparateur Mécanicien, rattaché au Responsable Mécanique, vous contribuez à maintenir notre outil de production dans des conditions optimales, tout en garantissant la sécurité, la qualité et la performance opérationnelle. À ce titre, vous : Organisez, planifiez et suivez les interventions de maintenance mécanique et de travaux neufs, en optimisant les ressources humaines et matérielles ; Assistez le responsable mécanique et assurez un rôle de relais opérationnel, avec un appui technique sur les activités de mécanique et de tuyauterie ; Diagnostiquez les pannes, définissez les actions correctives et coordonnez les interventions en répartissant les tâches au sein de l’équipe ; Gérez les équipements et pièces de rechange (réparation, remise en état et remise en stock) afin d’assurer leur disponibilité et leur fiabilité ; Utilisez la GMAO (SAP) pour piloter les ordres de travail, tracer les interventions et analyser les historiques de maintenance ; Contribuez aux projets d’amélioration continue, notamment en matière de performance énergétique et de fiabilité industrielle ; Veillez au respect strict des exigences EHSQ, coordonnez les prestataires externes et contribuez à la culture sécurité du site. Informations supplémentaires : Travail dans un environnement industriel Seveso seuil haut. Processus en batch ou continu, exploitation 24/24h – 365 jours/an. Travail de journée. Après un an sur le poste, vous integrerez également le service d'astreinte maintenance. jobs.name: - Cyber Security Risk Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. We are seeking an experienced Cyber Security Risk Specialist to join our CISO organization. As part of the Cyber Security Risk Management team, you will contribute to the development, implementation, and maintenance of our cyber security risk management framework. RESPONSIBILITIES You will be a part of our Cyber Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Product Family, which is the pilar of the second Line of Defense (2LoD) and manages the Cyber Security Framework for the whole BASF Group, following a risk-based approach. One major part of that is to develop and implement risk management tools, policies, and procedures in line with ISO 27001 and other relevant standards. Your core responsibilities will be: Provide support to Asset Owners and Risk Owners to facilitate the operationalization of Cyber Risk Management-related processes across both IT and OT (Automation Technology) environments, Foster collaboration with our global Risk Community, incl. OT stakeholders, by actively gathering their feedback, while effectively communicating updates and enhancements to ensure alignment and engagement. Provide awareness materials and moderate training sessions on Cyber Security Risk Management with dedicated modules for OT environments to promote continuous learning and compliance towards BASF Business Units Derive new processes or pilots to strengthen GRC in response to the evolving threat landscape in IT and OT (Automation Technology) Conduct research on new threats by leveraging different sources such as Google Threat Intelligence or Dragos Execute strategic risk assessments on-demand to identify and evaluate emerging risks in IT and OT, including risks to production continuity, safety, and environmental impact, that could negatively affect or harm BASF Maintain and improve the toolset that our team provides (RSA Archer, Power BI, Knowledge Base within SharePoint) ensuring integration of OT-specific risk scenarios, asset classifications, and network segmentation (e.g., Purdue model layers) Aggregate operational risks and translate asset-specific risks to generic risk scenarios on enterprise level to support senior management reporting and strategic as well as tactical decision-making Support the lifecycle update of group-wide cyber security governance regulations based on generic BASF risk landscape Work closely with cross-functional teams to support compliance of risk management processes with ISMS according to ISO 27001 and OT security requirements Collaborate with Asset Owners and Risk Owners to maintain a risk register of IT and OT risks and associated risk treatment plans up to date Monitor and report on the effectiveness of risk management controls including OT-specific compensating controls (e.g., network segmentation, jump hosts, monitoring) and support the reporting of significant risks to senior management. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field Experience with developing, implementing, and maintaining an ISMS based on ISO 27001 and familiarity with IEC 62443 or comparable OT security frameworks Profound experience in cyber security, particularly in GRC and cyber security risk management across IT and OT environments Strong experience in security for automation and laboratory environments, including industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA, DCS, PLCs, and LIMS/PIMSSolid understanding of OT architectures and concepts (e.g., Purdue Model, network segmentation, zones and conduits) and their implications for cyber risk management Strong understanding of risk management principles, frameworks and practices, especially in the field of risk aggregation as well as definition and evaluation of generic risks on enterprise level Experience with risk assessments, cyber threats and vulnerabilities Knowledge of relevant laws and regulations related to cyber security and OT security Ability to bridge communication between IT security teams and OT/engineering stakeholders in production environments Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal team members and cross-functional teams Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC are a plus additional OT-focused certifications (e.g., GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443) are highly desirable BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right. Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines. We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance. We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities. Contact Do you have any questions about the application process or the position? Please reach out to Felipe Bianco ( felipe.bianco@partners.basf.com )

jobs.name: Global Customs Preferential Management & Rules of Origin (Senior Executive)
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position The purpose of this role is to ensure full compliance with international trade regulations and to optimize the use of Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) across global operations. Within Preferential Management, the role is critical to safeguarding BASF against financial and reputational risks by ensuring the accurate determination and application of preferential origin in accordance with national customs laws. The position supports the systematic determination of preferential origin through the collection and validation of supplier declarations (long-term and single use), as well as the analysis of key data such as product compositions (BOMs) and pricing structures. This enables the accurate issuance of Free Trade Certificates and Origin Declarations for both customer and intercompany transactions. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Responsible to coordinate and conduct analysis of all products subject to the Free Trade Agreements (FTA) and prepare and maintain data and documentation required by these FTAs. Collaborate, coordinate and recommend best practices with BU senior leadership, Customs Country Experts as well as the Management Team in Customs to ensure FTA processes are optimized and supported in the global KPI report. Ability to work flexibly and collaborate with stakeholders across different time zones. Participate in and organize the Preference Management regular meetings and align cost and KPI measures Responsible for the solicitation of data and documentation, such as FTA certificates and long-term supplier agreements, from BASF suppliers to obtain cost avoidance status for the various BU’s and BASF legal entities. Responsible for communication with BASF customers and senior leaders within the BASF business units to ensure that FTA responses and requirements are met Responsible for assisting with additional duty management opportunities for the Customs organization, both regionally and globally Responsible for the coordination and support of the implementation of process and system changes related to Free Trade Agreements in collaboration with IT and process owners Responsible for the operational implementation of applicable customs authorizations and regulatory requirements related to Free Trade Agreements Prepare, maintain, and update operational reports by tracking FTA-related activities, including the number of certificates issued, supplier declarations processed, and transactions by customer, product, and legal entity; ensure accurate data recording and timely updates to support daily operational monitoring and control. Requirements Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Business Administration, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline. Working experience Experience in the chemical industry and/or a Chemical Engineering background would be an advantage. 3-5 Years of professional experience in Preferential Origin determination and Free Trade Agreements Technical Skills (mandatory): Experience in Custo ms and/or Foreign Trade law Ability to work flexibly and collaborate with stakeholders across different time zones. Strong technical knowledge of HS tariff classification, rules of origin, and customs valuation principles Proficiency in data management and reporting, including the use of Excel or similar tools to track and maintain trade compliance and operational data Understand BASF Organization and Culture Know how on Products and Markets Strong communication and argumentation skills Analytical thinking Structured work organization Strong teamwork competence Experience in project management is desirable Good knowledge of the SAP master data systems and SAP GTS Strong service and customer orientation Ability to balance service orientation with compliance requirements BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre was established in 2005. Located in Kuala Lumpur, the regional service hub has about 1,200 employees and growing. Focused on being a competency and digitalization driven hub, it also provides quality functional and know-how services in the areas of finance, controlling, human resources, real estate and facilities management, communications, environmental, health and safety, procurement, import-export order management, and information services to BASF companies and affiliates in the Asia Pacific region. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay that cover the Europe and Americas regions. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises six segments: Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €68.9 billion in 2023. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the U.S. Further information at www.basf.com .

jobs.name: Financial Reporting (Analyst) - 1 year contract
jobs.description: ​​​​​​ Objectives of the Position Independently in delivering Financial Reporting services to BSSCKL’s customers in accordance with established Financial Reporting processes and work procedures and in compliance with BASF policies & guidelines, internal control requirements, local company legal and statutory requirements. Ensure that timelines and quality meet the agreed service levels and targets. To support and provide guidance to Analysts in performing Financial Reporting tasks. To back up, assist with and perform Financial Reporting tasks as required. Main Tasks Functional Tasks (including but not limited to): Independently provide Financial Reporting transaction processing support and ensuring delivery quality in terms of accuracy, completeness and timeliness on daily basis. Perform and analyse booking of accounting transactions, fixed asset transactions, master data maintenance and account reconciliation including account clearing. Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, trend analysis and transaction posting checks. Prepare and coordinate for month-end, quarter-end, year-end and statutory financial reports for BASF companies across Asia Pacific on timely, accurate and complete basis. This would include reports for group reporting, internal management reporting, statutory reporting as well as any agreed ad hoc reports required e.g. audit schedules, tax schedules etc. Trouble shoot and liaise with relevant stakeholders to resolve issues and queries related to Financial Reporting processes. Contribute or participate in working groups (i.e. Smart Close, Final Sprint, RRM, CbCR & etc.) with specific expertise knowledge. Perform back up and other duties as and when required or delegated. Compliance and Quality: Participate in any compliance audits and respond to audit queries. Responsible in ensuring all work documentations and work processes are updated in compliance to BASF policies & guidelines, Financial Reporting Compliance requirements, local company legal and statutory requirements. Continuous Improvement and Projects: Identify, recommend and implement solutions for continuous improvement opportunities. Contribute and drive the implementation of project initiatives e.g. technology enhancement, internal control, merger and acquisition etc. Lead local projects and participate in regional projects. Knowledge Management: Contribute inputs to maintain and update a set of comprehensive and complete training materials of Financial Reporting functional training. Contribute to Financial Reporting internal control measures. Contribute to knowledge database by updating company specific procedures and issue logs (including resolution and preventive action) to facilitate continuous learning, development and knowledge retention. Support new and existing team members through effective knowledge transfer and sharing of best practice for sustainable development of knowledge within the team. Conduct functional training in accordance with established training structure (when necessary). Frequent collaboration with relevant stakeholders: Counterparts in BASF companies, internal/external auditors, external consultants and BSSCKL cross functional units. Specialists, Experts, Assistant Managers, Managers, Department Head, Analysts and peers. Corporate Finance unit. Global Financial Reporting functional units. Degree of Supervision Required in the job: Work with minimal supervision. Minimum Education and Qualification Required for the Position Education: University degree in finance and accounting or business studies; and/or Chartered or Certified Professional Accountant or equivalent. Working Experience: Minimum 3 years’ experiences in Financial Reporting or other accounting function. Competent candidates with lesser years of experience are considerable. Preferably experience working in SAP system or other major ERP system’s work environment. Experience in a shared service or business process outsourcing engagement will be an added advantage. Experience working in a MNC or Malaysian Public listed company preferred. Technical & Professional Knowledge: Knowledge and understanding of Financial Reporting and other accounting functions. Knowledge and experience of MS office tools. Proficiency in English and other language required with good communication skill.

jobs.description: Main Objectives Be accountable for end-to-end customer service excellence for the Care Chemicals business across Asia Pacific. Ensure reliable order fulfillment, superior and consistent customer experience, and operational resilience, while driving regional standardization, digitalization, and continuous improvement in close partnership with Sales, Supply Chain Operations and other relevant functions. Play a critical part in protecting revenue, strengthening long term customer trust, and enabling profitable growth, by building a high performing, customer centric organization capable of operating effectively in a complex, multi-country environment. This role also requires close monitoring of legal, political, and economic developments, translation into end‑to‑end customs processes, and deep‑dive data analytics to support risk assessments, audits, and management reporting. Main Tasks Customs Governance, Policies & Procedures Define, maintain, and govern global customs policies, guidelines, and standard procedures covering import, export, bonded warehouse, special customs regimes (e.g. inward processing, duty drawback), FTAs, Free Trade Zones, and excise management Ensure global availability, accuracy, and validity of customs documentation in the GB Rule Base and Customs ICS Initiate and control implementation of regional and national deviations to reflect specific legal requirements while maintaining global consistency Audit, Risk & Compliance Management Initiate, coordinate, and perform process‑oriented risk assessments including documentation and annual follow‑up within the BASF Customs Internal Control System Conduct spot checks, compliance reviews, and follow‑ups on deviations jointly with Customs Audit & Legal Advisory teams Monitor court decisions, new laws, regulations, and customs agreements, translating impacts into policies, procedures, and business guidance Stakeholder & Cross ‑ Functional Coordination Actively engage and align with Customs Communities of Practice, SDU Heads, Country Leads, and Custodians to ensure global process adherence Closely align with Process Design Teams to implement required changes in the customs process landscape Serve as the central global contact for customs‑relevant M&A activities, ensuring consistent, structured, and legally compliant customs input across projects Data Analytics, Reporting & Training Perform deep‑dive analysis of internal and external customs data and present results in standardized visual formats (e.g. dashboards) Conduct global and regional knowledge transfer and training for Customs Custodians, regional units, and hubs Act as project coordinator for global customs initiatives and improvements Requirements Strong BASF business and Supply Chain Operations knowledge across regions (Asia, EMEA, Americas) Expert knowledge of Customs & Foreign Trade regulations, including audit and compliance processes Experience working with customs authorities, brokers, and external advisory partners Strong communication, stakeholder management, and argumentation skills Excellent analytical thinking and structured working methodology Strong teamwork competence and project management capability Very good knowledge of SAP master data systems and SAP GTS will be an advantage English (fluent in spoken and written) The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. Unvorstellbar! Als Chemikant:in übernimmst Du anspruchsvolle Aufgaben im gesamten Herstellungsprozess: vom Bereitstellen der Inhaltsstoffe bis zur Abfüllung der fertigen Lacke. Du bedienst und überwachst die Produktionsanlagen, entnimmst regelmäßig Proben und analysierst die Produkte – einschließlich der Dokumentation. Damit bekommst Du nicht nur einen Einblick in unsere spannende Produktwelt, sondern bist bei der Produktion mittendrin statt nur dabei. Du wirkst daran mit, dass wir die besten Produkte herstellen. DAS LERNST DU WÄHREND DEINER AUSBILDUNG Verantwortung für Vorbereitung, Steuerung und Überwachung der Produktionsprozesse Mitwirken bei der Verfahrensentwicklung zur Herstellung chemischer Produkte aus organischen und anorganischen Rohstoffen Durchführen von Wartungsarbeiten Entnahme von Produktproben und Untersuchungen im Labor Erhalten der hohen Standards bei Umweltschutz und Arbeitssicherheit DAS BRINGST DU MIT Fachoberschulreife Begeisterung für Chemie und Technik Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit großes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Genauigkeit und Sorgfalt beim Arbeiten DAS BIETEN WIR IN DEINER AUSBILDUNG eine spannende Ausbildung mit Besuch des Hans-Böckler-Berufskollegs in Münster (Westfalen) verschiedenste Einblicke in unterschiedlichste Abteilungen wie bspw. Infrastrukturbetriebe, Lackproduktion und Harzfabrik attraktive Vergütung – Du startest mit über 1.200 € im 1. Ausbildungsjahr und erhältst zahlreiche Zusatzleistungen (z. B.: Weihnachtsgeld, 700 € Urlaubsgeld) wir übernehmen Dich bei erfolgreichem Ausbildungsabschluss– versprochen! Verkürzung der Ausbildung bei entsprechender Leistung möglich 30 Tage Urlaub maßgeschneiderte Schulungsangebote in Form von Seminaren und Workshops zum Weiterentwickeln deiner persönlichen und fachlichen Fähigkeiten Freizeitangebote (z. B. betriebliches Fitnessstudio), Mitarbeiterevents und Teilnahme an Azubiprojekten (z. B. Kennenlernfahrt) AUSBILDUNG GESCHAFFT - WAS DANN ? Deine Ausbildung ist der Startpunkt: Bei herausragenden persönlichen und fachlichen Leistungen unterstützen wir deine individuelle Entwicklung – ob durch fachliche Weiterbildungen, Spezialisierungen oder eine weiterführende Qualifizierung.
