Todas las candidaturas cualificadas que cubran el perfil para una posición se considerarán para nuestras vacantes sin distinción de edad, ciudadanía, tono de piel, religión, sexo, estado civil, nacionalidad, discapacidad, identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual,  origen étnico, lengua, identidad indígena, apariencia física, condiciones de salud, características genéticas, embarazo, religión, opiniones políticas, académicas o filosóficas, identidad o filiación política, por su forma de pensar, vestir, actuar, gesticular, por tener tatuajes o perforaciones corporales o cualquier otra condición análoga protegida por la ley del país correspondiente. En BASF, estamos comprometidos con la inclusión, proporcionando siempre que sea posible, ajustes razonables a las personas con discapacidad o con alguna necesidad específica, para garantizar su acceso y el uso de servicios. En caso de requerir algún apoyo, favor de comunicarlo durante tu primer contacto con Atracción de Talento. Estamos buscando un(a) Gerente de Servicio al Cliente. El objetivo de la posición será liderar y gestionar la operación de Servicio al Cliente para la Unidad de Negocio EM de Estados Unidos desde México, contribuyendo al crecimiento sostenible del negocio. Esta posición será responsable de facilitar y optimizar los procesos comerciales regionales a través de un equipo, impulsando la implementación de indicadores clave, la mejora continua de procesos y la adopción de herramientas que garanticen una gestión ágil, eficiente y transparente. El rol busca fortalecer la cercanía con los clientes, promover la excelencia operativa y asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos estratégicos y comerciales de la organización. En este rol estarás a cargo de: Dirigir el proceso de Servicio al Cliente, incluyendo la facturación derivada de las distintas entregas de productos y terminales, alineado con la estrategia del negocio y asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas comerciales y de calidad, garantizando entregas oportunas y el cumplimiento de los requerimientos de los clientes. Liderar un equipo de profesionales de Servicio al Cliente en sus responsabilidades operativas diarias, impulsando iniciativas estratégicas y de mejora continua, y asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos. Identificar y priorizar desafíos y oportunidades, desarrollando y ejecutando planes de acción orientados a la mejora continua y a la optimización del desempeño general. Coordinar y asegurar entregables claros, estableciendo y cumpliendo plazos, gestionando acciones pendientes, compartiendo información con los stakeholders clave, facilitando la toma de decisiones, promoviendo la colaboración y presentando resultados finales. Colaborar con líderes y stakeholders clave en iniciativas operativas destinadas a optimizar la eficacia y eficiencia de los procesos de Servicio al Cliente, incluyendo Order to Cash, gestión de precios, reportes de negocio, entre otros. Identificar oportunidades para mejorar los niveles de servicio y aumentar la productividad mediante el análisis de datos y la generación de insights que impulsen mejoras sostenibles. Si cuentas con: Título universitario en Administración, Cadena de Suministro, Logística o carreras afines. Entre 8 y 10 años de experiencia liderando operaciones de Servicio al Cliente y Supply Chain, gestionando equipos de alto desempeño e impulsando iniciativas de transformación, gestión del cambio y mejora continua. Experiencia trabajando en organizaciones globales y entornos altamente colaborativos, con responsabilidad sobre clientes estratégicos, gestión de stakeholders clave y operaciones orientadas a los mercados de Estados Unidos y/o Canadá. Dominio de SAP aplicado a procesos de Customer Service y Supply Chain. Nivel de inglés avanzado, tanto oral como escrito. ¡Esta vacante es para ti! Crea tu propia química: Lo que te ofrecemos ... Todas las candidaturas cualificadas que cubran el perfil para una posición se considerarán para nuestras vacantes sin distinción de edad, ciudadanía, tono de piel, religión, sexo, estado civil, nacionalidad, discapacidad, identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual,  origen étnico, lengua, identidad indígena, apariencia física, condiciones de salud, características genéticas, embarazo, religión, opiniones políticas, académicas o filosóficas, identidad o filiación política, por su forma de pensar, vestir, actuar, gesticular, por tener tatuajes o perforaciones corporales o cualquier otra condición análoga protegida por la ley del país correspondiente. En BASF, estamos comprometidos con la inclusión, proporcionando siempre que sea posible, ajustes razonables a las personas con discapacidad o con alguna necesidad específica, para garantizar su acceso y el uso de servicios. En caso de requerir algún apoyo, favor de comunicarlo durante tu primer contacto con Atracción de Talento. Estamos buscando un(a) Jefe(a) de Servicio al Cliente. El objetivo de la posición será gestionar la estrategia de servicio al cliente para la cartera asignada del negocio de Químicos Intermedios de Norteamérica, garantizando la satisfacción de los clientes en Estados Unidos y Canadá, a través del liderazgo de un equipo diverso y de la gestión de cuentas clave del negocio. La posición impulsará iniciativas alineadas con los objetivos del negocio, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas, los procedimientos internos y las regulaciones aplicables, así como también promoverá la mejora continua de los procesos y el desarrollo de relaciones sólidas y de largo plazo con los clientes. En este rol estarás a cargo de: Liderar un equipo de profesionales de Servicio al Cliente, asegurando la excelencia operativa, la mejora continua y el cumplimiento de las políticas, procedimientos y normativas aplicables. Gestionar cuentas estratégicas y fungir como punto de contacto principal para los clientes en temas relacionados con pedidos, proporcionando respuestas oportunas y precisas a sus consultas. Desarrollar y fortalecer relaciones de largo plazo con los clientes, promoviendo una comunicación proactiva y la resolución eficaz de problemas e incidencias. Comunicar de manera clara y oportuna el estado de los pedidos, posibles retrasos, riesgos e impactos asociados, tanto a clientes como a stakeholders internos. Coordinar iniciativas y actividades operativas, definiendo prioridades, estableciendo planes de acción, dando seguimiento a compromisos y facilitando la toma de decisiones para asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos. Promover el crecimiento y desarrollo del equipo a través de mentoría, coaching, planes de desarrollo y programas de capacitación orientados a fortalecer capacidades y maximizar el desempeño. Establecer relaciones de colaboración con líderes funcionales y stakeholders clave para desarrollar e implementar iniciativas operativas que maximicen la efectividad y eficiencia de las operaciones de Servicio al Cliente, incluyendo procesos de Order to Cash, Administración de Precios, Reporteo de Negocio y otras actividades relacionadas. Asegurar el cumplimiento de los indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) del área, tales como OTIF (On Time In Full) y el porcentaje de órdenes recibidas a través de canales de comercio electrónico (eCommerce), entre otros. Identificar oportunidades de mejora de procesos y apoyar la implementación de iniciativas. Investigar y gestionar no conformidades y quejas relacionadas con el servicio. Si cuentas con: Formación académica en Ingeniería Química, Administración de Empresas, Logística, Cadena de Suministros o carreras afines. Experiencia sólida en Servicio al Cliente, con liderazgo de equipos y gestión de procesos complejos de cadena de suministro en entornos dinámicos e interfuncionales. Se valorará especialmente la exposición a los mercados de Estados Unidos y/o Canadá, así como la interacción con clientes y equipos regionales en dichos mercados. Experiencia en la adopción y uso de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial. Dominio de SAP aplicado a procesos de Customer Service y Supply Chain. jobs.name: HR Business Partner - Southfield, MI
jobs.description:
Job Title: Human Resources Business Partner – Refinish Coatings (RFN) North America Now hiring! Human Resources Business Partner Southfield, MI We are looking for a Human Resources Business Partner to join our Refinish team in Southfield, MI! New finish, Proven expertise. Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding.  Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. The role: Join us as an HR Business Partner supporting Refinish Coatings (RFN) North America, a business entering an exciting new chapter as part of our transition to an independent organization. This role is far more than traditional HR business partnering; it is an opportunity to help shape the future of a growth-focused business undergoing transformation. You will partner directly with commercial and functional leaders across the RFN organization, helping build the capabilities, culture, organization, and leadership required to accelerate growth and create shareholder value. As a trusted advisor, you will influence business decisions, challenge conventional thinking, and help leaders navigate change while ensuring we attract, retain, develop, and engage exceptional talent. The ideal candidate is an entrepreneur at heart - someone who thrives in dynamic environments, embraces ambiguity, and sees HR as a lever for business performance. We are looking for a leader who understands that people strategies should drive revenue growth, productivity, organizational effectiveness, and long-term value creation. As part of the North America Human Resources team, you will work closely with business leaders, Centers of Excellence, and global stakeholders to build a high-performing organization that can compete and win in the marketplace. This is an opportunity to leave a lasting impact on a business redefining its future. As a Human Resources Business Partner, you will... View HR through a business lens and understand how organizational decisions impact growth, profitability, productivity, and customer success. You connect people strategy directly to business outcomes and help leaders make informed decisions that create measurable value. Thrive in fast-moving environments and naturally seek opportunities to improve, simplify, and transform. You are energized by building something new, challenging the status quo, and identifying creative solutions that enable business success. Serve as a trusted thought partner to senior leaders, providing candid feedback, organizational insights, and practical recommendations. Your strong business acumen allows you to influence decisions on talent, structure, capability, and culture. Lead organizations through transformation with confidence and credibility. Whether supporting organizational redesign, capability building, workforce planning, or cultural evolution, you help leaders navigate complexity and deliver sustainable results. Understand that talent is a competitive advantage. You drive succession planning, leadership development, performance management, and workforce strategies that strengthen organizational capability and prepare the business for future growth. Continuously look for opportunities to increase organizational effectiveness, improve productivity, strengthen leadership, and optimize talent investments. You focus on outcomes, not activity, ensuring Human Resources initiatives contribute directly to business performance. Build strong partnerships across functions, geographies, and leadership levels. You bring people together to solve problems, share best practices, and deliver results for the business. Embrace technology, analytics, and AI to improve decision-making, simplify processes, and enhance the employee experience. You leverage data and insights to identify opportunities and drive measurable business outcomes. Build organizational capability that accelerates business growth. Develop leaders who drive accountability, engagement, and performance. Create scalable people solutions that support business transformation. Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve organizational effectiveness. Serve as a trusted business advisor who contributes directly to RFN's value creation agenda. If you have... Demonstrated success partnering with commercial, sales, or growth-oriented organizations. Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to connect people decisions to business performance. Experience supporting organizational transformation, restructuring, integration, or change initiatives. Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive strategic workforce decisions. Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward action and continuous improvement. Exceptional communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills. Experience utilizing data, analytics, and technology to guide decision-making. Bachelor's Degree required; Master's Degree, MBA, or advanced HR certifications preferred. Privacy statement Surventis takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. jobs.description:
Welcome If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding.Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us.At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. About The Role To ensure treasury governance and operational efficiency in China. How You Will Do It Cash planning and financing management Coordinate with all entities for cash flow forecast in direct method. Assist on the execution of WOFE entities financing proposal, include capital injection, intercompany loan , external borrowing and JV dividend payment. Coordinate facility line annual review and audit treasury related. Bank account management Bank structure / bank account set up and maintenance in considering the RTC cash management arrangement, local practice, and local regulation requirements. Manage e-banking access, related functions setup. Lead to coordinate the annual bank account inspection and internal & external audit affairs related to bank account Payment Approval Work with P2P team for paying banks communications Closely monitor each bank account balance and arrange funds transfer as needed Execute payment approvals by evaluating cash positions from liquidity perspective Trade finance and daily cash management Ensure smooth operation & provide consultancy on bank guarantee and letter of credit related affairs Maintain and enhance relationship with local banks to ensure bank facilities are executed and implemented smoothly Support on the foreign bank’s credit facilities review and implementation Daily cash position monitoring and cash pooling management FX management Assist to maintain a good working relationship with SAFE. Provide support to ad hoc inquiries to business partners. Ensure periodical and ad-hoc SAFE reporting on time and accurate submission Assist regional treasury team on the readiness of valid dealing mandate and other requirements BAD / CAD management Keep updated and implement treasury guidelines on BAD / CAD. Communicate with different banks for BAD/CAD quotations and get approved for discounting. Maintain BAD list on monthly basis Projects Support Assist new company set up and old company liquidation with regard to treasury matters Fulfil other ad hoc projects assigned by supervisor. Others Support on expatriate related banking affairs, e.g., bank card affairs coordination. What We Look For Bachelor’s degree or above with major in finance, accounting, or economics. At least 4-5 years’ working experiences in treasury areas. MNC treasury experience will be a plus Good communication skills in spoken and written English. Good command of Microsoft Office incl. Excel, Power point etc. [[LEGAL_ENTITY_OBJ]] Notice regarding responsibility and data processing The job offers published on this platform relate exclusively to positions at . jobs.name: Officer, Customer Service, Care Chemicals - Mandarin Speaking
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position Ensure accurate, timely, and compliant execution of end‑to‑end Order‑to‑Cash (OTC) processes. Deliver professional and consistent customer service to assigned customers and accounts. Support Customer Service Supervisors and cross‑functional partners to ensure stable operations and customer satisfaction. Contribute to process discipline, service quality, and continuous improvement in daily operations. Main Tasks 1. Order‑to‑Cash (OTC) Operations Create, maintain, and process sales orders in SAP, including order creation, changes, and completion. Monitor order status, delivery progress, and invoice status; follow up with planners, logistics, and supply units to ensure on‑time fulfillment. Proactively communicate delivery updates, order changes, and exceptions to customers and internal stakeholders. Handle returns, credit notes, debit notes, and other exceptional order scenarios according to procedures. 2. Customer Interaction & Service Management Act as the primary contact for customer enquiries, requests, and service‑related issues. Ensure professional, timely, and solution‑oriented communication with customers. Support long‑term customer relationships through reliable service execution and customer focus. Coordinate closely with Sales to align on customer priorities and service expectations. 3. Documentation & Compliance Prepare and verify order‑related and shipping documentation in a timely and accurate manner. Ensure compliance with internal policies, trade regulations, and customer requirements. Maintain accurate master data and transactional data in SAP systems. 4. Complaint & Issue Handling Register and manage customer complaints in the NCM system. Coordinate with internal stakeholders (Quality, Logistics, Sales, Finance) to resolve issues effectively. Support investigation, corrective actions, and follow‑up communication with customers. Requirement: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or equivalent experience. Minimum 2 years of experience in Customer Service, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related operational roles. Hands‑on experience with OTC processes in a B2B environment. Solid SAP system knowledge and good PC skills for daily operations. Familiarity with foreign trade practices and customer service procedures. Strong sense of responsibility, customer orientation, and attention to detail. Ability to manage routine operations independently and escalate issues appropriately.

export and customs community and initiatives and projects relevant to supply chain operations serviced by Global Business Service • Responsible for establishment, adherence, and adequate documentation and digitalization initiatives Main Tasks General • Responsible for import export and customs operations targets, performance, deliverables and compliance • Responsible for service provider management subject matter advice to business, country, regional and global stakeholders, • Collaborate and support Japan supply chain caretaker in country operational matters and with regional shipping management, operational vendor management and regional customs • Active participation in global, regional, and country level projects and initiatives for companywide projects, continuous improvement, and business requirement, where relevant to the scope of service Customs & Foreign Trade • Responsible compliance to company policies and local regulatory and statutory requirements specifically on customs and trade • Responsible for customs operations processing by both internal team and service providers to ensure accurate duty & import tax processing up to duty payment processing within the scope of customs and foreign trade team. adherence to rules as stipulated in the respective trade agreements • Responsible for customs broker management in line with global policies and customs broker management framework and guidelines • (including access management) • Continuous improvement of overall Import / Export management, carrier, and service provider operations. • Risk management of LSP partnership, compliance and overall transport management • Cost management of LSP services National Trade Compliance • Act as National Trade Compliance Officer (NTCO) for Japan • Monitor & interpret trade compliance relevant regulatory changes; derive business impact • Evaluate regulated goods and sanctioned parties against national laws relevant o trade compliance • Maintain the Internal Compliance Program (ICP) for own jurisdiction Minimum Education and Qualification Required for the Position • Education: Degree in Business Administration or equivalent, Supply Chain Management, and other Degree with relevant work jobs.name: Senior Officer, Customer Service, Care Chemicals - Japanese Speaking 1
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position Ensure accurate, timely, and compliant execution of end to end Order to Cash (OTC) processes with efficient and demonstrate high level of reliability. Demonstrate supervision skills to support the Customer Service team, ensuring service quality, compliance, and continuous capability development for the responsible countries. Act as a key interface for key customer accounts, supporting business continuity, issue resolution, and long term customer relationships. Support GBU in achieving KPIs and business targets through strong operational execution, process expertise, and data transparency. Job Requirements: Customer Service Operations & OTC Operation Manage order management activities, including order creation, changes, delivery coordination, invoicing and follow‑up, and exception handling. Monitor order status, supply availability, and delivery progress and performance; proactively communicate changes to customers as required and internal stakeholders. Ensure accurate and timely documentation handling (e.g. shipping documents, etc). Manage returns, credit / debit notes, and customer complaints via NCM system, ensuring timely resolution and feedback loop closure. Supervisory & Team Support Responsibilities Provide day‑to‑day supervision, coaching, and guidance to Customer Service team members. Support workload allocation, priority setting, and escalation handling. Act as a role model for service mindset, compliance, and customer focus. Support team capability building, knowledge sharing, and onboarding of new team members. Key Account Handling Serve as primary or senior service contact for assigned key customer accounts. Coordinate closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, and Production to ensure stable service and issue resolution. Support customer relationship development by ensuring consistent service quality and operational excellence. Provide structured communication and updates to key customers during supply constraints or service disruptions. Process Expertise & Cross‑Functional Collaboration Act as process expert for assigned OTC‑related processes (e.g. master data, credit management, NCM, quality coordination). Serve as key contact across teams for process alignment and best‑practice sharing. Support GBU heads and Sales with business analysis, service performance insights, and operational inputs Systems, Data & Continuous Improvement Ensure correct and efficient use of SAP systems in daily operations. Act as SAP Power User, supporting reporting, analysis, and user guidance within the team. Identify service gaps and improvement opportunities; support implementation of process optimization and standardization initiatives. Contribute to data accuracy, transparency, and KPI monitoring for customer service performance. Lead and support adhoc projects as required Job requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or equivalent experience. Minimum 5 years of experience in Customer Service, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related operational roles. Proven experience in OTC processes and customer interaction in a B2B environment. Prior experience in team support or supervisory role is required. Strong SAP knowledge; SAP Power User capability is an advantage. Good understanding of foreign trade practices and documentation. Strong customer orientation with structured problem solving skills. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and handle pressure in a dynamic environment. Excellent team player with good communication skills About BASF BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

Responsible for the safety of the workplace with fulfilling the requirement from both local organization and regional requirements. Aligns Technical Development resources with local sales needs to achieve trial and troubleshooting requests. Analyzes all opportunities, Identifies, coordinates, and follows up development of new customers business, new applications, relevant processing technologies. Coaches & drives Technical Development team in all customer/processing related requests. Aligns Technical Development resources with country Sales head to achieve local sales team support requirements. Secures Know-how/IP protection with PMD/Technical Development teams. Work closely with product management team to ensure reliable supply, monitor RM/FG cost and process optimization project to ensure competitiveness on market. Ensure that lab equipment for CASE in ATDC (Application & Technical Development Center) is well-maintained, always calibrated in desired frequency and in perfect working condition, particularly equipment used in daily Quality Control. Technical support of market strategy: Drive as a coordinate to consolidate ASEAN CASE business update (data collection from CASE ASEAN Sales colleagues) & project update for timely and monthly update/report to CASE regional team. Identify and provide the guidance on CASE target applications, mapping with ASEAN country requirements. Provide technical inputs/ recommendation to strategy development. Visit customers to collect and analyze field information for industry trends. Aligns Technical Development resources with country Sales needs to achieve business support requirements. Aligns with regional CASE Technical development team and collaborate with CASE research developments regional team for having a necessary to drive and strive for a project achievement. Manages resources for TD/TS to achieve SBU/BM/country strategy targets. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or higher in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field. At least 3 – 5 years of relevant experience in the polyurethane industry, preferably in technical service or R&D , with exposure to polyurethane coatings, adhesives, sealants, and elastomers markets . Expertise knowledge in PU System from product properties, product development, application development, processing technology. Good understanding on technical perspective on the related target applications of footwear industry. Full experience of PU applications in Automotive or CASE industries. Strong written and spoken English skills, with good computer literacy. Work location Emporium office, Bangkok BASF has been present in Thailand for more than 50 years. jobs.name: SAP EWM, StRM, IM Consultant - (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At BASF Digital Hub Hyderabad we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. The role provides Application support for SAP logistics processes, ensuring stable operations, fast incident resolution and continuous improvement across SAP EWM, Inventory Management and Stock Room Management (SAP MM-IM or/and SAP WM) Key Responsibilities : • Application support: Receive, prioritize and document incidents and service requests with impact, evidence and reproduction steps. Analyze complex warehouse and inventory issues across configuration, logs, interfaces and process dependencies. • Standard issue resolution: Resolve user issues, authorization questions, errors and transaction problems using defined procedures and knowledge articles. Get supported by AI features for ticket handling support. • Cross-team coordination: Work with cross teams to resolve technical defects, interface failures and performance issues. • Problem management: Being able to early identify recurring issues and define PDCA to able to resolve problems • Change and release support: Support approved fixes, configuration changes, testing, transport preparation, release activities and cutover support. • Operational excellence: Maintain runbooks, support documentation and knowledge base articles to improve first-time resolution and system stability. • Escalation management: Escalate to Level 3 or development teams where required, providing full diagnostics, evidence and business impact assessment. Required Qualifications : • Several years of experience in SAP application support, preferably in logistics, warehouse management or inventory management environments. • Good functional knowledge of SAP EWM, SAP MM-IM and SAP SRM Stock Room Management (or Warehouse Management (SAP WM)), including inbound, outbound, stock movements, inventory handling and warehouse execution. • Strong experience with ITSM processes, ticket handling, incident management, change management and structured troubleshooting. • Basic technical understanding of SAP logs, jobs, interfaces, IDocs, RFCs and integration monitoring. • Basic understanding, monitoring and error handling for APIs, Kafka streams, BTP and debugging • Strong analytical skills, customer orientation and clear communication in English. Nice to Have • Experience with MES or other Level 3 system integrations connected to warehouse and inventory processes. • German, Spanish or Mandarin WHAT WE OFFER Be part of a global leader in digital transformation, working in a vibrant Digital Hub that values innovation, agility, and cross-functional collaboration. Shape the future of BASF’s digital landscape, contributing to projects that drive sustainability and make a real impact. Thrive in a high-performance culture that supports your personal and professional growth, offering diverse learning opportunities and career development. Enjoy a modern, inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, and your curiosity and ambition are encouraged. Benefit from flexible working models, international networking, and a strong sense of purpose as we enable our customers’ green transformation and lead the way in digital excellence.

jobs.name: SAP QM , NCM Consultant - (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At BASF Digital Hub Hyderabad we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. The role provides Application support for SAP Manufacturing, Quality Management and Non-Conformance Management processes, ensuring stable operations, fast incident resolution and continuous improvement (SAP PP or/and SAP PI-QM) Responsibilities : • Act as the primary SAP S/4HANA support contact for incidents and service requests, from triage to SLA compliant resolution. • Receive and prioritize tickets; capture complete, accurate ticket data (user, system, steps to reproduce, attachments). • Troubleshoot and resolve common end-user issues (logins, authorizations, basic data-entry errors, printer/formatting problems) using runbooks and knowledge base articles. • Perform deeper investigation for escalated issues: reproduce problems, examine configuration, analyze logs, run diagnostic queries, and identify root causes. • Implement approved configuration changes and corrective actions in non-production environments; prepare transport/approval documentation for production changes per change management processes. • Execute routine operational tasks: password resets, user account creation/role assignments (following governance), basic data fixes and mass updates under controls. • Coordinate with Basis, ABAP developers, integration teams (ALE/IDoc, RFC, CPI/PI), and vendors to resolve technical defects, performance issues, and integrations; jobs.name: Global Customs Preferential Management & Rules of Origin (Manager)
jobs.description: O bjectives of the Position The Manager, Global Customs Preferential Management & Rules of Origin, is responsible for leading a team of specialists and ensuring the compliant, efficient, and high-quality execution of Preferential Management activities within the assigned region(s) and area of responsibility. This role ensures adherence to customs regulations, preferential origin requirements, and BASF compliance standards while actively maximizing the utilization and duty-saving potential of Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) for BASF Group companies. The position oversees preferential origin determination, supplier declaration management, origin-related customs processes, and advisory services to business units and group companies, while safeguarding BASF against compliance violations, financial penalties, and business risks arising from incorrect preferential origin determinations. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Lead and supervise a team of specialists who coordinate, conduct analysis of products subject to Free Trade Agreements (FTAs), and prepare and maintain the data and documentation required under applicable FTAs. Contribute to collaboration and coordination with Business Unit leadership, Customs Country Custodians, and the Customs Management Team to support best practice implementation, optimize FTA processes, and support KPI reporting and performance monitoring. Ability to work flexibly and collaborate with stakeholders across different time zones. Participate and contribute in Preference Management regular meetings, monitor operational performance, and support the alignment of cost and KPI measures within the assigned area of responsibility. Oversee the solicitation, validation, and maintenance of data and documentation, including FTA certificates and long-term supplier agreements, from BASF suppliers to support preferential treatment and duty-saving opportunities for Business Units and BASF legal entities. Coordinate and oversee communication with BASF customers, Business Units, and relevant stakeholders to ensure that FTA requirements, responses, and origin-related obligations are met. Identify, evaluate, and support additional duty management and Free Trade Agreement utilization opportunities to enhance cost savings and customs efficiency within the assigned area of responsibility. Manage and support the implementation of process and system changes related to Free Trade Agreements in collaboration with IT, process owners, and relevant stakeholders. Apply an operational excellence mindset to review, standardize, and optimize end-to-end Preferential Management process flows, improving efficiency, quality, compliance, and customer service. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree/Masters in Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Business Administration, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience in the chemical industry and/or a Chemical Engineering background would be an advantage. 5–8 years of professional experience in Customs, Foreign Trade Compliance, Preferential Origin determination, and Free Trade Agreement (FTA) management. Experience in Customs and/or Foreign Trade laws and regulations. Ability to work flexibly and collaborate with stakeholders across different time zones. Strong knowledge of Preferential Origin determination, Free Trade Agreements (FTAs), and customs compliance requirements. Strong technical knowledge of HS tariff classification, rules of origin, and customs valuation principles. Good understanding of supplier declaration management and origin-related documentation requirements. Good knowledge of SAP master data systems, SAP ERP, and SAP GTS. Proficiency in data management, KPI monitoring, reporting, and operational analysis. Ability to identify and drive continuous improvement opportunities through process optimization, standardization, automation, and digitalization initiatives.

We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a Breeding Agronomist, you will enjoy a varied role conducting field trials and plant breeding experiments. You'll be responsible for planning and executing field trials, inclusive of trial site management, data collection and communication with our colleagues. How You Will Do It Establish and maintain field trials to produce data and seed, maintain all breeding records, update breeding database with trial and seed production results. Responsible in all aspects of the field program; locating and contracting land, land preparation and all in-season agronomy, following trial protocol and implementing treatments, harvest of trial and shipping of seed. Collaborate with breeders in the conduct of experiments and seed productions in growth chambers at Longerenong. Manage the supply of all key inputs (land, pollinators, contractors, materials) to ensure an efficient and reliable supply is maintained. Be field-based and hands on to ensure operations & activities are on time and to budget. Ensure all operations satisfy safety, regulatory, stewardship and compliance requirements. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you’ll have previous experience in an agronomy-based role and an understanding or interest in plant breeding or agricultural research.. You’ll have a strong focus on detail and enjoy a role with a balance of planning and hands-on operations. You will: Have a degree in Agricultural Science or similar discipline Have 2-10 years of experience conducting field trials Have experience in operating trial equipment and/or farm machinery. Have sound knowledge of canola agronomy. Understanding of hybrid seed production, particularly in relation to canola. Have knowledge of procedures used in agricultural field trials and plant breeding. Show natural leadership in ensuring that people follow guidelines and plan effectively. Demonstrate the ability to collaborate with a diverse range of people. Display strong communication and interpersonal skills. Have a valid driver’s license. A MR or HR license would be beneficial. What We Can Offer You At BASF you get more than just compensation. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements to suit each one of our global team. By creating chemistry with us, you can look forward to: A diverse and inclusive environment, with an open and fair internal promotion process A competitive parental leave policy, regardless of gender, and a supportive return to work plan Give back to your community with our corporate volunteering scheme 4 weeks annual leave, with the offer to purchase additional leave throughout the year Opportunities to apply for international assignments – the perks of a global business! Connect to Create Chemistry If you’d like to join a diverse global business and create chemistry for a sustainable future, we want to hear from you! Click ‘apply’ below. BASF is proud to be a WORK180 Endorsed Employer for all women. If you’d like to know more information about how we are supporting our employees, you can view our policies and benefits here . Offers of employment will be subject to background checks including references, police checks and may include a pre-employment medical. Beware, Job Applicants. At BASF, we are committed to providing a safe and transparent recruitment process. Please be aware of job scams and fraudulent job postings. Only apply through the official BASF Career website to ensure your application is received by us. Be cautious of unsolicited job offers or communications that do not come from official BASF email addresses. Verify any doubtful communications through our HR department. jobs.name: Technical Services Manager
jobs.description: About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a Technical Marketing Manager, you'll play a pivotal role at the intersection of agronomy, technical expertise and commercial strategy. Working closely with sales, customers and industry stakeholders, you'll lead the technical direction of BASF's crop protection portfolio, develop compelling technical marketing programs and drive the successful launch of innovative solutions across New Zealand. How You Will Do It Lead technical strategy and provide expert support for BASF's crop protection portfolio, helping drive customer success and commercial growth. Develop and manage agronomy trials, translating technical data and field insights into practical recommendations and commercial opportunities. Create technical marketing materials, product positioning and data-driven stories that support customer engagement and sales effectiveness. Partner with sales teams, customers and industry stakeholders to provide technical advice, training and product expertise. Lead the planning and execution of new product launches, including business case development, market assessments and launch strategies. Investigate field performance enquiries and provide technical guidance to optimise product performance and customer outcomes. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you'll bring a strong foundation in agronomy and crop protection, combined with the ability to translate technical information into practical solutions for customers and commercial teams. You'll enjoy building relationships, sharing knowledge and influencing outcomes across a diverse stakeholder network. You will: Hold a degree in Agricultural Science or a related discipline. Have significant experience within the crop protection, agrichemical or agribusiness industry, ideally with exposure to a broad range of crop segments. Bring proven agronomic expertise and experience working with crop protection products. Be confident presenting technical information, delivering training and engaging with customers, industry groups and commercial teams. Demonstrate strong analytical skills and the ability to convert data and field observations into actionable business insights. Possess excellent communication, stakeholder management and relationship-building skills. What We Can Offer You At BASF you get more than just compensation. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements to suit each one of our global team. By creating chemistry with us, you can look forward to: A diverse and inclusive environment, with an open and fair internal promotion process A competitive parental leave policy, regardless of gender, and a supportive return to work plan Give back to your community with our corporate volunteering scheme 4 weeks annual leave, with the offer to purchase additional leave throughout the year Opportunities to apply for international assignments – the perks of a global business! Connect to Create Chemistry If you’d like to join a diverse global business and create chemistry for a sustainable future, we want to hear from you! Click ‘apply’ below. BASF is proud to be a WORK180 Endorsed Employer for all women. If you’d like to know more information about how we are supporting our employees, you can view our policies and benefits here . Offers of employment will be subject to background checks including references, police checks and may include a pre-employment medical. Beware, Job Applicants. At BASF, we are committed to providing a safe and transparent recruitment process. Please be aware of job scams and fraudulent job postings. Only apply through the official BASF Career website to ensure your application is received by us. Be cautious of unsolicited job offers or communications that do not come from official BASF email addresses. Verify any doubtful communications through our HR department. Never provide personal information or make payment as part of the application process. #LI-Jobs

BASF Española S.L. markets more than 5,000 products to meet the needs of our customers and society across a wide variety of sectors. The chemical industry is changing; and so is BASF. Discover our new strategy: #WinningWays Do you want to boost your career to the next level and create chemistry with us? WHAT YOU WILL DO As Area Sales Manager Spain & France / Animal Nutrition Feed Enzymes & Feed Performance Ingredients, your key responsibilities will include: Drive business growth and develop customer-focused solutions through close collaboration with customers. Monitors sales budgets, taking corrective action where necessary. Sales Excellence (Account Plans, FC, accurate on-time reporting, budgeting). Develop/manage customer portfolio and partnerships in order to grow sales with specialty products. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU University degree/ master’s degree/PhD or equivalent in Animal Nutrition or Veterinary. 3-5 years sales or technical sales experience in animal nutrition (feed ingredients) or technical background in animal nutrition. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships with an international network. Project management and regional collaboration. Positive mindset, customer focus and strong motivation to capture market share. Negotiation skills and partnership development. Attractive salary package: based on a fixed salary and a bonus based on performance. Flexible compensation plan: to take advantage of services such as Health Insurance, Childcare, Transportation Card, and Training, among others. Professional development: we promote continuous training and access to internal vacancies to keep growing at BASF. Investments for your future: with a Pension Plan, Accident Insurance, Life Insurance, and even the opportunity to participate in the Stock Program after one year in the company. Work-life balance measures: as well as financial assistance for the schooling of children. Sports sections: where you can connect with colleagues and play football, paddle, basketball, cycling, yoga, etc. Flexible work: with the chance to work from home and adjusting your schedule, depending on your position and workplace. And much more. HOW TO PARTICIPATE IN THE PROCESS Send your CV through the job offer so we can get to know each other. If your profile matches, we will call you from the Spanish Talent Acquisition team in Germany (prefix +49) and support you throughout the process. With each step, you will be closer to meeting your future team! If you have any further questions about this process, please contact: Sara Prado (sara.prado-marques@basf.com) * *Please note that we will not be able to accept your resume via this email. MORE ABOUT BASF We celebrate diversity and actively promote an inclusive work environment where every voice is heard and every idea is valued, regardless of age, gender, marital status, ethnicity, religion, physical/mental condition, or sexual orientation. #BeYourself We are Creative, Open, Responsible and Entrepreneurial people. Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Senior Specialist Digitalization | Solution Consultant - B2B Integrations (EDI, O2C/PTP)
jobs.description: Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur attracts, inspire and develop diverse talents who will elevate BASF’s digital journey. As one of the world’s largest chemical companies, BASF is on a mission to create chemistry with a sustainable future. The Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur, alongside four other Digital Hubs across the globe are part of the technology powerhouse driving our vision. Join our organization and make an impact in an inclusive and diverse work environment. We value individual differences and provide opportunities for you to contribute your unique perspective towards our collective goals. Objectives BASF’s Business Process Integration (BPI) team provides and supports digital solutions for B2B integrations with external partners through a variety of systems and processes within the BASF’s architectural landscape.  BPI is considered a strategic tool to digitalize processes and enable seamless exchange of data between applications, businesses, customers and partners in real-time. In this role, you will focus on consulting representatives of BASF businesses and BASF partners on integrating business processes primarily in the Purchase-to-Pay process area, including respective mappings. Main Tasks The Solution Consultant provides customized integration solutions for internal partners and external partners via EDI, API, Micro Services, AI Agents, and similar technologies. The Solution Consultant supports our internal (SAP ERP and Satellite Systems) and external partners to specify their requirements and translates those into best-in-class solution designs based on technical and business process knowledge, aligned with process design and architecture. The consultant will be responsible for supplemental tasks in the daily operation, e.g. operational support (2nd/3rd level), issue resolving, quality assurance, and business interaction. The role does also include assignments to support comprehensive business integration projects. The Solution Consultant works in a global, international setting, interacting with team members in all other regions to provide sustainable digital solutions for our partners. Additional work aspects: strategic contribution to IT architecture and cross-process digitalization efforts, interact with connectivity solutions by supporting API, micro services, generative AI and other industries relevant technical developments. The business processes in scope of this role are: Purchase-to-Pay Job Requirements Education Master's degree in computer science, business or STEM major with 4-6 years of IT or related field experience OR Bachelor's degree in computer science, business or STEM major with 6-8 years of IT or related field experience OR Diploma or comparable training with 6+ years of professional experience in IT and/or business areas Working Experience Minimum 4 years related working experience Experiencing Agile way of working or agile implementation approach Work experience in an international company is a plus Technical & Profressional Knowledge Consult and support internal and external partners when dealing with complex processes and IT application questions. Good business knowledge in various application and process areas, esp. Purchase to Pay (Purchase Orders, Confirmations, Goods Receipts, Migo Movements, Invoices). Conducts and support the technical implementation of the B2B Integration to external partners Showing strong transactional experience in SAP R3 and/or S4/HANA (MM Procurement - SD) Ability to work and navigate in SAP middleware platforms (PO, CPI Integration Suite) Provides a deep technical understanding of standard connectivity messages EDI-APIs and programming protocols (supporting e.g. iDocs, XML, EDIFACT, JSON, UI etc.) Consult and support IT analysis (process and/or data), mentoring, modelling, solution design and optimization of related business processes and models Execute studies in preliminary stages of projects, including evaluation of existing or new solutions Ability to support strategic planning and realization Can assume roles as project manager and related tasks Coordinate and execute prototyping, configuration and testing of solutions based on BASF requirements, while ensuring quality and security aspects Provide structured acceptance, analysis and description of solutions and/or concepts Support and/or steer the formulation of more complex costs estimates for efforts spend solution design, testing and implementation of business solutions Provides Business support and training (processes, tools, reports, etc.) where required Provide guidance and structure to enable day2day operational support incl, advising external support resources Extensive knowledge of standard connectivity messages, related business processes and applications Familiar with Azure DevOps (or GitHub or similar) You can demonstrate fluent communication skills in English (spoken and written) Well-developed sense of teamwork in an international team with strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication and conflict resolution skills. Business consulting skill with a focus on value generation Ambitious, proactive & entrepreneurial character Highly developed sense of responsibility High customer- and innovation-orientation Time flexibility to work across different time zones Experiences as project manager Experiences in strategic planning and realization Experiences in AI Agents and AI based communication Certifications in Agile, SAP S/4 At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises six segments: Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €68.9 billion in 2023. BASF is committed to empowering its employees to pursue their interests and explore emerging technologies. By investing in top-quality tools and promoting cross-functional collaboration, we encourage our team members to drive positive change within our organization. Come join us and be a part of our digitalization journey . Further Information at https://go.basf.net/careers_digitalhubkl

This role is essential in driving brand visibility, gathering market insights, and supporting sales force effectiveness across Malaysia’s rice-growing regions Job Responsibilities: 1.Customer Forums Coordinate logistics and content for rice customer forums. Support speaker preparation and presentation materials. Capture customer feedback and insights for post-event analysis. 2.Shop Front Sales Programs Plan and execute shop front campaigns in collaboration with sales teams. Ensure promotional materials and samples are distributed effectively. 3.Customer Data Entries Maintain accurate and timely customer visit reports and data entries. Support DCA execution tracking and sales team productivity metrics. 4.Field and Rice Demo Visits & Surveys Participate in field demo visits to showcase product performance. Support rice team in data collection from farmers and retailers. Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Marketing, or related field. Strong communication and coordination skills. jobs.name: Field Officer - rice
jobs.description: Job Description: Position Summary The Field Officer - rice is responsible for supporting demand generation activities, promoting BASF crop protection solutions, and driving product adoption among farmers, distributors, and retailers within the assigned territory. The role focuses on field execution, customer engagement, technical support, and market development to achieve business objectives. Job Responsibilities 1. Product Promotion & Demand Generation * Conduct product demonstrations * Organize farmer meetings, field days, and crop clinics. * Promote BASF products and technologies to farmers and channel partners. * Support marketing campaigns and product launch activities. 2. Farmer Engagement * Develop and maintain strong relationships with farmers and key influencers. * Conduct regular farm visits to understand customer needs. * Provide recommendations on crop protection solutions and best farming practices. 3. Technical Support * Monitor crop conditions, pest, disease, and weed infestations. * Assist farmers with product application methods and stewardship practices. * Collect field performance data and feedback on BASF products. 4. Channel Partner Support * Work closely with distributors, dealers, and retailers to increase product awareness and demand. * Assist in dealer training and promotional activities. * Support inventory movement through demand creation initiatives. 5. Market Intelligence * Monitor competitor activities, product performance, and market trends. * Gather customer insights and provide regular reports to the sales team. * Identify new business opportunities within the assigned territory. 6. Compliance & Stewardship * Ensure all activities comply with company policies, safety standards, and regulatory requirements. * Promote responsible and sustainable use of crop protection products. * Support product stewardship and container recycling programs. Job Requirements * Have at least Diploma or equivalent. * Experience in agriculture, crop protection, seed business, or sales promotion is an advantage. * Good communication and interpersonal skills. * Able to work independently and travel extensively within the assigned territory. * Possess a valid driving license and own vehicle for work purpose. Job Description Footer: BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Communication & Culture Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At BASF Digital Hub Hyderabad we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. Key Responsibilities : Drive Communication, Change & Culture for the Digital Hub, designing and executing the overall communication and change activities to support the Hub’s vision, culture, and business goals – and to contribute to the overall global communications and culture strategy and targets of Global Digital Services Oversee all internal and external communication channels relevant for the Hub (news, intranet, social media, LinkedIn, event communications), ensuring consistent messaging and strong employer branding. Organize and manage end-to-end events (onsite and virtual) that promote company culture, support our transformation, foster engagement, and create synergies among IT professionals and across technology domains, promoting integration and knowledge sharing. Act as a cultural ambassador, driving initiatives that strengthen our Winning Culture and digitalization priorities, diversity, inclusion, and collaboration, and advising leaders and teams on best practices. Monitor and analyze communication and change management effectiveness, continuously improving measures and content based on feedback and business needs. Closely collaborate with the local and regional communications network in BASF and ensure all activities comply with local (India) requirements and leverage local trends and platforms to maximize impact. Requirements : Bachelor’s degree in Communication, Marketing, Public Relations, Change Management, or related field. Up to 1-2 years’ experience in communication, event organization, social media management, preferably in a multicultural or digital environment is beneficial. Excellent communication skills in English; knowledge of local languages is a plus. Ability to create concepts and content relevant to the local context with a strategic and analytical mindset. Strong interpersonal and intercultural skills, an open and transformative mindset, curiosity to question the status-quo, and the ability to connect and engage diverse audiences. WHAT WE OFFER Be part of a global leader in digital transformation, working in a vibrant Digital Hub that values innovation, agility, and cross-functional collaboration. Shape the future of BASF’s digital landscape, contributing to projects that drive sustainability and make a real impact. Thrive in a high-performance culture that supports your personal and professional growth, offering diverse learning opportunities and career development. Enjoy a modern, inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, and your curiosity and ambition are encouraged. Benefit from flexible working models, international networking, and a strong sense of purpose as we enable our customers’ green transformation and lead the way in digital excellence.

Sobald Du Dein Haarspray in der Hand hältst, möchtest Du wissen, wie dieses sich chemisch zusammensetzt und dass selbst ein Handy ohne Chemie keine Energie hätte, ist für Dich nichts Neues? Så er det nu, du skal slå til! Ved du allerede nu, at du skal i praktik til februar, og leder du efter den helt rigtige læreplads? Så har du en unik mulighed for at komme foran de øvrige ansøgere og sikre dig en attraktiv læreplads i god tid. Vi søger lige nu vores kommende procesoperatørelever med opstart i februar, hvor du får mulighed for at lære faget i praksis i en spændende produktionsvirksomhed med fokus på kvalitet, teknologi og udvikling. Vent ikke for længe – send din ansøgning allerede i dag, og tag det første skridt mod en spændende karriere som procesoperatør! Er du igang med grundforløb 2 eller allerede gennemført og ønsker du en læreplads hos en fødevarevirksomhed der arbejder med spraytørringsteknologi i et GMP reguleret miljø med fokus på høj produktkvalitet og personsikkerhed, så skal du søge en elevplads hos os med start februar 2027. Hos BASF skaber vi kemi for en bæredygtig fremtid. Vi kombinerer økonomisk succes med miljøbeskyttelse og social ansvarlighed. De ca. 110.000 ansatte i BASF-koncernen arbejder for at bidrage til succes for vores kunder, som man finder i næsten alle brancher og i næsten ethvert land over hele verden. Vores produkter er opdelt i seks segmenter: Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition Ingredients og Agricultural Solutions. BASF A/S Production Site Ballerup hører til under segmentet Nutrition Ingredients. Vi er specialiseret i mikroindkapslede formuleringer af vitaminer og carotenoider. Vores produkter anvendes hovedsagelig til fødevare-, drikkevare- og medicinalindustrien og vi beskæftiger ca. 130 medarbejdere. Vi søger 4 procesoperatørelever med interesse i at lære nye processer og udstyr og som ønsker at være en del af et dygtigt team i en spændende virksomhed i udvikling. HVAD DU KAN FORVENTE Som procesoperatørelev vil du indgå i et team, som har den primære opgave at sikre optimal produktion med processen af vitaminer og carotenoider. Nogle af arbejdsområderne er: •    Råvarehåndtering, pluk og afvejning •    Betjening og overvågning af spraytørrings- og pakkeanlæg •    Skriftlig dokumentation og afrapportering af produktionsforløb •    Prøveudtagning og proceskontrol •    Rengøring af anlæg, udstyr og lokaler Arbejdstiden er skifteholdsarbejde på en 3-holdsplan med dag-, aften- og nattevagter. Hverdagsvagter er på 8 timer og weekendvagter er på 12 timer. HVAD DU TILBYDER •    Du har interesse for alle aspekter ved produktion. •    Fleksibilitet, ordenssans, teknisk flair og hygiejneforståelse. •    Du har gode samarbejdsevner og frem for alt er du ansvarsbevidst. •    Gode kundskaber i skriftligt og mundtligt dansk. •    Du trives i et aktivt job og er i god fysisk form, da en del af opgaverne kræver fysisk arbejde, f.eks løft, bevægelse, opgaver både i højder og mindre rum (confined space) HVAD VI TILBYDER I Produktionen er vi et diverst team, der prioriterer og hjælper hinanden i en dynamisk hverdag. Vi sætter stor pris på ærlighed og respekterer hinandens forskelligheder i alt, hvad vi gør. Derudover vil du opleve ansvar fra første dag i et udfordrende arbejdsmiljø med læring i jobbet bl.a. igennem vores mentorordning. Du får løn under uddannelsen inkl. pensionsordning og sundhedforsikring. Vi har en fantastisk kantine med et bredt udvalg af smagfulde retter herudover er vi en social arbejdsplads med 2 forskellige foreninger, personale- og sportforening, der arrangere alt fra klatring til teaterture og fælles spisninger med dine kollegaere. Herudover er BASF A/S Ballerup en røgfri arbejdsplads, med røgfri arbejdstid. Main responsibilities EHS Management System Gap analysis and implementation for the new EHS regulation and requirement. Maintains EHS management system (IMS) and documentations. Support to implement EHS standards to compliance according local and BASF requirement. Define training needs, coordinate/arranges/delivery EHS training. Introduce and initiate country EHS TA together with site TA. Work with the country EHS to deliver competitive, reliable and high quality EHS services according to site needs. Benchmarks the EHS performances in the site (i.e. Initiates measures and proposals to contain the potential issues and continuously improves EHS standards of the Sites). Stakeholder Management Interfaces with site management & Business unit. Interfaces with local industry groups on behalf of BASF for issue management and advocacy. Represents BASF to participant local industry organization. Dialogues regularly with site managements to evaluate level of service, prioritizes & allocates resources and improves effectively and efficiency of the EHS service. Implement service catalogue and conducts service dialogue with site and business unit to fine-tune the service scopes. TDS (Transportation & Distribution Safety) Ensure safety and security standards for all modes of transportation are implementing and compliance. Nomination as Country/Site Dangerous Goods Safety Advisor. Training and Guidance to TDS related personnel involved in distribution safety processes. Conduct TDS Reviews for all Responsible person. Conduct Safety and Quality Assessments of suppliers, service providers and customers that transport or store our raw materials or goods. Incorporation of Transportation and Distribution Safety Performance in the Procurement Process. Carrier/Trucker Qualification Checks and Performance Evaluation. Incident Investigation, Corrective Actions and Reporting. ER (Emergency Response) Nomination as Country Emergency Expert. Assist to develop, review On-site Emergency Response Plans and scenario, fire prevention concept and compliance to legal and BASF requirement. Conduct Fire prevention assessment and fire prevention concept to meet as per requirement. Provide expertise to support and review for fire prevention design and equipment installation. Crisis and Security Management Nomination as Country/Local Security Manager as per BASF requirement. Provide expertise to support Site Security concept. Conduct self-assessment site security and security risk assessment. Coordinate with regional team to provide security review. Lead to investigate security incident. Develop and prepare readiness Country Incident Management. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in EHS, Science, Engineering, Production, Chemical Engineering, or a related field is required. A Master’s degree or PhD is an advantage. At least 5 years of experience in production, engineering, or EHS is required. Leadership experience is an advantage. A professional-level Safety Officer must hold at least a Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety or a related field. Proficiency in both spoken and written English is required. Strong communication and management skills, familiarity with local EHS legislation and legal requirements, and a solid understanding of EHS unit scope and functions are required. Work location Emporium office, Bangkok BASF has been present in Thailand for more than 50 years. The company offers a wide range of products and solutions to support almost all the key industries in the country, including Agricultural Solutions, Intermediates and Process Catalysts, Monomers, Petrochemicals, Coatings, Dispersions and Resins, Performance Chemicals, Care Chemicals, Nutrition and Health, and Performance Materials. BASF in Thailand was established in 1966 and maintains its head office in Bangkok. It operates three production sites in Samutprakarn, Chonburi and Rayong, an Automotive Coatings Technical Competence Center, and a Performance Materials Technical Development Center in Samutprakarn. In 2024, BASF posted sales of €531 million to customers in Thailand and had 623 employees as of the end of the year. jobs.name: Talent Acquisition Partner (Contract Role)
jobs.description: Role Summary The Talent Acquisition Partner manages the full recruitment lifecycle from Job Requisition (JR) approval to candidate offer acceptance. This role acts as a strategic advisor to the business, partnering closely with hiring managers and HR stakeholders to ensure effective talent delivery. The TA Partner is responsible for developing sourcing strategies, managing candidate pipelines, and driving a seamless recruitment experience for both candidates and internal stakeholders. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities End-to-End Recruitment Management •    Manage the complete hiring process from JR approval, sourcing, screening, interview scheduling, selection, to offer stage. •    Build and maintain strong talent pipelines across assigned functions. •    Ensure timely process progression while maintaining a high quality candidate experience. •    Provide market insights, talent trends, and recommendations to hiring managers. Stakeholder Management •    Act as a trusted advisor to Hiring Managers, HR Business Partners, Country Heads, and functional leaders. •    Facilitate alignment discussions on hiring needs, role requirements, and selection criteria. •    Conduct regular hiring updates and performance discussions with business stakeholders. •    Manage expectations on hiring timelines, candidate availability, and recruitment challenges. Sourcing Strategy & Execution •    Develop and execute sourcing strategies using job portals, networks, referrals, and targeted outreach. •    Leverage recruitment tools and platforms to identify and engage relevant talent. •    Promote employer brand through candidate engagement and consistent communication. Candidate Assessment & Selection •    Conduct initial screening and evaluate candidates’ skills, experience, and cultural fit. •    Coordinate interviews with relevant stakeholders and ensure structured and fair evaluation processes. •    Guide stakeholders in decision making with candidate insights and interview feedback. Communications & Cross-Functional Collaboration •    Serve as the communication link between candidates, HRBP, Country Heads, Talent Teams, and other internal partners. •    Ensure smooth coordination of interviews, feedback loops, and offer negotiations. •    Collaborate with Compensation & Benefits, HRIS, and Finance teams for accurate and timely hiring data. Process Excellence & Compliance •    Ensure recruitment activities comply with company policies and governance standards. •    Maintain data accuracy in recruitment systems and trackers (e.g., SuccessFactors, HR systems). •    Continuously improve hiring efficiency through feedback, process reviews, and best practices Job Requirements Education •    Bachelor’s degree in business, HR, Analytics, or related fields. Working Experience •    At least 5 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition. •    Experience managing end-to-end recruitment processes. •    Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and HR systems (e.g., SuccessFactors). Technical & Professional Knowledge •    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. •    Ability to manage multiple roles and competing priorities. •    Good interviewing and candidate assessment capabilities. •    Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint). •    Detail-oriented with strong coordination skills. •    Fluency in spoken and written English; additional languages are a plus. About BASF in Malaysia BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.description: Representante Técnico de Vendas Pleno (AGRO) - Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiencia - Sinop/MT Negócio “Juntos pelo seu legado”. Esse é o compromisso da BASF com o agricultor! Aqui, o campo está em nosso DNA e, por isso, estamos conectados às mais novas tendências do agronegócio mundial, oferecendo um amplo portfólio de produtos e serviços, com foco na rentabilidade e sustentabilidade dos negócios. Área Na BASF, a sigla P&SS refere-se a Professional & Specialty Solutions (Soluções Profissionais e Especializadas), uma divisão voltada para mercados específicos como controle de pragas urbanas, manejo de vegetação profissional, silvicultura (florestas) e pastagens. Candidato(a) Representar a BASF junto aos grandes pecuaristas, distribuidores e redistribuidores na região Norte, Mato Grosso e Goiás, com atuação majoritária no segmento de Pastagem. É preciso mobilidade para viagens frequentes dentro do território (Norte, TO, MT e GO). O profissional atuará em conjunto com as áreas de Marketing, R&D e Desenvolvimento de Mercado para antecipar necessidades e tendências regionais.
