O relacionamento prévio com grandes pecuaristas, distribuidores e cooperativas na região Norte/MT/GO/TO, será diferencial. Nossa química valoriza o talento e a diversidade de gênero, raça, idade, nacionalidade, crenças, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, deficiências e todas as demais características, diferenças e semelhanças que fazem parte da diversidade humana. jobs.name: National EHS Specialist
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a National EHS Specialist, you will be the trusted advisor for Environment, Health & Safety across BASF's Agricultural Solutions business in Australia and New Zealand. You'll partner with business leaders to strengthen our EHS culture, drive compliance, influence safe work practices and deliver continuous improvement across diverse agricultural operations, sites and supply chain partners. How You Will Do It Partner with business leaders across ANZ to provide expert EHS guidance and drive EHS priorities across the Agricultural Solutions (AP) business. Ensure compliance with Responsible Care principles, Australian and New Zealand legislation, and BASF EHS standards across sites, warehouses, contractors and suppliers. Champion and strengthen BASF's OneAP EHS culture through engagement, coaching, training and continuous improvement initiatives. Monitor emerging regulatory requirements, assess business impacts and implement practical compliance and risk management strategies. Analyse EHS performance data and KPIs to identify trends, drive improvements and support leadership decision-making. Travel across ANZ operational sites to build strong stakeholder relationships and support safe, compliant and high-performing operations. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you'll bring significant EHS leadership experience and a passion for creating safe, compliant and high-performing workplaces. You'll be confident influencing senior stakeholders, navigating complex operational environments and translating regulatory requirements into practical business solutions. You will: Hold a Diploma in Environmental Health & Safety or equivalent. Have 7-10 years of EHS experience, ideally within agriculture, agribusiness, manufacturing, logistics or other operational environments. Demonstrate strong knowledge of Australian EHS legislation, compliance frameworks and industry best practice. Thrive in a complex matrix organisation and enjoy building strong relationships across multiple sites and stakeholder groups. Have experience influencing senior leaders and engaging effectively with diverse operational, contractor and site-based workforces. Bring strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to use EHS data to drive continuous improvement and business outcomes. What We Can Offer You At BASF you get more than just compensation. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements to suit each one of our global team. By creating chemistry with us, you can look forward to: A diverse and inclusive environment, with an open and fair internal promotion process A competitive parental leave policy, regardless of gender, and a supportive return to work plan Give back to your community with our corporate volunteering scheme 4 weeks annual leave, with the offer to purchase additional leave throughout the year Opportunities to apply for international assignments – the perks of a global business! Connect to Create Chemistry If you’d like to join a diverse global business and create chemistry for a sustainable future, we want to hear from you! Click ‘apply’ below. BASF is proud to be a WORK180 Endorsed Employer for all women. If you’d like to know more information about how we are supporting our employees, you can view our policies and benefits here . Offers of employment will be subject to background checks including references, police checks and may include a pre-employment medical. Beware, Job Applicants. At BASF, we are committed to providing a safe and transparent recruitment process. Please be aware of job scams and fraudulent job postings. Only apply through the official BASF Career website to ensure your application is received by us. Be cautious of unsolicited job offers or communications that do not come from official BASF email addresses. Verify any doubtful communications through our HR department. Never provide personal information or make payment as part of the application process. #LI-Jobs

jobs.name: Temporary Laboratory Assistant - MS Structural Elucidation (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In our APD/EFL Environmental Fate and Structure Elucidation unit, we conduct regulatory studies to ensure the safety of our products for consumers, the environment, and wildlife. A key part of our work is the structural elucidation of degradation products and production-related by-products. To determine chemical structures, we utilize state-of-the-art analytical techniques, particularly in the fields of mass spectrometry and NMR. We are looking for a new team member to support us on a fixed-term basis for 12 months with the possibility of an extension for a further 12 months. In this role, you independently operate and maintain analytical instruments in the areas of LC-MS and NMR. You also perform routine maintenance and minor repairs on these instruments. You develop and optimize analytical methods with a focus on chromatography and mass spectrometry. Your expertise is essential in evaluating measurement data using specialized software and interpreting results to address complex analytical questions. Together with your colleagues, you conduct GLP and non-GLP studies for the structural elucidation of crop protection products and their degradation products. You are responsible for the evaluation, documentation, and management of analytical data, preparing reports, coordinating outsourced analyses, and providing scientific customer support as part of GLP-compliant data generation. WHAT YOU OFFER completed vocational training as a Chemical Laboratory Technician or a comparable qualification at least four years of professional experience in mass spectrometry, structural elucidation, or a comparable analytical environment solid knowledge of mass spectrometry and experience working in a GLP-regulated environment. experience and knowledge in high-resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS) and NMR are an advantage very good German and good English language skills, as well as proficiency in common IT applications and databases strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a structured, detail-oriented approach to work WHAT WE OFFER A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. Inspiring networks for the development and implementation of your ideas (e.g. Women in Business). Learning opportunities for your professional and personal development. Career paths as professional development into other roles within the company. We actively support with childcare (e.g. company daycare, holiday programmes) and provide a fitness and health studio as well as a medical center with numerous offers for your health. We offer sustainable mobility benefits - a discounted Deutschlandticket for regional public transport, a job‑bike leasing program, and on‑site e‑charging stations for private electric vehicles to make your commute affordable, healthy, and climate‑friendly. HOW TO REACH US Romy Marie Brinsa (Talent Acquisition), romy.brinsa@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-56730 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are also welcome to book an online appointment. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here ABOUT US BASF Agricultural Solutions Deutschland GmbH is a reliable partner to the agricultural sector, offering innovative and sustainable solutions tailored to a wide range of crop systems. With the Agricultural Center in Limburgerhof, near the BASF Group headquarters in Ludwigshafen, you’ll find an attractive environment for both your professional life and your leisure time in the Rhine ‑ Neckar metropolitan region. You can learn more about the Agricultural Center in Limburgerhof here . Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As a Financial Accountant, become an important part of our international Financial Reporting team. In this position, you are responsible for the general ledger and act as an interface within the finance function. You process business transactions in the general ledger and fixed asset accounting and ensure reconciliation with the subledgers. You are responsible for the timely preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS and HGB, as well as the preparation of income tax calculations for German BASF Group companies in the electromobility sector. You are responsible for preparing the monthly group reporting and answering internal and external reporting-related inquiries. In accounting matters, you serve as the central point of contact for our subsidiaries, the subledgers, and BASF’s central finance units. Furthermore, you actively participate in projects and coordinate the technical and process-related development of our organization in collaboration with our partners. Together with us, you help shape the transition to the new SAP S/4HANA version. WHAT YOU OFFER completed degree in Business Administration with a focus on Accounting and Taxation, qualifications as a Certified Accountant, or an equivalent qualification, for example as a Tax Specialist professional experience in external financial reporting as well as knowledge of preparing financial statements in accordance with IFRS and HGB proficient in the use of common MS Office applications (especially Excel), as well as ideally user-level knowledge of SAP R/3 and SAP S/4 very good German language skills and good English language skills high motivation to achieve success together as a team an independent approach to work and strong analytical thinking characterize your working style WHAT WE OFFER Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualification and work experience, 48.000 - 52.000 € possible with correspondingly higher qualifications - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location Team and company events in which we celebrate our achievements and live up our team spirit Location-independent work models with defined days of presence in Berlin and place of residence in Germany - Here a first impression Subsidy for public transport, personal employee benefit card and other discounts Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks HOW TO REACH US Jennifer Weiz (Talent Acquisition), jennifer.weiz@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-56454 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US As an international service hub, the BASF Services Europe GmbH bundles a wide range of services for the BASF Group throughout Europe. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our career opportunities here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: QC Chemist
jobs.description:
Now hiring! QC Chemist Greenville, OH We are looking for a QC Chemist to join our team in Greenville, OH. New finish, Proven expertise. Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. We are seeking a professional like you to ensure specification quality of both, purchased raw material and Site-manufactured products. This is done by creating and/or updating test methods extending to SOPs, JTAs and PWIs for the QC and Production labs. You will also coordinate the training done for the analytical/wet methods in the QC lab and standardize technique as well as methods run not only in the QC lab, but also in the Production labs. You will also ensure that equipment and instruments involved in QA are up to date regarding calibration and coordinate the efforts to keep them working with the required precision and accuracy. As a QC Chemist you will... Understand Environmental and Quality Policies and perform job responsibilities safely, you will follow documented work procedures and instructions, while keeping in mind the Environmental Aspects and their potential Impacts. Work in a team environment acting as backup for the QC Supervisor and QC Lab Application Specialist, as well as provide back-up support to Laboratory Technicians on an as needed basis. Leverage your education in Chemistry and/or your experience in QC lab to manage the (QC) Laboratory ECP and calibration program. Be a subject matter expert with knowledge of analytical testing equipment and techniques, you will provide the required training on analytical/wet test methods to the Lab Technicians and ensure the required standardization across the different shifts. Oversee and support the QC activities in Production Labs using your strong leadership skills Demonstrate your knowledge of statistical tools and continuous improvement techniques by identifying improvement opportunities, including new test methods, elimination of tests, etc. and work directly with technical, purchasing and suppliers to improve first time quality. Use your strong verbal and written communication skills to coordinate the introduction of new test equipment, including training as appropriate. Additionally, you will act as site representative on a Test Method committee and Inter-site Lab COP. Successfully work independently, updating SOPs, PWI and JTAs related to the analytical/wet testing in QC and Production Labs. Utilize your strong problem solving and organizational skills to ensure that the QC installations/equipment receive the right preventive and corrective maintenance, keeping a close contact with Engineering and Maintenance Department, as well with the external Technical Services. Additionally, you will give support to Engineering for the Capital Projects and Investments related to the QC installations/equipment. If you have... BS Degree in Chemistry (or related) or 5-years experience in Quality Assurance. Significant breadth and depth of experience in QC systems and processes. Ability to direct and motivate sub-ordinates. Well-developed analytical and organizational skills. Familiarity and ability to maintain compliance with site, business and corporate policies, particularly in the areas of safety and the environment. Ability to interact with and communicate effectively to all levels of the site and with external stakeholders. Strong understanding of how to conduct measurement systems analysis and apply statistical thinking. Privacy statement Surventis takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. jobs.name: EHS Specialist
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position To support the implementation and continuous improvement of Workplace Safety programs, regulatory compliance, emergency preparedness, and EHS initiatives for BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre (KL Hub) and BASF Malaysia office (BuO) operations. The role serves as the operational focal point for Workplace Safety activities and stakeholder engagement, contributing to a safe, compliant, and resilient workplace environment that supports business growth, workplace transformation initiatives, and the transition towards a 24/7 operating model. M ain Tasks Functional Tasks (including but not limited to) Workplace EHS Compliance Serve as the Workplace Safety focal point for KL Hub and BuO offices, ensuring compliance with BASF requirements, local regulations, and corporate EHS standards. Support implementation and continuous improvement of safety programs, procedures, emergency response plans, risk management, and operational guidelines. Coordinate statutory and corporate EHS reporting and audits (e.g., DOSH, REHSA), monitor safety performance, and drive timely closure of findings and follow-up actions. Maintain safety and training records, certifications, inspection and incident reports, and other compliance documentation. Workplace Risk Management Lead risk assessments, hazard identification, safety inspections, observations, and compliance reviews. Coordinate periodic checks and maintenance of safety and emergency equipment (fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, smoke detectors, first aid, etc.) to ensure readiness. Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, perform root-cause analysis, implement corrective/preventive actions, and track their effectiveness. Oversee IAQ, environmental monitoring, and workplace hygiene assessments with building management and service providers to drive improvements. Emergency Preparedness & Business Resilience Lead and improve emergency preparedness and response programs for KL Hub and BuO offices, including drills, exercises, and crisis simulations. Coordinate Emergency Response Team (ERT) activities: nomination, onboarding, training/certification renewals, duty rosters, annual planning etc. Actively participate in emergency response, crisis management, and business continuity efforts; monitor ERT effectiveness and drive improvements. Safety Culture & Capability Development Promote a proactive safety culture through engagement programs, awareness campaigns, safety communications, and wellbeing initiatives. Develop and deliver workplace safety and competency training (new joiner briefings, fire safety, emergency response, first aid, Global Safety Day, and EHS learning campaigns). Conduct safety inductions and orientations, share safety alerts/lessons learned/best practices, and support leadership engagement to reinforce ownership and accountability. Stakeholder Management Build and manage partnerships with Business Units, HR, Facilities, Procurement, Building Management, contractors, and service providers to improve Workplace Safety; provide guidance and escalate complex issues to the Senior Manager as needed. Serve as Secretary and EHS focal point for the Safety & Health and Emergency Response Team committees: coordinate meetings, management reviews, action tracking, governance reporting, and communicate key outcomes. Contractor Safety & Facilities Oversight Lead contractor safety for office projects, maintenance, renovations, fit-outs, relocations, and infrastructure upgrades: review risk assessments, method statements, and permit requirements, and ensure EHS requirements are integrated into workplace changes. Conduct contractor safety briefings, monitor compliance with BASF EHS and regulatory obligations, and coordinate with Facilities, Building Management, and contractors to ensure safe execution. Strategic Projects & Continuous Improvement Support and implement strategic EHS, workplace transformation, employee wellbeing, and operational excellence initiatives in line with business needs. Identify and drive process improvements, digitalization, standardization, and simplification for Workplace Safety programs; act as EHS focal point to ensure EHS requirements and risk management are integrated into workplace-related projects. Produce management reports, dashboards, and presentations to monitor project performance and support decision-making; support regional and global EHS initiatives as assigned. Act as the EHS focal point for workplace-related projects, ensuring EHS requirements, risk management principles,   and BASF standards are integrated throughout project planning and execution. Requirements Education Bachelor's Degree in Occupational Safety & Health, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. Professional EHS certifications (Safety and Health Officer or Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) Coordinator) and relevant workplace safety experience would be an advantage. Work Experience >5 years of relevant experience in Occupational Safety & Health, Environmental Protection, EHS Management Systems, Workplace Safety, Facilities Safety, or related EHS functions. Experience in office/workplace environments, regulatory compliance, emergency preparedness, audit management, and EHS program implementation are an advantage

jobs.name: Authentication (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At BASF, we enable secure, modern and user-friendly authentication across our global enterprise. Our team provides reliable login capabilities for business-critical applications across cloud and on-premises environments based on one federated identity. We are responsible for authentication technologies such as Smartcards, Windows Hello for Business and FIDO2, ensuring secure access for employees and administrators worldwide. As a core part of BASF's Cyber Security and Identity & Access Management landscape, we are driving the adoption of phishing-resistant and passwordless authentication technologies that strengthen security while improving user experience. To strengthen our team in Madrid, we are looking for a Senior Cyber Security Engineer who combines technical expertise, hands-on engineering and architectural thinking to help shape the future of authentication at one of the world's leading chemical companies. jobs.name: Project Lead Inhouse Consulting - Transformational Change (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Welcome to the global management consultancy of BASF! We focus on strategic projects that drive the effective transformation of our businesses. Our teams work on a broad range of topics such as sustainability, organizational development, efficiency projects, M&A, and profitable growth through all types of innovation. We put people first: We are proud of our strong team spirit, and we cherish diversity. Become part of a great international team where your hands-on approach and desire to leave an impact are truly valued. Together, let’s create new ideas and offer the best solutions to our customers. Hands-on mentality: From day one, you apply your expertise in systems and management consulting to successfully drive change processes. Clarity and direction: You specify the impacts of change and derive strategies for organizational and cultural projects. Impact: You support leaders and the organization in implementing effective change initiatives. Based on our comprehensive end-to-end service offering, you guide a project from start to finish. Visibility: You design change management initiatives and facilitate interventions, such as large-scale events and workshops with management teams. Growth: Through your projects, you gain insight into BASF's diverse business areas and build a network at the management level. We help you expand your competencies and support your personal development. WHAT YOU OFFER required: At least 2 years of professional experience in change management, management consulting, or strategic organizational and management development proven experience in designing, executing, and implementing change initiatives degree in Business Administration, Economics, Psychology, or Social Sciences excellent German and English language skills strategic and forward-thinking mindset, as well as an interest in working in an international team ability to shift perspectives and view situations from different angles international work experience is an advantage WHAT WE OFFER Attractive location: Your work location is in Monheim (near Düsseldorf), the administrative headquarters of BASF Personal Care & Nutrition GmbH. The Monheim office has a canteen and modern, flexible workspaces designed to accommodate various teams and functions. Hybrid Work: You can combine remote work with up to 3 office days. Regular visits of our headquarters in Ludwigshafen are required, e.g. for monthly team days or unit events. Depending on the project/client, journeys to other BASF sites may be necessary as well. Work-Life-Balance: We offer access to childcare providers, flexible working time models, and cooperations with fitness and health studios, along with numerous other (preventive) offers for your mental and physical health. Personal Growth: We provide a comprehensive training program tailored to your needs. Our unit has a successful track record in employee career development: former team members can be found at all hierarchy levels at BASF globally. Individual support for your professional development is part of our mission. Perks: An attractive salary and a variable bonus, employee stock options, the possibility of special leave, 30 days of paid vacation, canteens with freshly cooked food, job bike, social counselling, and many others. HOW TO REACH US Jennifer Weiz (Talent Acquisition), jennifer.weiz@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-56454 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . Wir konzentrieren uns auf strategische Projekte, die die effektive Transformation unserer Geschäfte vorantreiben. Unsere Teams arbeiten an einem breiten Spektrum von Themen wie Nachhaltigkeit, Organisationsentwicklung, Effizienzprojekte, M&A und profitables Wachstum durch alle Arten von Innovation. Wir stellen die Menschen in den Mittelpunkt: Wir sind stolz auf unseren starken Teamgeist und schätzen Vielfalt. Werden Sie Teil eines großartigen internationalen Teams, in dem Ihr praxisorientierter Ansatz und der Wunsch, einen Einfluss zu hinterlassen, wirklich geschätzt werden. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam neue Ideen entwickeln und die besten Lösungen für unsere Kunden anbieten. WAS SIE ERWARTET Als Project Managing Consultant leisten Sie einen echten Beitrag zur Zukunft von BASF, indem Sie innovative Lösungen und wirksame Empfehlungen für die Führungskräfte von BASF entwickeln. Zu unseren internen Kunden gehört die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette von BASF – von Basischemikalien bis hin zu Spezialitäten – mit jeweils individuellen Anforderungen. Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf den Themen Nachhaltigkeit, End-to-End-Supply-Chain-Prozesse, Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungsinitiativen sowie Komplexitätsmanagement. End-to-End-Projektleitung: Sie leiten Supply-Chain-Beratungsprojekte mit hoher Wirkung – von der initialen Strukturierung von Problemstellungen und der Entwicklung von Business Cases über die Lösungsentwicklung bis hin zur Implementierungsplanung. Fokus auf die CORE-Wertschöpfungskette: Sie treiben Transformationen in groß angelegten, kostenkritischen Wertschöpfungsketten der Chemieindustrie sowie in für Consumer Care relevanten Wertschöpfungsketten voran. Der Schwerpunkt liegt dabei auf Planung, S&OP, Logistik, Bestandsmanagement und Netzwerkoptimierung. Zusammenarbeit mit Senior Stakeholdern: Sie agieren als vertrauenswürdiger Sparringspartner für Führungskräfte und Projektsponsoren, kommunizieren klar, faktenbasiert und mit einer starken Wertschöpfungsorientierung. KI-gestützte Beratung: Sie nutzen fortschrittliche Analysen und KI-unterstützte Werkzeuge (z. B. Szenariomodellierung, Planungsanalytik, Process Mining oder Entscheidungsunterstützungslösungen), um Erkenntnisse schneller zu gewinnen, die Qualität von Entscheidungen zu verbessern und die Wirkung der Beratung zu erhöhen. Kompetenzaufbau: Sie coachen und entwickeln Beraterinnen und Berater in modernen Beratungsmethoden, digitalen und KI-bezogenen Fähigkeiten sowie den Verhaltensprinzipien der BASF Winning Ways und stellen deren nachhaltige Verankerung in der Organisation sicher. Thought Leadership: Sie beobachten kontinuierlich externe Trends und interne Prioritäten, um neue Methoden und skalierbare Lösungen für die zukünftigen Herausforderungen der BASF-Lieferkette zu entwickeln. WAS SIE MITBRINGEN mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Supply-Chain-Beratung oder in Transformationsrollen, idealerweise in der CORE-Chemieindustrie, im Consumer-Care-Bereich oder in anlagenintensiven Industrien nachgewiesene Expertise in Bereichen wie Supply-Chain-Strategie, Planung, S&OP, Kostenoptimierung, Bestandsmanagement oder Logistik ausgeprägtes strategisches Denkvermögen mit einer praxisorientierten, datengetriebenen Arbeitsweise sowie Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams und im Umgang mit komplexen Stakeholder-Landschaften erfahrung mit Advanced Analytics, KI-gestützter Planung oder digitalen Supply-Chain-Lösungen ist ein großer Vorteil hervorragende Englischkenntnisse; gute Deutschkenntnisse und internationale Berufserfahrung sind von Vorteil hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Neugier und unternehmerischem Antrieb, im Einklang mit den BASF Winning Ways WAS WIR BIETEN Attraktive Lage: Ihr Arbeitsort befindet sich in Monheim (nahe Düsseldorf), dem administrativen Headquarter der BASF Personal Care & Nutrition GmbH. Das Büro in Monheim verfügt über eine Kantine und moderne, flexible Arbeitsplätze, die für verschiedene Teams und Funktionen ausgelegt sind. Hybrides Arbeiten: Sie können Remote-Arbeit mit bis zu 3 Bürotagen kombinieren. Regelmäßige Besuche unseres Headquarters in Ludwigshafen sind erforderlich, z. B. für monatliche Teamtage oder Abteilungsevents. Je nach Projekt/Kunde können Reisen zu anderen BASF-Standorten notwendig sein. Work-Life-Balance: Wir bieten Zugang zu Kinderbetreuungsangeboten, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Kooperationen mit Fitness- und Gesundheitsstudios sowie zahlreiche andere (präventive) Angebote für Ihre mentale und körperliche Gesundheit. Persönliche Entwicklung: Wir bieten ein umfassendes Schulungsprogramm, das auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnitten ist. Unsere Einheit hat eine nachweisliche Erfolgsbilanz in der Karriereentwicklung von Mitarbeitern: Ehemalige Teammitglieder sind auf allen Hierarchieebenen weltweit bei BASF zu finden. Individuelle Unterstützung für Ihre berufliche Entwicklung ist Teil unserer Mission. Benefits: Ein attraktives Gehalt und ein variabler Bonus, Mitarbeiteraktienoptionen, die Möglichkeit von Sonderurlaub, 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub, Kantinen mit frisch zubereitetem Essen, Jobrad, soziale Beratung und viele weitere. SO ERREICHEN SIE UNS Jennifer Weiz (Talent Acquisition), jennifer.weiz@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-56454 beantwortet gerne Ihre Fragen zu dieser Position. Unser Recruiting-Team erreichen Sie auch hier . Erste Informationen zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess finden Sie hier . Auf Basis natürlicher, nachwachsender Rohstoffe entwickeln und produzieren wir ein großes Sortiment an Inhaltsstoffen für die Körperpflegeindustrie. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US As an international service hub, the BASF Services Europe GmbH bundles a wide range of services for the BASF Group throughout Europe. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our career opportunities here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Payroll & People Data (Analyst) - 12 month Leasing
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position •    Understand business needs and provide expert advice, services and solutions on Payroll, HR data, systems and processes. •    Provide expert consultation in payroll and HR data practices by staying abreast of current and emerging market insights and legal legislations in local countries. •    Drive process improvements, automation, and digitalization measures to offer best service delivery experience. •    Ensure payroll and statutory reporting and payments are processed with high accuracy and timeliness according to our SLAs and local legal requirements. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Operational Excellence •    Ensure data quality and data integrity for Payroll and HR data maintenance processes. •    Manage full payroll portfolio (either in-house or via vendors) accurately, timely and in compliance with statutory requirements, business policies and company guidelines. Responsible for payroll issues resolutions, data analysis, payroll accounting activities, payroll taxation and legislation administration. •    Provides solutions to manage time and attendance processes for office and production workers, including the maintenance of time system configurations, time settings such as public holiday calendar maintenance, work schedules arrangements, time calculation rules etc. •    Provide actual payroll and compensation data based on SAPHR to the Compensation & Benefits and Mobility teams in support of the salary review management. Develop expertise in International labor and social standards and support relevant internal/external audit analysis (for example: Corporate Audits, external audits, FRC processes) •    Responsible for vendor management for Payroll, which includes service provider scouting, selection, negotiation, contract management, onboarding, performance monitoring and vendor invoice processing. •    Accountable to ensure finance processes with relevance to payroll is followed through with high accuracy and timeliness. Service Engagement •    Provide advisory such as manual payment calculation, pay slip simulation, gross up computations for payment, national service claims etc. •    Monitor and stay abreast with local payroll legislation which affects the HR climate and support business to manage changes proactively. •    Analyze, clarify, and resolve operation issues and enquiries with close collaboration with relevant Country HR and Regional HR Business Partners to ensure quality services are delivered from the service hub. All unsolved and potential operational issues are escalated timely according to establish escalation process, with detailed analysis provided to Assistant Manager and Manager. Process Improvement and Project Initiatives •    Continuously review and update knowledge documents in areas of Payroll and HR data to develop the formation of competence hub. •    Identify opportunities, prepare and analyze business case and participate in digitalization and process optimization. Actively work on implementation of process improvements, automation and digitalization measures which will be rolled out predominantly in the GB KL Hub for achieving the efficiency target. •    Drive initiatives which contribute to the improvement of service experience •    Develop and maintain the blueprints of multiple system processors in Payroll and HR data maintenance processes to ensure the capturing of business requirements, system settings, configuration needs and change trackers. Provide inputs and participate in user acceptance testing in system maintenance and upgrade, follow up and escalate timely with respective party to ensure fixes or changes can be delivered on time. •    Participate in mergers and acquisitions activities pertaining to setting up or transfer of payroll and HR data maintenance activities. Ensure successful implementation of payroll and HR data maintenance processes for mergers and acquisition activities. Team Collaboration •    Works autonomously within established procedures and practices; seeks guidance in the more complex aspects of the process. •    Contribute positively to a knowledge sharing environment through generously provide guidance and sharing knowledge with others. •    Guides and trains junior team members and newly joined team members. Job Requirements Education •    Relevant tertiary qualifications: Degree in Accounting, Mathematics, Commerce, Business Administration and Finance Working Experience •    With minimum 3 years of related HR working experiences in Payroll and HR Operations •    Experience in relevant payroll procedures, practices and country statutory •    Working knowledge of integrated payroll systems preferably on SAP. Technical & Professional Knowledge •    Demonstrates a high level of proficiency in language and culture of the supported country/location. •    Understanding of HR principals and/or Employee Laws of the supported country/location. •    Strong processing skills and analytical abilities (inclination for Mathematics/Finance/Problem solving). •    Service mindset with strong interpersonal and communications skills. •    Functional knowledge and skills in using Microsoft application i.e. Words, Excel, Power Point. About BASF in Malaysia BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: QA/QC Coordinator
jobs.description: Now hiring! QA/QC Coordinator Palmyra, MO We are looking for a QA/QC Coordinator to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Palmyra, MO. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. The QA/QC Coordinator ensures product quality and compliance across the site by interacting daily with laboratory and plant personnel (production managers, supervisors, operators, and logistics) to confirm products are produced within specifications and coordinating laboratory testing as needed. The role coordinates activities to maintain the site quality management system, manages quality data in SAP and/or LIMS, and serves as the site non-conformance coordinator—leading root‑cause investigations and implementing effective corrective actions. The QA/QC Coordinator also tracks and reports site quality KPIs and, where applicable, acts as the delegate for the Site Quality Manager. As a QA/QC Coordinator, you create chemistry by... Maintaining compliance with all safety regulations and procedures Coordinating activities to uphold the site quality management system, including data management in SAP and/or LIMS and conducting internal auditsgenerating Certificates of Analysis as required Ensuring continuous laboratory operations to support manufacturing, including routine QC testing, data review, and record management as needed Serving as the site non‑conformance coordinator by leading root‑cause investigations and implementing effective corrective actions Tracking and reporting site quality KPIs and compiling analytical data to support campaign reviews, compliance monitoring, and audits Packaging and shipping dangerous goods following IATA protocols and supporting non‑routine shipping as backup to the Lab Services/QA Coordinator Coordinating non‑routine testing and continuous‑improvement initiatives as requiredacting as deputy to the Site Quality Manager in their absence, where applicable If you... Hold a high school diploma or equivalent. BS/BA in Sciences, Chemistry, Biology, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field preferred Have at least 3 years of QA/QC experience with a relevant degree, or at least 10 years of QA/QC experience without a degree Bring experience working in a manufacturing environment preferred Possess working knowledge of quality management systems (e.g., ISO 9001), LIMS, and/or SAP. PowerBI and/or Excel experience preferred Have practical experience with laboratory analytical testing techniques Demonstrate strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with diverse internal stakeholders Have previous experience with auditing preferred Are able to travel up 5%, domestically. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. jobs.name: Freights and Brokers Analyst (fixed-term project-based)
jobs.description: This position is offered under a fixed‑term, project‑based contract, with a minimum guaranteed duration of six months. Who we are: We are BASF, the largest chemical company in the world, with more than 150 years of experience. In Montevideo, we operate as a HUB providing services to all BASF companies across the Americas. We offer professional solutions in finance, procurement, reporting, logistics, technology, human resources, projects, communications, legal affairs, environment, safety, health, and quality. Area: Purchase to Pay Services Americas (P2P) is part of the Supplier and Reporting (GBR) cluster and includes Procurement and Accounts Payable E2E Services for the entire Americas region. In P2P, we are responsible for acquiring goods and services up to the payment stage. Our area processes plant demands and ensures invoices are paid when appropriate so that there are no delays in the production process. Everything required for a chemical plant to operate is purchased by P2P: chemical products, reagents, gloves, food, etc. Main Objective of the Position: The freight and brokers analyst manages the daily finance operations within the Freight Cost Management team. He/she is responsible for the correct and timely invoice processing according to global KPIs. The freight and brokers analyst works very closely with the account management analyst, ensuring the success of the cluster targets. Main Tasks: Assures daily business in terms of invoice entry and processing Understands the stakeholder’s specifications and needs and acts as single point for the designated brokers or carriers. Anticipate, identify and evaluate possible risks that may affect the owned process and results to propose mitigation strategies to achieve the established objectives. Periodically report on the progress and status of the brokers and freights daily business and escalate to management as needed. Conduct training and participate in internal initiatives or projects as needed. Seeks for automation opportunities and continuous improvement. Minimum Education and Qualification Required for the Position: Education: University Degree or advanced student in Administration, Finance, Foreign Trade, or similar. Working Experience: 2 or + years of previous experience in similar positions. Languages : English (advanced), Portuguese (valued). Technical Skills: Knowledge of SAP and MS Office (Advanced Excel). Soft Skills: Strong customer focus and communication skills. What we offer: Living BASF means being part of a culture where the focus is on people and on their professional and personal development. Our diversity, collaboration, and leadership style make the difference. By joining our team, we offer you: • A hybrid and flexible work model • Access to a learning ecosystem with on‑demand resources and tools • Private medical insurance for you and your family from day one, as well as life insurance • Additional flexible leave days, in addition to your statutory vacation days • A day off on your birthday • A day off for moving • Annual bonus (subject to meeting the requirements established by internal policies) • Well‑being benefits, such as on‑site nutrition services and massages BASF considers Law No. 19.691 and Decree No. 73/019 in all its hiring processes. Any qualified candidate who meets the requirements outlined in the job description will be considered in this hiring process without distinction of any kind. In addition, BASF is an equal opportunity employer. We enthusiastically embrace our responsibility to make employment decisions without regard to race, age, marital or social status, national origin, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic or group not related to the candidate’s suitability and qualifications for the position. Our management is committed to upholding this policy in hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, demotion, dismissal, termination, recruitment, compensation and other forms of remuneration, training, and general treatment throughout employment.

Vores produkter anvendes globalt i fødevare-, kosttilskuds- og medicinalindustrien, og vi beskæftiger ca. 130 engagerede medarbejdere. For at styrke vores produktionsteam søger vi nu en operatør, der med både faglighed og personlighed kan være med til at holde vores høje kvalitet og sikre en stabil produktion. Vores værdisæt, Winning Behaviors, handler om ejerskab, fremdrift og et mindset præget af forbedringer – og vi leder efter en kollega, der deler disse værdier. HVAD DU KAN FORVENTE Som operatør bliver du en central del af vores team, der har ansvaret for at sikre optimal drift af vores vitaminproduktion. Efter oplæring forventer vi, at du på sigt kan varetage alle arbejdsområder i produktionsprocessen – herunder også lager, blanding og pakning. Dine primære opgaver vil være: •    Drift, overvågning og betjening af processen •    Klargøring af udstyr og procesområder •    Prøveudtagning og proceskontrol •    Skriftlig dokumentation og rapportering •    Rengøring af anlæg, udstyr og lokaler •    Tværgående samarbejde med kolleger om drift og optimering Arbejdstiden er på skiftehold, typisk med vagter på 8, 12 eller 12,5 timer placeret over hele ugen. Jusqu’au 1er juillet, notre activité faisait partie de BASF. Dans le cadre de cette transition, toutes les offres d’emploi ainsi que le processus de candidature sont encore hébergés sur la plateforme BASF et présentés sous l’identité visuelle de BASF. Merci de ne pas vous laisser dérouter par cette situation : tous les postes proposés sont des opportunités au sein de Surventis, et votre candidature nous sera directement transmise. Chez Surventis, nous allons au-delà des apparences dans tout ce que nous entreprenons. Nous plaçons nos clients au cœur de nos décisions, anticipons leurs besoins et développons des solutions qui créent une véritable valeur ajoutée ainsi que des partenariats durables. Nous nous inspirons mutuellement à voir plus loin, à prendre pleinement la responsabilité de notre travail et à repousser sans cesse les limites du possible. Si vous venez avec toute votre authenticité, osez remettre en question les évidences et souhaitez évoluer au sein d’une équipe qui met réellement ses valeurs en pratique, alors vous êtes au bon endroit. VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Rattaché au Responsable HSE, vous proposez et mettez en œuvre les systèmes et les programmes de prévention destinés à améliorer la sécurité des procédés du site en adéquation avec les exigences règlementaires et Groupe SURVENTIS. À ce titre : Vous garantissez l'animation de la politique du site en matière de sécurité des procédés ; Vous garantissez le pilotage des analyses de risques des installations lors des projets d´amélioration ou des installations nouvelles (APR, HAZOP, SHE review, PID review etc. ) en accord avec les référentiels Groupe et en lien avec les experts Groupe ; Vous garantissez la mise à jour des Études de Dangers sur les installations neuves ou existantes, notamment dans le cadre des révisions quinquennales ; Vous garantissez le conseil et l'assistance dans votre domaine ; Vous contribuez à la prévention et la maîtrise du risque industriel sur le site y compris au travers de l'animation du système de gestion de la sécurité (SGS) incluant la rédaction des dossiers de sécurité ; Vous contribuez à la mise en place et à l´évolution des procédures et consignes en sécurité des procédés et veiller à leurs conformités d'application ; Vous contribuez au respect des législations et réglementations et des exigences SURVENTIS en vigueur en matière de sécurité des procédés ; Vous contribuez à la gestion des modifications sur le site ; Vous contribuez aux missions du service HSE. VOTRE PROFIL Doté d'un diplôme en Ingénierie des Procédés, vous possédez une expérience confirmée en suivi de site SEVESO ainsi que dans les méthodologies d'analyse des risques (APR, HAZOP, ...) ; Vos capacités relationnelles vous permettent de gérer des projets transversaux ; Vous êtes capable d'animer des sessions de formation ; Vous maîtrisez l'informatique (MS Office) et parlez couramment l'anglais. CE POSTE VOUS INTERESSE ? Pour candidater, il suffit de cliquer sur le bouton « postuler » sur cette fiche de poste. Vous devrez alors créer votre profil et ajouter vos documents de candidatures. Cela ne vous prendra que quelques minutes. Emilie, en charge de ce recrutement, reçoit et analyse toutes les candidatures et enverra un courriel aux candidats présélectionnés pour les inviter à un entretien vidéo MS Teams de 30 minutes. Nous vous souhaitons bonne chance et sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature ! Seules les candidatures soumises via l’offre publiée sur notre site carrière seront étudiées. Toute candidature reçue en dehors du processus prévu (par e-mail, par exemple) ne sera pas considérée. Pour bien comprendre le processus, vous pouvez vous rendre sur cette page dédiée. Il vous reste des questions ? Vous pouvez nous contacter ici. QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? Coatings France est spécialisée dans le développement, la production et la commercialisation de différentes solutions de revêtement allant des traitements de surface à la peinture automobile. Nous soutenons l'innovation, le design et de nouvelles possibilités d'applications au sein d'une équipe internationale dont l'objectif est de répondre aux besoins de nos partenaires dans le monde entier. Notre gamme de services comprend également le programme « Innovation Beyond Paint » qui vise le développement de nouveaux marchés et de modèles commerciaux. La diversité est notre plus grande force ! Rejoignez notre formule gagnante et venez développer le futur avec nous - au sein d'une équipe internationale qui encourage l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances indépendamment du genre, de l'âge, de l'origine, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou des croyances. jobs.name: Assistant Manager, Customer Service, Intermediates Asia Pacific
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . O bjectives of the Position This role is responsible for day-to-day order management and provides a consistently high level of service in line with business strategies for operational excellence and customer satisfaction, objectives & act as key user of OTC process including: Manage Order to Cash at direct the related business unit(s) of Customer Service properly. Provide solutions to business operations and customer service group proactively by analyzing / reviewing related Order to Cash operations and increasing continuous efficiency and improvement. Drive actions that directly contribute to achieving sales, profit, and growth targets by offering services that meet customer needs with support from supervisors / team members Expert of OTC processes and act as key user of SAP Implementing new system function or changes or upgrading in customer service team Support Project Mercury implementation Responsibilities Key Performance Indicators – Response for the managing of core KPIs, including steering actions for improving performance within related business unit(s), i.e. Delivery Reliability, Days of Sales Outstanding, # of SOLI / FTE Customer relationship management – manage customer relationships in accordance with related business unit(s), and sales strategies, e.g. perspectives, sales excellence, value-based management, key account management, and business rules. Order to Cash and Non-conformance management – Provide order management-related expertise and information to business, functional counterparts and related business unit(s) customer services community for continuous process improvement, system harmonization and solution coordinator for process problem solving. Offer guidance to CSO team in capturing customer expectations / requirement in NCM process within own responsible business area. Analyze the root causes, propose corrective measures and ensure on-time closure of the end-to-end process in coordination with BUs and Functions for non-product quality complaints Continuous Improvement – Propose solutions in order to enhance customer satisfaction as well as to enhance efficiency as solution provider within related own OTC area. Logistics Service Providers – Provides operational support of LSP operations in terms of on time delivery and shipment.  Responsible to ensure appropriate services, such as compliance, on time delivery to meet business requirements, manage business rules in line with budget. Process Improvement – Identify and implement of improvements with supervision from supervisor(s)  in own business process areas and share best practices among customer service community to contribute to strengthen related OTC areas of customer service group. Projects –Participate implementation and timeline of customer service related projects within own related business unit Integration – Manage related customer service activities, including best practice sharing, process set up and system migration.  Periodic review of process to identify improvement opportunities. Act as SAP key user and provide training to customer service team or support on system trouble shooting. Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Economics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering or equivalent experience Knowledge of Power BI, Power Automation will be an advantage. Ability to speak Mandarin will be an advantage (but not a must). Working Experience Minimum of 3 years of experience in Business Management, Supply Chain Management, Internation Trades, Logistics Operation; Prior leadership experience is preferred Familiar with SAP SD, MM & TM modules Candidates with less experience may also be considered for this role at a lower job grade, depending on qualifications and potential. Technical & Professional Knowledge Good knowledge of international trade and shipping operation. Thorough knowledge of sales process and OTC process. Financial & Accounting knowledge will be an advantage. Good understanding of the products / services offers in a responsible area. Good understanding on purpose / objectives on operational handling topics. Good communication skills and strong collaborative spirit About BASF in Malaysia BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. jobs.name: Regulatory Affairs Officer TEMPORAL(m/f/d)
jobs.description: The world needs innovations, and our team needs you! We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Our solutions are purposefully designed for different crop systems, connecting seeds and traits, crop protection, digital tools and sustainability approaches. We strive to deliver the best possible outcomes to farmers, growers, and other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers, and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions vision & mission ! WHAT YOU WILL DO At our Barcelona site, you will join the Regulatory Affairs team and contribute to the successful management of our Agricultural Solutions portfolio by: Requesting and following up on certificates through the RegHub system, including composition certificates, supply letters, Letters of Access (LoA), and fee requests. Uploading documents and maintaining accurate information in RegHub and other regulatory databases. Coordinating label-related activities with Supply Chain, Artwork, and Product Safety teams, including tracking new Unique Formula Identifiers (UFIs). Preparing and uploading regulatory dossiers, including requesting composition certificates, supply letters, Letters of Access (LoA), and fee requests through RegHub, in support of F500 submissions. Preparing and submitting administrative petitions to Spanish regulatory authorities. Supporting the preparation and follow-up of registration dossiers for plant protection products, biocides, biostimulants, and fertilizers under the guidance of senior team members. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Supply Chain, to support regulatory processes. Providing administrative support for third-party agreements. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Natural Sciences, or a comparable scientific background Basic knowledge of Regulatory Affairs; previous experience is a plus but not mandatory Proficiency in Spanish and English, enabling effective work in an international environment Strong analytical and organizational skills Excellent communication and collaboration skills Detail-oriented and scientifically minded, with a structured and accuracy-focused approach WHAT WE OFFER Estimated initial duration: 4 months. Healthy work environment: where your safety and health (both physical and mental) are always our priority. Attractive salary package: based on a fixed salary and a bonus based on performance. Flexible compensation plan: to take advantage of services such as Health Insurance, Childcare, Transportation Card, and Training, among others. Professional development: we promote continuous training and access to internal vacancies to keep growing at BASF. Work-life balance measures: as well as financial assistance for the schooling of children. Sports sections: where you can connect with colleagues and play football, paddle, basketball, cycling, yoga, etc. Flexible work: with the chance to work from home and adjusting your schedule, depending on your position and workplace. And much more. HOW TO PARTICIPATE IN THE PROCESS Send your CV through the job offer so we can get to know each other. If your profile matches, we will call you from the Spanish Talent Acquisition team in Germany (prefix +49) and support you throughout the process. With each step, you will be closer to meeting your future team! If you have any further questions about this process, please contact: Vanessa (vanessa.morales-soto@basf.com) *Please note that we will not be able to accept your resume via this email. This are our values, they guide us and describe who we are and how we act. If you identify with them, BASF is the place for you! Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. As the world’s leading chemical company, we deliver innovative solutions that support key industries across Africa from agriculture, mining, coatings, health & nutrition, and performance materials. We combine global expertise with strong local presence, working closely with customers and partners to address regional challenges and drive sustainable growth. Our people are at the heart of what we do. We value diverse perspectives, encourage development and offer opportunities for careers to grow based on both performance and potential. jobs.name: Senior Manager, Technology
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position Own and drive regional technology for Acrylic Acid & Acrylates as the single technology focal point for Asia Pacific. Lead technical execution of investment projects and ensure on‑time, on‑budget delivery. Drive OpEx and cost‑reduction initiatives to improve asset effectiveness and KPIs. Coordinate cross‑functional stakeholders to implement technology and reliability measures. Provide hands‑on technical support, troubleshooting and capability building across the region. Main Tasks Act as the accountable regional technology owner for Acrylic Acid & Acrylates in Asia - proactively drive technical support, decisions and improvements at all production sites. Lead technical dialogues with external partners and project teams to define, design and approve tie‑ins, plant integrations and raw‑material feed specifications; own the technical interface and ensure robust integration plans. Serve as the single interface between Global Technology & Strategy, Operations and Regional Business Management; prepare and steer internal decision packages and approval processes (Commissions S and F). Evaluate technical and economic viability of projects - from debottlenecking and new site assessments to alternative feedstock options - and recommend clear go/no‑go and make‑or‑buy decisions aligned with regional strategy. Drive and/or lead cost and technology benchmarking studies, delivering actionable recommendations to reduce manufacturing cost and improve competitiveness. Own process and product safety activities for the portfolio in Asia, including regulatory compliance and risk‑mitigation measures; escalate and resolve safety or compliance gaps. Lead Operational Excellence across all Acrylic Acid & Acrylates assets in the region: define targets, prioritize initiatives, sponsor implementation and ensure sustained KPI improvements. Minimum Education and Qualification Required for the Position Degree: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a closely related engineering/technical field. Experience: Minimum 6 years of hands‑on experience in chemical manufacturing or technology development, with demonstrated problem‑solving in production environments and proven responsibility in managing investment projects (engineering, commissioning or debottlenecking). Technical expertise: Strong, practical knowledge of Acrylic Acid & Acrylates production processes, including process design, plant operations and process control systems. Project and commercial skills: Solid track record in project management (scope, schedule, budget), technology and manufacturing cost evaluations, and executing make‑or‑buy assessments. Operational excellence & safety: Experience driving OpEx initiatives and applying process and product safety, regulatory compliance, and risk‑reduction measures in plant environments. Communication & leadership: Fluent in English; proficiency in Mandarin preferred. Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and cross‑functional communication skills; ability to lead technical discussions with internal and external partners. Tools & methods: Proficiency with engineering design standards, manufacturing cost models, common process simulation/control tools and standard office software. 请时刻警惕任何可能的招聘欺诈行为！请注意，巴斯夫绝不会在任何情况下向候选人以任何形式收取任何费用。

jobs.name: Operatore di Produzione - Fino Mornasco (CO)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Lozioni per la cura della pelle, shampoo delicati, creme per la protezione solare, detergenti delicati ed efficienti per la casa e l'industria: tutti questi prodotti impiegano ingredienti formulati dalla nostra divisione Care Chemicals. La conoscenza delle norme in materia di sicurezza e salute costituisce un requisito qualificante per la scelta del candidato. Conoscenza di base della lingua Inglese. Lavoro su ciclo continuo. I suoi prodotti sono impiegati in molti settori di attività quali edilizia, agricoltura, packaging, materie plastiche e automotive. Soluzioni e persone di BASF Italia contribuiscono al successo di centinaia di clienti che hanno la necessità di affrontare e vincere impegnative sfide globali: tutela ambientale, efficienza energetica, nutrizione e mobilità. jobs.name: Electrical Maintenance/Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Now hiring! Electrical Maintenance/Reliability Engineer Freeport, TX, Geismar, LA, Houston, TX, Spartanburg, NC, Wyandotte, MI. We are looking for a Electrical Maintenance/Reliability Engr  to join our GE team. Come create chemistry with us! At BASF, we create chemistry through the power of connected minds. By balancing economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility, we are building a more sustainable future through chemistry. As the world’s leading chemical company, we help our customers in nearly every industry meet the current and future needs of society through science and innovation. We are seeking a professional like you to be part of the Automation, Controls and Electrical team within the North American (NA) Technical Expertise department. In this role, you will lead electrical engineering design, maintenance & reliability efforts across our manufacturing sites, including but not limited to greenfield and brownfield capital projects, site support activities, reliability improvements, and power system studies. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (discipline engineers, project managers, plant operations, and maintenance personnel) to deliver innovative and cost-effective engineering solutions. Your responsibilities will also include providing technical guidance to less experienced I&E engineers and designers, whether in-house or from third-party firms. You will be responsible for reviewing design documentation submittals and understanding how the designs interact with manufacturing systems to reduce cost, improve sustainability, and develop best practices within the production process. Your participation in teams, internal committees (Electrical Safe Working Group / RATN), and ad hoc assignments to represent the discipline are key to success. As a Electrical Maintenance/Reliability Engineer, you create chemistry by... Offering engineering expertise and leadership for low, medium & high voltage hardware & distribution systems maintenance & reliability, including electrical safety and explosion protection. Providing technical support and solutions for manufacturing site initiatives, including power system design, modeling, and testing. Leading electrical engineering for capital projects, including estimating, design, procurement, and commissioning support. Efficiently executing electrical design, offer technical expertise on maintenance activities, and provide troubleshooting during construction and startup. Ensuring maintenance & reliability of low, medium, and high voltage systems (e.g., substations, transformers, motors, VFDs, UPS). Developing and managing preventive and predictive maintenance programs utilizing SAP and maintenance history/records. Conducting electrical studies (load flow, arc flash, relay coordination, etc.) using SKM PowerTools. Supporting BASF Corporation Sites and developing NEC Code-compliant electrical projects. Reviewing and approving electrical specifications, drawings, and construction work package documentation. Function as technical reviewer during MOC process. Participating in root cause failure analysis (RCFA) and develop corrective actions. Championing long term maintenance and reliability strategies, including long range planning and TAR work scope development support. Ensuring compliance with NFPA 70E, NEC, IEEE, and company standards. Collaborating with internal teams and external partners to drive continuous improvement. Proposing value-based engineering savings, participating in continuous improvement initiatives, and working with technical, project, and management teams. If you have... A Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 8 + years of experience in Electrical Engineering within chemical, petrochemical, or similar manufacturing sectors. The ability to manage multiple projects with varying and evolving priorities. Proficient and management and experience working with SKM Power Tools and SAP. Robust experience driving safe, sustainable, and efficient solutions in BASF facilities. Demonstrated capability to collaborate effectively and passion for problem-solving and innovation. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Operational vendor management activities support on performance reporting and analytics e.g., LLP implementation training / support, etc. where assigned. Familiar with performance management of logistics service provider especially performance metrics and supplier management Experience in SAP/ERP Transport Management (TM) module Technical & Professional Knowledge Proficient in MS Office applications such as Excel, PowerPoint, Word, MS Teams Knowledge in SAP system (Transport Management) and data analytics preferred.
