jobs.name: External Data Management Specialist
jobs.description: Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur attracts, inspire and develop diverse talents who will elevate BASF’s digital journey. As one of the world’s largest chemical companies, BASF is on a mission to create chemistry with a sustainable future. The Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur, alongside four other Digital Hubs across the globe are part of the technology powerhouse driving our vision. Join our organization and make an impact in an inclusive and diverse work environment. We value individual differences and provide opportunities for you to contribute your unique perspective towards our collective goals. As part of our Data Products & Semantics Team, you play a key role in the management of external data at BASF. You are responsible for ensuring that high-quality external data is selected, procured, managed, and made available across the organization in a transparent and cost-efficient way. With a current portfolio of 11 major external data providers, the team streamlines data demand across Sales & Market functions, with a strong focus on pricing, company, and trade data. You will work at the intersection of data, procurement, controlling, and IT, contributing directly to the standardization at BASF. Responsibilities and Key Outcomes You take care of the external data management lifecycle, from data demand assessment, through purchasing and contract-related processes, to data delivery. You manage and continuously optimize the external data provider portfolio, ensuring standardization in line with business needs. You maintain and manage purchasing and work cycle processes in SAP in line with Procurement. You serve as the central point of contact for the external data portfolio, acting as the knowledge authority for subscription packages, licensing models, and permitted usage across the organization. You administer sub-services for external data subscriptions, including the creation, maintenance, and update of service calculations and cost models as well as general user access gatekeeping. You actively support the implementation of our standardization strategy, particularly by managing and evolving the charging model towards a transparent and standardized cost allocation. You are responsible for communication with data consumers and controlling stakeholders, including cost transparency, charging logic, supplier updates, disruptions, and invoicing-related questions. You collaborate closely with technical experts to ensure efficient data provisioning and management of external data as standardized data products. You develop a sufficient understanding of the underlying data and use cases to effectively support procurement in discussions with data providers and stakeholder related questions. You work cross-functionally with experts from data, IT, procurement, controlling, and business units across the organization. Job Requirements University degree in Business Administration, Business Informatics, or a comparable field. Strong interest in external data management, data provisioning, or data-related procurement processes. Structured and analytical working style with a high level of ownership and reliability. Working knowledge of Microsoft tools, especially Excel and Power BI and ideally first experience in SAP. Strong communication skills and the ability to interact confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have: Familiarity with pricing data, company data, trade data, or market intelligence data providers. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. jobs.name: Digital Trainee Program - Software Engineering (Data Products & Semantics)
jobs.description: Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur attracts, inspire and develop diverse talents who will elevate BASF’s digital journey. As one of the world’s largest chemical companies, BASF is on a mission to create chemistry with a sustainable future. The Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur, alongside four other Digital Hubs across the globe are part of the technology powerhouse driving our vision. Join our organization and make an impact in an inclusive and diverse work environment. We value individual differences and provide opportunities for you to contribute your unique perspective towards our collective goals. With BASF’s Digital Trainee Programme, we believe in preparing you for the future: as we embark on one of the largest digital transformation journeys in Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur (DHKL) Hub, we are on the hunt for bright digital talents to be a part of this exciting digital vision for BASF! Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur is supporting the BASF business in transforming the digitalization landscape – our mission is to drive forward the digital transformation of BASF, providing innovative, global and high-quality digital products and services through a strong agile culture – question is, are you up for the challenge? Rest assured, you will be given full accountability from Day 1 to make an impact – be involved in exciting projects that allows you to bring your creativity, passion, and pioneering spirit to our global teams. You will learn from the best mentors and coaches we have to offer, coupled with opportunities to work with some of the brightest digital minds. You will also have opportunities to train and develop technical and functional capabilities – a highly valued expertise for your career development. What to expect: Our 20-month Digital Trainee Programme will give you insights into the various activities that take place in Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur. You will familiarize yourself with various topics across various systems, and how it works in the larger BASF landscape. Gain a comprehensive understanding of unit-specific and cross-unit tasks. After just a short time, you will assume responsibility for exciting projects or subprojects. You will be assigned to four rotations, each lasting approximately five months each. Upon successful completion of your rotations, you will have the opportunity to do a rotation in other Global Digital Hubs to expand your network and further develop your intercultural skills. The team Data Products and Semantics coordinates the creation and management of data products. Data products are reusable sets of data for enterprise-wide usage with high-quality and prepared to be fit for purpose. To ensure a smooth and solid governance and curation of data products we develop and optimize the tool Data Product FAIRway. FAIRway guides Data Product Owners through all steps of lifecycle management of a data product. Ultimately, all data product metadata are transmitted to the data catalog and build the foundation for users to explore and shop data products. As a trainee at Data Products & Semantics you will be part of the FAIRway development team and support to achieve the next milestones towards an expanded Data Ecosystem. You will work according to agile methodology and be integral part of planning, executing and reviewing sprint items You’ll hands-on develop needed components (backend or frontend) and collaborate with your colleagues to achieve the relevant steps You’ll contribute to improve the user experience with the tool As part of our strategy, we are integrating further data product platforms (e.g. for SAP-based data products) into our Data Ecosystem – you will learn and be able to work with BASF’s main data sources as they are added to the Ecosystem To succeed in the role, you: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Informatics, Business Informatics, or a related field. Fresh graduate or up to 2 years of relevant work experience. Basic programming skills in Python. Understanding of modern front-end development concepts and frameworks (e.g., Vue.js). Basic knowledge of API integration and web services. Basic understanding of cloud technologies and software architecture concepts. Strong learning agility, a positive attitude, and a growth mindset. Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Passion for technology, software engineering, and continuous learning. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises six segments: Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €68.9 billion in 2023. BASF is committed to empowering its employees to pursue their interests and explore emerging technologies. By investing in top-quality tools and promoting cross-functional collaboration, we encourage our team members to drive positive change within our organization. Come join us and be a part of our digitalization journey . Further Information at https://go.basf.net/careers_digitalhubkl

jobs.name: Electrical & Instrumentation Technician
jobs.description: Now Hiring! E/I Technician Savannah, GA The world needs creative solutions. We need YOU! Where the Chemistry Happens... The BASF Savannah plant manufactures and operates the following products: fluid catalytic cracking (FCC) catalysts, co-catalysts and additives used by petroleum refiners to convert crude oil into gasoline, other transportation fuels, heating oil, and petrochemical feed stocks. Our portfolio serves industries such as the automotive, chemical sectors, refineries, battery manufacturers as well as the production of fuels, chemicals and plastics. As an Electrical & Instrumentation Technician for our Catalyst business unit, you will start a meaningful career and you will be responsible to install, maintain, and troubleshoot site instrumentation, control systems, and electrical equipment to provide safe operation with maximum production availability. During your straight Monday to Friday day shift as an E/I Technician, you will Complete required repairs and tasks to instruments, controls, and electrical systems in an efficient, timely manner to restore or maintain safe operating capability. Work with process equipment programs, Ladder logic, computer skills (email/word/excel/SAP). Pressure devices/DC VFD’s is a plus. Be responsible for installing repairing and maintaining the Instrument and Electrical equipment, as well as encompassing the plant switch-gear installations, electrical and pneumatic system across site using drawings, manuals, or blueprints. Interpret electrical schematics, blueprints and computer logic to trouble shoot production problems and resolve them. Perform process control, sensing and monitoring system calibrations, record keeping and communicate any alterations to existing instrument (control, or electrical systems) to ensure all site records are current and proper documentation is completed. Recommend changes to existing instruments, controls, electrical systems, or equipment to improve reliability, accuracy, or further optimize processes. Suggest tools, equipment, or methods to improve the safety and timeliness of system repairs. Maintain acceptable housekeeping standards in the work area. Complete Root Cause Failure Analysis investigations and occasionally operate forklifts and manlifts. If you have... Have a High School Diploma or GED. Have at least 2 years of I/E industrial maintenance experience (preferred). Possess related work experience reading loop sheets, electrical interconnect drawings, ladder logic drawings, equipment, and process instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs) and knowledge of prevailing electrical codes. Have basic knowledge of MS Office. SAP preferred. Are available to work a flexible schedule and occasionally overtime on nights and weekends such as call outs. The ability to lift up to 50 lbs and occasionally work with heights. Then... Click below to Belong@BASF! Create Your Own Chemistry when taking advantage of our Total Rewards. At BASF you get more than just compensation, Medical & Dental. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements you need to be your best in every stage of your life. That’s what we call you@BASF. Our Periodic Table of Benefits includes some additional perks below for starters… Flexible Work Arrangements whenever possible Retirement Benefits Maternity/Paternity Leave, Infertility & Adoption reimbursement Mentoring & Development Programs Employee Discounts Pet insurance Matching Donations to your favorite cause Access to our BASF Wine Cellar and much more! Privacy Statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact myhr@basf.com to report fraud. jobs.description: Now hiring! Scientist II - CASE market Southfield, MI (On-site) We are looking for a Scientist II - CASE market to join our Care Chemicals team in Southfield, MI. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Care Chemicals division is a globally leading supplier to the cosmetics, detergents and cleaning industries. We also offer solutions for technical applications and crop protection. Together with our customers, we create innovative solutions to meet the current and future needs of society more sustainably. We contribute to the long-term success of our customers’ brands with a broad range of products and concepts via our global network of production and development site. As part of this division, BASF Industrial Formulators plays a pivotal role in serving specialized markets with speed and agility. It is the leading global chemical supplier for agrochemical, CASE (Coatings, Adhesives, Sealants, and Elastomers) raw material, Health, and Industrial markets, focused on partnering with customers to create innovative solutions with great speed and agility to meet the current and future needs of society in a more sustainable way. The purpose of the job is to utilize strong technical expertise in the application of principles of chemistry and chemical engineering with special emphasis on surfactants and dispersants. It will also require strong statistical analysis and design of experiments tools to provide value-added technical solutions to unmet general market and specific customer needs in the application area of CASE (Coatings, Adhesives, Sealants and Elastomers) Raw Materials; which include surfactants for emulsion polymerization and aqueous emulsification of polymer resins and polyethylene glycols and polypropylene glycols for the synthesis of urethane and non-urethane based rheology modifiers. jobs.description: Now hiring! Site Manager We are looking for a Site Manager to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Lubbock, TX. Come create chemistry with us! jobs.description: Now hiring! Site Safety Specialist We are looking for a Site Safety Specialist to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Lubbock, TX. Come create chemistry with us! Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. jobs.name: Label Services (Senior Specialist)
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . O bjectives of the Position Label Services (Senior Specialist) plays a central and strategically significant role by ensuring compliance with and maintenance of the highest labeling standards in the region. Acting as a key contact, they serve as a liaison between Country Label Experts, Business Label Advisors, and the Global Label Advisor. This demanding position requires a proactive, independent working style that allows the specialist to develop innovative solutions to meet labeling requirements while simultaneously building effective communication and support networks. The role will be significantly involved in the implementation of a state-of-the-art label management system as part of the NGBA. M ain Tasks The role will be an integral part of the project team for NGBA (Next Generation Business Architecture) playing a crucial role in implementing the new label management system for North & South America region. This includes the precise translation of business requirements into process and system requirements, comprehensive testing, close coordination with the IT department and end users, particularly in production facilities and site logistics, as well as creating comprehensive documentation and conducting user training. Take the lead on (sub-)projects aimed at the continuous development and introduction of innovative processes and IT solutions to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in labeling. Qualification Education: Bachelor or other advanced degree Working experience: 4 years of working experience in EHS regulatory product safety and/with at least 2 years of experience in labelling for chemical industry. Fundamental knowledge of SAP processes, production and filling as well as delivery. International work experience is preferred. Skills: SAP EHS, SAP GLM, SAP PP (for MTI) and SD (for OTC) , MS Office in general, D&I Ability to work across North America & South America time zones

jobs.name: Executive Coordinator
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . O bjectives of the Position The Executive Coordinator manages the Director’s calendar, meetings, follow-up actions, presentations and written communication. The role works with managers and teams across Asia Pacific and is expected to complete tasks independently, follow up consistently and handle sensitive information professionally. Main Deliverables Execute related Product Safety services deliverables, including chemical Manage the Director’s calendar and recurring meeting schedule across Asia Pacific in a practical and organised way. Plan ahead, identify scheduling conflicts and maintain visibility of key meetings, deadlines, travel and business activities. Prepare meeting agendas and minutes, track agreed actions and follow up with relevant stakeholders. Prepare professional PowerPoint presentations, emails, meeting packs and management updates. Coordinate clearly and professionally with managers, teams and support functions across different locations. Work independently, adapt to changing priorities and escalate matters that require the Director’s decision. Handle confidential and sensitive information with good judgement and discretion. Main Deliverables Calendar and Schedule Management Manage the Director’s calendar and meeting schedule across Asia Pacific time zones. Plan recurring one-to-one, management, division and stakeholder meetings. Prioritise meeting requests and resolve calendar conflicts. Arrange meeting rooms and virtual or hybrid meeting facilities. Maintain visibility of key meetings, travel, deadlines and business activities. Meeting Administration and Follow-Up Prepare meeting agendas and coordinate pre-read materials. Attend designated meetings and prepare concise, accurate minutes. Record decisions, action items, responsible owners and due dates. Maintain action trackers and follow up on outstanding items. Maintain organised and confidential meeting records. Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate communication and activities between the Director, leadership team and internal stakeholders. Support communication and follow-up across Asia Pacific teams. Handle confidential and sensitive information professionally. Escalate unclear, sensitive or overdue matters when required. Maintain effective working relationships across functions, locations and cultures. Presentation and Written Communication Prepare and update PowerPoint presentations, reports and management materials. Draft professional emails, announcements and meeting communications. Prepare briefing documents, meeting packs and management updates. Check the accuracy, quality and consistency of documents before circulation. Maintain organised document filing and version control. Initiative and Event Coordination Coordinate leadership meetings, workshops, team events and business activities. Support the planning and tracking of departmental initiatives. Monitor key deadlines, deliverables and dependencies. Coordinate materials, participants and logistics for business activities. Identify delays or risks and raise them for timely action. Job Requirements Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, Office Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field. Candidates with an equivalent professional qualification and strong relevant executive support experience may also be considered. Technical & Professional Knowledge Minimum five years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Executive Coordinator, Secretary or similar role. Experience supporting a Director, department head, regional leader or senior management team. Experience managing a busy calendar across countries or time zones. Experience preparing agendas, taking management meeting minutes and following up actions. Experience preparing professional PowerPoint presentations and business emails. Experience working with confidential or sensitive information. Experience in a multinational or matrix organisation is preferred. Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Word and Excel. Clear written and spoken English. Good minute-taking, business writing and presentation-formatting skills. Good planning, prioritisation and follow-up discipline. Ability to work independently and manage several deadlines at the same time. Confidence to follow up with managers and senior stakeholders in a professional way. High attention to detail, confidentiality and accuracy. The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. The hub also won the title for Excellence in Learning Tech Advancement System and a Certificate of Excellence in Talent Management and Leadership at the HRD Awards 2024. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €65.3 billion in 2024. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. Further information at www.basf.com .

ปรับปรุง ซ่อมแซม ปรับแก้ฐานรองรับ และแก้ไขปัญหาการรั่วซึมตามมาตรฐานวิศวกรรม ปฏิบัติงานเชื่อมโลหะ (เช่น งานเชื่อมไฟฟ้า เชื่อมอาร์กอน หรือเชื่อมพื้นฐาน) สำหรับงานซ่อมบำรุงและงานผลิตชิ้นงานขนาดเล็ก โดยปฏิบัติตามข้อกำหนดด้านความปลอดภัยและคุณภาพ สนับสนุนงานซ่อมฉุกเฉินนอกเวลางาน และงานแก้ไขเครื่องจักรขัดข้องในทุกสาขางานตามที่ได้รับมอบหมาย การควบคุมโครงการ: ให้การสนับสนุนการติดตั้งหรือให้การสนับสนุนในการจัดการผู้รับเหมาในงานปรับปรุงพัฒนา หรืองานโครงการที่ได้รับการร้องขอจาก BU ที่เกี่ยวข้องกับระบบหน่วยสาธารณูปโภคและอาคารสถานที่ การบริหารจัดการผู้ให้บริการ: ให้คำแนะนำและตรวจตราผู้รับเหมาให้ปฏิบัติงานภายใต้มาตรฐานปฏิบัติงานด้วยมาตรฐานความปลอดภัยของ BASF การจัดทำเอกสารและการรายงาน: จัดทำ บันทึก และปรับปรุงเอกสารที่เกี่ยวข้องกับงานซ่อมบำรุง เช่น ใบงานซ่อม รายงานการตรวจสอบ แผน PM และประวัติอุปกรณ์ ให้ถูกต้องและเป็นปัจจุบัน บันทึกกิจกรรมซ่อมบำรุง ผลการตรวจสอบ การวิเคราะห์สาเหตุ และการแก้ไขปรับปรุง ลงในระบบหรือแบบฟอร์มที่กำหนด การใช้ Microsoft Office และระบบงาน: ใช้โปรแกรม Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) เพื่อสนับสนุนการวางแผนงานซ่อมบำรุง การจัดทำรายงาน การบันทึกข้อมูล และการติดต่อประสานงาน ดูแลและปรับปรุงข้อมูลการซ่อมบำรุง แผน PM รายการอะไหล่ และการวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลเบื้องต้นโดยใช้ Microsoft Excel ควบคุมและจัดเก็บเอกสารให้เป็นระบบ ตามขั้นตอนของบริษัท ข้อกำหนด ISO และพร้อมสำหรับการตรวจประเมิน งานอื่น ๆ: สนับสนุนงานต่างๆที่ได้รับมอบหมายจากหัวหน้างานและจากการหน่วยงานต่างๆ เผยแพร่ความรู้ทางเทคนิคที่ได้จากการทำงานให้กับเพื่อนร่วมทีมเพื่อการเรียนรู้และพัฒนาร่วมกัน ปฏิบัติตามกฎระเบียบและวิธีปฏิบัติของ ชีวอนามัย ความปลอดภัยและสิ่งแวดล้อม อย่างเคร่งครัดและดำเนินการให้เป็นผลสำเร็จ ดำเนินการเพื่อรักษาความเป็นระเบียบเรียบร้อยและความสะอาดของพื้นที่รับผิดชอบ ปฏิบัติตามกฎ/ข้อบังคับ EHS และข้อกำหนด RC ทั้งหมด, ISO9001, ISO14001, IATF16949, ISO45001 คุณสมบัติ วุฒิ ปวส. สาขาเครื่องกล ไฟฟ้า หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง มีประสบการณ์งานซ่อมบำรุงมากกว่า 3 ปี มีทักษะซ่อมบำรุงหลายด้าน ทั้งงานไฟฟ้า เครื่องกล ระบบท่อ และงานเชื่อม สามารถอ่านแบบไฟฟ้า เครื่องกล และระบบท่อพื้นฐานได้ ใช้ Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) และจัดทำเอกสารงานซ่อมบำรุงได้ในระดับพื้นฐานถึงปานกลาง มีประสบการณ์ในโรงงานอุตสาหกรรมหรือสายการผลิต วิเคราะห์ปัญหาและหาแนวทางแก้ไขได้อย่างเป็นระบบ Work location Bangpoo, Samutprakan BASF has been present in Thailand for more than 50 years. The company offers a wide range of products and solutions to support almost all the key industries in the country, including Agricultural Solutions, Intermediates and Process Catalysts, Monomers, Petrochemicals, Coatings, Dispersions and Resins, Performance Chemicals, Care Chemicals, Nutrition and Health, and Performance Materials. BASF in Thailand was established in 1966 and maintains its head office in Bangkok. It operates three production sites in Samutprakarn, Chonburi and Rayong, an Automotive Coatings Technical Competence Center, and a Performance Materials Technical Development Center in Samutprakarn. In 2024, BASF posted sales of €531 million to customers in Thailand and had 623 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/th .

jobs.name: Postdoc Fundamental Chemistry for Enabling Self-Driving Lab for Thermal CO₂ Valorization (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are inviting applications for a Postdoctoral Researcher within the ASCEND ( Accelerate Positive Clean Energy Districts) project, contributing to Work Package 01 Digital Catalysis and Work Package 04 Self-Driving Lab for Thermal CO₂ Valorization. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT The position focuses on the development of chemically meaningful descriptors and their on-demand computational generation, enabling their integration into data-driven experimental design frameworks. The overall objective is to support chemically informed and efficient exploration of large catalyst and process spaces within autonomous (self-driving) laboratory environments. You will develop physically and chemically meaningful descriptors for catalytic systems relevant to thermal CO₂ valorization. Furthermore, you will implement computational pipelines for scalable, on-demand descriptor generation. You will interface descriptor frameworks with data-driven exploration strategies. Additionally, you will contribute to method development and validation in collaboration with experimental and digital teams. You will support the integration of methods into self-driving laboratory workflows. Last but not least, you will disseminate results through scientific publications and project reports. WHAT YOU OFFER PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field strong expertise in computational chemistry (e.g. DFT, atomistic simulations) and catalyst modelling (heterogeneous and/or homogeneous systems) experience with Python-based scientific computing (e.g. FireWorks, Jobflow, pymatgen, ASE or similar tools) as well as modelling and analysis of catalytic or materials systems proven ability to translate chemical insight into quantitative descriptors knowledge of design of experiments (DOE), active learning, Bayesian optimization or machine learning methods for chemical systems is considered a plus familiarity with high-throughput computational or experimental workflows, automated or self-driving laboratory concepts, as well as strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams WHAT WE OFFER Participation in a collaborative, interdisciplinary research project within ASCEND Access to advanced computational and experimental infrastructures Opportunity to contribute to the development of next-generation autonomous research systems Dynamic research environment with strong academic and industrial collaboration HOW TO REACH US Larissa Anna Treiber (Talent Acquisition), larissa-anna.treiber@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-56384 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US Please attach a curriculum vitae, a publication list, as well as a brief research statement (maximum two pages) describing your relevant experience and research interests (in English). For more information about the ASCEND project, please visit the ASCEND project website . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Product Manager
jobs.description: Now hiring! Product Manager Houston, TX (Hybrid 3/2) This position required the availability to travel 25% of the time. We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Chemical Intermediates team in Houston, TX. Come create chemistry with us! At BASF, we create chemistry through the power of connected minds. As the world’s leading chemical company, we help our customers in nearly every industry meet the current and future needs of society through science and innovation. In this role, you will drive the strategic and operational direction of a broad portfolio of products within the Chemical Intermediates Americas regional business unit. Leveraging your collaboration and communication skills, you will act as the key interface to Sales, Customer Care, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, R&D, Product Stewardship and Legal in the Americas. Your analytical skills and strategic thinking capabilities will allow you to optimize the profitability of your product portfolio, which currently represents significant third-party sales via our assets at our biggest North American production site in Geismar, LA along with selectedimports from production facilities in Europe and Asia. As a Product Manager, you create chemistry by... Managing the product portfolio to deliver returns above cost of capital and drive business strategy execution, with full accountability for pricing, margin expansion, and profitability. Understanding regional market economics, growth, trends, opportunities, value chain, customers, and competitive environment. Implementing and managing the regional development and commercial strategies for product portfolio, including product positioning and business plan development and execution. Guiding the sales force relative to product pricing, positioning, negotiations, and customer communications to align with the business/product strategies. Driving continuous improvement across cost, quality, supply chain, and service levels to enhance competitiveness, financial performance, and operational excellence. Leading product portfolio lifecycle management, including launch, repositioning, management of change, and withdrawal. You will also support innovation projects for the product portfolio. Collaborating across the organization, including Customer Care, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, R&D, and Regulatory organizations, to successfully deliver business plan targets. Coordinating with Supply Chain on demand planning, product allocation, and inventory management. Identifying new leads, prioritizing projects, and commercializing opportunities to drive continuous growth of the portfolio. If you have... A Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering/Chemistry or closely related fields Industry experience, of which 5 years in Operations, Sales, Product Management and/or Procurement Previous Product Manager experience preferred. Solid understanding of supply chain principles and systems Solid business and financial acumen, analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent interpersonal communication skills, including: negotiation, influencing, presentation, reporting, and relationship building Focus on increasing efficiency and driving continuous improvements Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. jobs.name: Industrial Electrician
jobs.description: Now hiring! Industrial Electrician Attapulgus, GA. (Onsite) We are looking for an Industrial Electrician to join our Catalyst team in Attapulgus, GA. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Catalysts division is the global market leader in catalyst technologies. The division develops and produces mobile emissions catalysts as well as process catalysts and offers precious metals trading, recycling and related products and services. The BASF Attapulgus, Georgia site manufactures catalyst for the global refining industry. You will provide electrical support to BASF Attapulgus Operations with a Safety-First mindset.  This role will be responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting and repair of electrical equipment in an industrial plant, including power distribution, motor controls, PLC’s, wiring and process controls, involving work of a varied nature with minimum supervision. During your 12-hour rotating shift as a Industrial Electrician, you will • Recognize and practice safe work habits in all facets of daily duties. • Able to do normal lifting of heavy motors, circuit breakers, electrical cable, and other equipment utilized in the electrical industry. • Ability to read and interpret charts, tables, drawings, symbols, and equipment manuals used in industry. • Ability to use a multi-meter, clamp-on ammeter, and meg-ohmmeter in motor and control troubleshooting. • Possess skills and ability to properly wire 3-phase, 240/460 volt nine-lead motors, and respective starters. • Have working knowledge of relay logic, and able to wire I/O PLC systems per provided drawings. • Able to problem solve in hazardous conditions with time demands. • Able to identify important dimensions of a problem, determine potential causes, obtain relevant information, and specify alternate solutions. jobs.name: Global Customs Preferential Management & Rules of Origin (Executive) 1
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . O bjectives of the Position The purpose of this role is to support compliance with international trade regulations and contribute to the effective utilization of Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) across global operations. Within Preferential Management, the role supports BASF in safeguarding against financial and reputational risks by ensuring the accurate maintenance, validation, and processing of information required for preferential origin determination in accordance with applicable customs laws. The position supports the systematic determination of preferential origin through the collection, validation, and maintenance of supplier declarations (long-term and single-use), as well as the preparation and management of key data required for preferential origin assessments, including product compositions (BOMs), supplier information, and other supporting documentation. This role contributes to the accurate issuance of Free Trade Certificates and Origin Declarations for both customer and intercompany transactions while ensuring data integrity, documentation accuracy, and compliance with established procedures. Responsibilities Support the collection, preparation, maintenance, validation, and follow-up of data, supplier declarations, certificates, and supporting documentation required for Free Trade Agreements (FTAs). Support preferential origin determination activities through the collection, validation, and maintenance of information and supporting documentation required for origin assessments in accordance with established procedures. Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Business Units, Procurement, Manufacturing Sites, Logistics, and Customs teams to support the execution of Preferential Management activities. Work flexibly and collaborate with stakeholders across different time zones to support operational requirements. Participate in Preferential Management meetings and support the preparation of KPI, operational, and performance reports. Communicate with BASF customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure FTA-related requests and documentation requirements are fulfilled in a timely manner. Support activities related to FTA utilization and duty-saving opportunities through accurate data maintenance, documentation management, and timely execution of operational processes. Execute operational activities supporting customs authorizations, regulatory requirements, and Free Trade Agreement processes in accordance with established procedures. Prepare, maintain, and update operational reports by tracking FTA-related activities, including certificates issued, supplier declarations processed, and transactions by customer, product, and legal entity, ensuring data accuracy and timely updates. Maintain accurate documentation, record retention, and audit trails to support compliance with customs regulations, internal controls, and BASF policies. Support process improvement, standardization, digitalization, and automation initiatives to enhance service quality, efficiency, and compliance. Requirement Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience in the chemical industry would be an advantage. 1-2 years of relevant experience in Customs, Foreign Trade, Preferential Management, Trade Compliance, Supply Chain Operations, or Shared Services. Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply Ability to work flexibly and collaborate with stakeholders across different time zones. Basic understanding of customs regulations, Free Trade Agreements (FTAs), and Rules of Origin. Knowledge of HS tariff classification and customs valuation principles would be an advantage. Knowledge of BASF products, business processes, and markets would be an advantage. Exposure to project, process improvement, or system implementation activities would be an advantage. Knowledge of SAP master data systems; experience with SAP GTS would be an advantage. Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

jobs.description: Now hiring! Their focus will remain 1) safely executing the daily production schedule, and 2) developing their team performance over time for increasing levels of EHS and technical competency, contribution level and flexibility while respecting others, embracing diversity, collaborating for achievement Come create chemistry with us! WYDR has four Shift Group Leaders working on a rotating schedule with teams A, B, C, and D. Shift Group Leaders  may rotate teams every two or three years, or as required in special cases (business needs, skills alignments, etc.), to encourage a great conception of team. High School diploma/GED and 5+ years of chemical plant experience as an operator, team leader or equivalent. Nossa equipe dá suporte técnico para as diversas áreas da empresa em processos como compra e venda de produtos, contratação de serviços e importação e exportação de mercadorias, sempre cuidando da saúde financeira da BASF. Além disso, garantimos a conformidade tributária em todas as operações da BASF e regularidade fiscal perante as autoridades fiscais. Se você é dinâmico, estudioso e gosta de desafios, queremos você no nosso time! Área Tributos diretos, no que se refere ao Compliance, têm como missão garantir o estrito cumprimento das regras tributárias e assegurar o correto reporte das informações às autoridades fiscais. No que diz respeito à Consultoria, o objetivo é oferecer suporte às áreas da BASF em suas diversas operações, a fim de assegurar a correta tributação nas transações realizadas pela companhia, avaliando as possibilidades legais para redução da carga tributária. Além disso, prestamos suporte ao grupo em operações internacionais, garantindo que sejam conduzidas de maneira adequada e estratégica para a companhia. Candidato(a) Principais atividades: Consultoria Tributária e Operações Internacionais Prover e revisar consultoria tributária relacionada aos tributos diretos (IRPJ/CSLL, IRRF, CIDE, IOF etc.) para as operações da empresa, inclusive as internacionais, bem como emitir e revisar pareceres técnicos relacionados a esses tributos; Revisar as rotinas de tributação aplicáveis a serviços internacionais, incluindo operações intercompany e com terceiros. Planejamento Tributário e Projetos Estratégicos : apoiar projetos estratégicos, incluindo iniciativas de M&A e novos modelos de negócio, por meio de pesquisas, análises técnicas e avaliação dos respectivos impactos tributários. Acompanhamento de Riscos e Oportunidades Tributárias: identificar e avaliar riscos e oportunidades relacionados aos tributos diretos, promover discussões sobre esses temas, bem como coordenar o acompanhamento dos riscos e oportunidades da área de Tributos Diretos como um todo. Fiscalizações Tributárias: apoiar as estratégias de defesa e fornecer respostas em fiscalizações relacionadas a operações cross-border , bem como revisar respostas a fiscalizações, notificações, intimações e demais questionamentos de autoridades fiscais referentes aos demais temas da área de Tributos Diretos. Suporte Técnico e Capacitação: para os temas sob sua responsabilidade, atuar na preparação e na condução de treinamentos para stakeholders internos. Relacionamento com Stakeholders Externo: atuar como representante da BASF em fóruns externos, associações e discussões técnicas relacionadas aos temas de sua responsabilidade. Requisitos: Formação em Direito, Contabilidade ou Administração; Sólido conhecimento em tributos diretos (IRPJ/CSLL, IRRF, CIDE, IOF, etc.), bem como dos respectivos normativos. É desejável possuir conhecimentos em contabilidade e em Transfer Pricing; Habilidades avançadas no uso do pacote Office (Excel, Word e PowerPoint); Inglês avançado; Alto senso de responsabilidade (ownership), comunicação clara e efetiva, e orientação para resultados. Nossa química valoriza o talento e a diversidade de gênero, raça, idade, nacionalidade, crenças, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, deficiências e todas as demais características, diferenças e semelhanças que fazem parte da diversidade humana. Convidamos você a se candidatar em nossas vagas!  #BASF_EuRecomendo

Todas las candidaturas cualificadas que cubran el perfil para una posición se considerarán para nuestras vacantes sin distinción de edad, ciudadanía, tono de piel, religión, sexo, estado civil, nacionalidad, discapacidad, identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual,  origen étnico, lengua, identidad indígena, apariencia física, condiciones de salud, características genéticas, embarazo, religión, opiniones políticas, académicas o filosóficas, identidad o filiación política, por su forma de pensar, vestir, actuar, gesticular, por tener tatuajes o perforaciones corporales o cualquier otra condición análoga protegida por la ley del país correspondiente. En BASF, estamos comprometidos con la inclusión, proporcionando siempre que sea posible, ajustes razonables a las personas con discapacidad o con alguna necesidad específica, para garantizar su acceso y el uso de servicios.  En caso de requerir algún apoyo, favor de comunicarlo durante tu primer contacto con Atracción de Talento. Estamos buscando un(a) Especialista de EHS (Requisitos Legales e Higiene Industrial) para Altamira . Tendrá como objetivo coordinar los programas de Ecología, Higiene y Seguridad Industrial (EHS) de prevención.  Asesorar en el manejo de residuos y administrar los monitoreos ambientales asegurando el cumplimiento de los requerimientos gubernamentales, corporativos, de asociaciones relacionadas con la materia, para las áreas de: servicios generales, dispersiones y plásticos de ingeniería con base en las metas y objetivos de las unidades de negocio del sitio Altamira.  En este rol, estarás a cargo de: Asegurar la operación del sitio mediante administración de requerimientos legales en materia de Seguridad, Agua, Aire, Suelo, Residuos Peligrosos y de Manejo especial, presentando reportes a las autoridades (SEMARNAT, CONAGUA, STPS, PROTECCÓN CIVIL, SEDUMA, Municipio, ETC) , a fin de asegurar el cumplimiento legal, Federal, Estatal y Municipal del Sitio, dando cumplimiento a la normatividad vigente. Consolidar reportes ambientales internos y externos con la finalidad de dar cumplimiento a las políticas y estándares ambientales de la compañía e implementar programas de sustentabilidad en el Sitio. Consolidar los KPIs ambientales dentro del sitio, así como plantear acciones de mejora con las áreas correspondientes para los indicadores fuera de resultado. Asesorar a los líderes de cada área en el manejo adecuado de sustancias peligrosas, sustancias reguladas y todas aquellas que requieren permisos especiales para su almacenamiento, uso, transporte y disposición final. Coordinar el programa de medio ambiente para dar seguimiento a monitoreos de Ruido perimetral y emisiones a la atmosfera de acuerdo con el programa anual para asegurar el cumplimiento requerido por la normatividad aplicable y los requisitos corporativos. Elaborar los reportes y documentos para el cumplimiento de la legislación ambiental vigente y estándares corporativos (RC Report, OD Report, COA. otros relacionados) Desarrollar y administrar los programas de Higiene Industrial y Seguridad Industrial requeridos por la Normatividad Mexicana y BASF, como iluminación, ruido, protección respiratoria, protección auditiva, exposición a agentes químicos, en coordinación con el departamento de Salud Ocupacional y responsables de área, para implementar estrategias de reducción a la exposición y asegurar el cumplimiento legal. Dar soporte en materia de EHS a los equipos multidisciplinarios durante la ejecución de MOC's, y durante en las investigaciones de los incidentes de Ecología, Higiene y Seguridad (por ejemplo: derrames, exposición a químicos y lesiones que ocurran) a fin de identificar causas raíz y establecer acciones correctivas que eviten su recurrencia dentro del sitio, así como los manejos de cambio y el seguimiento al cumplimiento de las acciones generadas de los mismos. Proporcionar soporte con las recomendaciones técnicas de EHS durante la revisión de proyectos de capital, HIRAs y WWA. Desarrolla y administra el programa de capacitación en materia de EHS  de acuerdo a los procedimientos, legislación mexicana aplicable y estándares corporativos. Atender visitas de inspección y auditorías de autoridades federales, estatales o municipales y corporativas.  Mantener comunicación con las autoridades ambientales federales, estatales, municipales y asociaciones (AISTAC, ANIQ) para garantizar que la operación del sitio cumpla con el marco legal y estándares corporativos y representar a la empresa en el área de EHS. Elaborar y estandarizar procedimientos dónde se establezcan los lineamientos para el manejo integral de residuos, sustancias químicas peligrosas, temas ambientales y los requeridos, para garantizar el cumplimiento legal del Sitio. Así como, participar y dirigir Investigaciones de incidentes (AIM's), Manejos del Cambios (MOC's) y los análisis de riesgo requeridos dentro del sitio como parte del equipo de Ecología, Higiene y Seguridad. Coordinar las auditorías e inspecciones establecidas por las instancias de Gobierno y BASF, así como establecer el plan de acción  y seguimiento al  cierre de hallazgos en caso de presentarse. Informar de los cambios en la legislación en materia ambiental al sitio por cada evento, con la finalidad de que se realicen las actividades necesarias para evitar incumplimientos, así como actualizar matriz de requerimientos legales, Advisories de BASF y llenado del sistema Dakota, Worldlex entre otros. Si cuentas con: Formación Universitaria completa en ingeniería química, ambiental o similares con experiencia relevante para el rol. Mínimo 3-5 años de experiencia en gestión de Programas de Seguridad Ocupacional/Higiene Industrial. Conocimientos y experiencia en Gestión de Manejo de Residuos Peligrosos y No Peligrosos. Conocimientos y experiencia en Gestión de Requerimientos Legales en Materia de EHS Experiencia en auditorías ambientales e interacciones con agencias de gobierno. Manejo de paqueterías Office. Manejo de plataformas de cumplimiento legal (ej: Dakota, Worldlex, Norlex). Nivel de inglés avanzado (conversación y escrito). Habilidades de influencia, colaboración multidisciplinaria, comunicación, análisis, resolución de problemas, atención al detalle, enfoque en mejora continua y sustentabilidad. jobs.name: Global Customs Classification Manager I - Expert 1
jobs.description: O bjectives of the Position The Global Manager, Customs Classification is accountable for leading and overseeing all customs classification activities for BASF products, raw materials, and non-chemical materials in compliance with international and national regulations. The role ensures accurate classification, regulatory compliance, and harmonized processes globally, while providing strategic direction and governance across regions. In addition, the position is responsible for building and developing a high-performing global team, driving operational excellence, and ensuring alignment with business and regulatory requirements. Responsibilities Customs Service Delivery Lead the delivery of customs classification services to business units globally Act as escalation point for complex classification and customs-related issues Ensure timely and high-quality response to business queries and operational needs Drive effective collaboration with Trade Compliance, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders Customs Classification (Operations) Oversee and ensure accurate classification of products, raw materials, and non-chemical materials Maintain accountability for classification master data quality and governance Define and implement global standards, policies, and procedures for classification Monitor changes in customs laws, ensuring timely implementation across regions Drive global harmonization of classification data and processes Represent BASF interests in internal governance and external regulatory discussions Compliance & Risk Management Ensure full compliance with customs regulations, trade laws, and tariff schedules Lead audit readiness, compliance assessments, and internal control frameworks Identify and mitigate classification-related risks and discrepancies Oversee development and maintenance of SOPs and related documentation Performance Management & Reporting Define and track KPIs for classification activities across regions Review monthly reports, dashboards, and performance metrics Drive data transparency, analytics, and performance improvement initiatives Ensure effective reporting standardization and automation Process & Systems Improvement Lead digitalization and automation initiatives for classification processes Oversee system enhancements (e.g., SAP / SAP GTS) and related testing activities Drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency Ensure alignment of IT solutions with business and compliance needs Leadership & Team Management Lead, develop, and manage a globally distributed classification team Define roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations Conduct performance reviews and drive a culture of accountability Coach and develop team members to strengthen technical and leadership capabilities Ensure effective workload distribution and resource planning across regions Stakeholder & Governance Management Act as key interface between global, regional, and local classification teams Engage with senior stakeholders (e.g., Trade Compliance, Supply Chain leadership) Lead governance forums, alignment meetings, and knowledge-sharing platforms Ensure consistent adoption of global standards and best practices Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineer or any major in related scientific discipline Minimum 8-10 years’ relevant experience in Classification, Customs and Foreign Trade; familiar with Supply Chain operations Strong expertise in customs classification and trade regulations Knowledge of chemical and non-chemical product classification Experience with SAP and SAP GTS systems Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills Proficient in Microsoft Office tool English (fluent in spoken and written) German language will be advantages

jobs.name: Officer, Customer Service, Care Chemicals - Thai Speaking
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position Ensure accurate, timely, and compliant execution of end‑to‑end Order‑to‑Cash (OTC) processes. Act as major interface for customer accounts, supporting business continuity, issue resolution, and long‑term customer relationships Deliver professional and consistent customer service to assigned customers and accounts. Support Customer Service Supervisors and cross‑functional partners to ensure stable operations and customer satisfaction. Contribute to process discipline, service quality, and continuous improvement in daily operations Job Requirements: Order‑to‑Cash (OTC) Operations Create, maintain, and process sales orders in SAP, including order creation, changes, and completion. Monitor order status, delivery progress, and invoice status; follow up with planners, logistics, and supply units to ensure on‑time fulfillment and commit to KPIs requirements Proactively communicate delivery updates, order changes, and exceptions to customers and internal stakeholders. Handle returns, credit notes, debit notes, and other exceptional order scenarios according to procedures. Customer Interaction & Service Management Act as the primary contact for customer enquiries, requests, and service‑related issues. Ensure professional, timely, and solution‑oriented communication with customers. Support long‑term customer relationships through reliable service execution and customer focus. Coordinate closely with Sales to align on customer priorities and service expectations. Documentation & Compliance Manage order-related and shipping documentation in a timely and accurate manner. Ensure compliance with internal policies, trade regulations, and customer requirements. Maintain accurate master data and transactional data in SAP systems. Complaint & Issue Handling Register and manage customer complaints in the NCM system. Coordinate with internal stakeholders (Quality, Logistics, Sales, Finance) to resolve issues effectively. Support investigation, corrective actions, and follow‑up communication with customers. Process Support & Continuous Improvement Support assigned OTC or customer service processes as a process contributor or key user. Follow defined SOPs and working instructions; highlight deviations and improvement opportunities. Participate in service improvement initiatives and knowledge sharing within the team. Support adhoc projects as required Job requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or equivalent experience. Minimum 2 years of experience in Customer Service, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related operational roles. Hands on experience with OTC processes in a B2B environment. Solid SAP system knowledge and good PC skills for daily operations. Familiarity with foreign trade practices and customer service procedures. Strong sense of responsibility, customer orientation, and attention to detail. Ability to manage routine operations independently and escalate issues appropriately. Good team player with good communication skills About BASF BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Technician, Utilities & WWTP
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position • Supports the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Utilities plants to ensure continuous supply of utilities to the site and production plants according to required quality and operational demand. • Provides operational support to Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) activities through monitoring, sampling, laboratory testing and routine operational tasks to ensure compliance with safety, environmental, regulatory and operational requirements. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Boiler Operation 1. Supports the safe and reliable operation of Utilities plants and ensures equipment is maintained in good operational condition, including: i. Treated water storage and supply system, Water Demineralization Plant, Cooling Water System, and Fire Hydrant pumping facilities. ii. Steam generation plants and steam distribution system. iii. Air compressors and compressed air supply system. iv. Nitrogen Membrane Generator, LIN storage and evaporator, and nitrogen distribution system. 2. Support to operate and monitor the Diesel Engine Emergency Generator set during TNB power failure or emergency situations. 3. Records daily stock levels and consumption of utilities direct and indirect raw materials, including boiler gas fuel, water treatment chemicals, and other related consumables. 4. Supports the recording and updating of daily utilities supply data and operating parameters in computerized log sheets to ensure accurate operational records 5. Assists maintenance technicians during maintenance activities, major overhauls, plant shutdowns, troubleshooting, and repair works on Utilities equipment and machinery. 6. Supports the site Emergency Response Plan, including firefighting activities and other emergency requirements, as instructed. Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) Support Operations 1. Supports the operation and routine monitoring of the Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) to ensure stable operation and compliance with environmental, safety and operational requirements. 2. Support Performs routine wastewater sampling, field inspections, laboratory testing and operational checks in accordance with established procedures, monitoring plans and schedules. 3. Assists in monitoring and recording key operational and laboratory parameters, including pH, COD, flow, sludge-related observations and other relevant process indicators to support effective WWTP operation. 4. Assists the WWTP Technician/Competent Person in routine plant operation, troubleshooting activities, process monitoring and follow-up actions arising from abnormal operating conditions. 5. Supports sludge handling, dewatering, storage, documentation and scheduled waste management activities in accordance with applicable regulatory and site requirements. 6. Maintains accurate operational records, laboratory results, inspection findings and related documentation to support environmental compliance and reporting requirements. 7. Reports abnormalities, equipment issues, process deviations or potential compliance concerns to the superior or WWTP responsible person for further evaluation and action. Others 1. Supports the implementation and compliance of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, 5S, Process Safety Management, and other site management systems by practicing established procedures and requirements. 2. Maintains good housekeeping and cleanliness at Utilities plants, Wastewater Treatment Plant areas, and related work locations. 3. Supports safe work practices and complies with BASF safety, health, environmental, quality, and operational requirements at all times. 4. Performs any additional duties or tasks assigned by management from time to time. Job Requirements (minimum requirement to carry out the work) Minimum Diploma in Environment, Chemical or Mechanical background Possess a valid 2nd Grade Boiler Operator Certificate. Possess relevant DOE certifications such as CePIETSO-PCP and CePSWaM. Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in Boiler Operation, with hands-on knowledge and skills in boiler system troubleshooting. Minimum 1 to 3 years of experience in Wastewater Treatment Plant operations would be an added advantage. Technical & Professional Knowledge Strong technical knowledge of boiler operation, including equipment and machinery design, function, operating limitations, maintainability, and safety features. Good understanding of local regulatory requirements related to boiler operation. Additional knowledge of utilities systems such as Water Demineralization Plant, Air Compressors, Nitrogen Membrane Generators, LIN Evaporator, and related distribution systems. Able to use computers for routine work management and familiar with common Microsoft Office applications such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Good command of English, with the ability to speak, read, and write effectively. Familiar with management systems and workplace practices such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001/18001, 5S, and other BASF site standards. BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Deputy Manager - Finance
jobs.description: About BASF in Vietnam BASF has been active in Vietnam since the establishment of its representative office in 1994 and celebrates its 30-year presence in the country this year. BASF Vietnam Limited was set up in 2009. The company maintains two sales offices in Hồ Chí Minh City and Hà Nội, offering solutions for Vietnam’s key industries, including Agriculture, Construction, Automotive, Footwear, Paints & Coatings and Electrical & Electronics. BASF’s sales to customers in Vietnam were approximately €238 million in 2023. BASF employed 110 people in Vietnam as of the end of the year. Further information on BASF in Vietnam is available at www.basf.com/vn . Objectives Oversee all accounting and tax-related operations to ensure full compliance with Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS), IFRS, local tax regulations, FDI policies, and BASF group policies and Corporate requirements. Ensure financial integrity and transparency through proper accounting, compliance reporting, and support for audits. Act as a key liaison with internal and external stakeholders (e.g. auditors, local authorities, BASF teams, and consultants) Execute Customer Credit Risk Management, Receivables, and Treasury operations in line with local regulations and BASF guidelines to support business needs. Provide technical and functional guidance on these areas to stakeholders. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Compliance and Governance: Ensure timely and accurate recording of all financial transactions, ensure compliance with IFRS, VAS, tax regulations, and FDI requirements through up-to-date knowledge and liaison with authorities and advisors. Establish, document, and maintain internal accounting policies, procedures, and tax guidelines. Regularly communicate updates to relevant stakeholders. Monitor and implement changes in local GAAP and tax regulations to ensure compliance and operational readiness. Coordinate and prepare accurate and timely financial statements in compliance with local and group standards including Tax filings (VAT, CIT, FCT, etc.), CbCR (Country-by-Country Reporting), transfer pricing (local file) report, and Quarterly tax notes. Lead statutory and tax audits. Serve as the primary contact point for local tax authorities, tax advisors, and compliance consultants. Operational excellence: Oversee day-to-day accounting operations to ensure transactional accuracy and alignment across systems. Support fixed assets management and impairment review. Coordinate physical verification of fixed assets. Coordinate with the auditors, supply chain and warehouse team to ensure an accurate and thorough observation of the annual physical stock count. Coordinate effectively with internal departments and Shared Service Centers to ensure smooth and timely execution of month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities. Manage cash/liquidity position of the company and liaise with Regional Treasury team to ensure availability of funds Prepare and administer bank-related documentation (hedging, deposits, guarantees, facilities), and manage signatory rights and user access. Ensure full compliance with transfer pricing requirements, including managing the preparation of Transfer Price documentation in collaboration with external consultants. Play the role of Insurance gatekeeper (e.g.: Marine Cargo Insurance (MCI); Public and Products Liability Insurance (PPL); Property all risks and Business interruption Insurance (PDBI)). Perform contract review from local finance and tax perspectives. Lead enhancements to the local e-Invoice portal to ensure compliance with updated tax regulations. Play the role of expense processor and local key user of Non-Trade Portal and MDG (Customer). Support cross-functional projects, including finance transformation and digitalization initiatives. Credit Management Oversee collection of all receivables for business teams, minimize DSO (Day Sales Outstanding), and performance indicators. Carry out credit risk evaluation, risk mitigation and annual credit review in line with sales strategies and local market practices. Perform business partnering with customer visits, financial consultancy, business, and customer trainings. Handle debt recovery with collection agent, lawyer, or court. Ensure relevant documents are maintained for effective debt validation and recovery. Handle provision for doubtful debts and write-off of bad debts with business teams. Assume local key user of SCO (Smart credit optimized), CARAT (Controlling Accounts Receivable Analysis Tools), and FSCM (Financial Supply Management) or other system as applicable. Account Receivable Oversee end-to-end request/ transaction process together with Supply Chain, GB Hub and related stakeholders. Provide insight to resolve issues, inefficiencies, and queries. Oversee process of non-trade business (Customer). Oversee accounts receivable adjustments such as Rebate process, Goods return, Customer compensation. Requirements Degree in Accounting / Finance or equivalent professional qualifications. Chief Accountant certificate 7 years of relevant working experience in MNCs with international manufacturing and trading operations, preferably with a finance-shared service center environment. Experience in business partnering or financial planning and analysis roles are preferred. In-depth knowledge of local accounting practices, the Vietnamese Accounting Standards and System, Vietnamese tax regulations, and related statutory requirements. Knowledge of relevant international financial and reporting standards. Hands-on knowledge of SAP or other International ERP systems is advantageous. E.G Oracle Good command of English and Excel skills.

jobs.name: HR Payroll Officer (Dutch-speaking) (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation, and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Are you ready to play a key role in our Belgium Payroll team? As part of our team, you'll manage the payroll and post-payroll process for our Belgian employees, covering everything from social security and taxes to time management and compensation & benefits. Your responsibilities will include: Payroll & Processes: Prepare and execute monthly payroll while implementing, improving, and maintaining our administrative HR processes in SAP HR and other HR systems. Compliance & Regulation: Ensure all legal and regulatory requirements for our HR services are met. Collaborate closely with our local HR Business Partners in Belgium, our internal service team in Berlin, and technical providers to maintain a compliant, efficient payroll. Projects & Knowledge Sharing: Participate in internal projects and promote best practice sharing across our HR teams in the EMEA region. Analizar y dar seguimiento de partidas pendientes por diferencias entre reconciliaciones de operaciones intra-BASF. Creación de contratos con terceros respecto a descuentos por volúmenes de ventas en tiempo y forma. Ejecutar las Notas de crédito por descuentos por volúmenes de ventas a terceros en tiempo y forma.
