jobs.name: Global Market Intelligence & Digital Marketing Manager - Home Care & I&I
jobs.description: Now hiring! Global Market Intelligence & Digital Marketing Manager - Home Care & I&I Florham Park, NJ (Hybrid) We are looking for a Global Market Intelligence & Digital Marketing Manager to join our Home Care & I&I team in Florham Park, NJ. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Care Chemicals division is a globally leading supplier to the cosmetics, detergents and cleaning industries. We also offer solutions for technical applications and crop protection. Together with our customers, we create innovative solutions to meet the current and future needs of society more sustainably. We contribute to the long-term success of our customers’ brands with a broad range of products and concepts via our global network of production and development site. The Global Market Intelligence & Digital Marketing Manager is responsible for translating market insights into actionable strategies while supporting marketing initiatives that drive growth across the Home Care and Industrial & Institutional Cleaning business. This role combines market intelligence, digital marketing, customer insights, and broader marketing activities to support business growth, customer engagement, and strategic decision making. The position works closely with marketing, sales, technical service, communications, and global stakeholders to strengthen BASF's market position and improve marketing effectiveness. As a Global Market Intelligence & Digital Marketing Manager - Home Care & I&I, you create chemistry by… Defining and refining market trends, customer insights, competitive intelligence, and growth opportunities Developing and maintaining market intelligence dashboards, reporting, and business insights Translating market, customer, and competitive insights into business, innovation, and marketing recommendations Leading digital marketing initiatives including web, email, analytics, and customer segmentation Coordinating digital tools, platforms, and product information management activities Supporting strategic planning and growth initiatives through market, customer, and competitive analysis Identifying emerging market opportunities, industry trends, and business risks Supporting marketing communications, customer-facing content, and promotional materials Supporting industry events, customer engagement activities, and marketing initiatives Driving marketing analytics, reporting, and continuous improvement efforts Ensuring alignment across marketing, sales, technical service, and business stakeholders If you… Hold a bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field Have experience in B2B marketing, digital marketing, or market intelligence Possess strong analytical and data interpretation skills Bring experience working in global, cross-functional teams Have strong communication and stakeholder management skills Are able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Pay transparency BASF is committed to pay transparency practices. The competitive pay range for this role is $108,000 - $135,000. Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.name: Domestic Delivery Services (Intern)
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position Responsible for co-ordination and planning the local distribution and warehouse. Responsible for SAP Transport management and creation. Ensure maintain supply chain functions standards accordance to all local regulatory compliance and Corporate Functions' requirements. Job Responsibilties: To perform Hub Domestic Delivery services according to process and business continuity. Manage day to day transport management surface (local order & cross border deliveries) and warehouse operation, to ensure completion of the order fulfillment process. Perform and follow up delivery operations to ensure meet operational KPI (trucking booking, Transport Management update, on-time delivery, delivery reliability, Post Goods Issue/Goods Received on time etc.) Collaborate with relevant party like etc. customer service, import/export, plant, business units, forwarders, transporters on daily Transport Management Surface Perform inventory goods received (GR), post goods issue (PGI) in the system Coordinate and follow up with relevant service providers on operational matters Preparing monthly report (Non-conformance report, Transport Management report, stock report and etc.) Participate yearly inventory stock count, to update the inventory discrepancies in system Ensure that Logistics operations are according to local regulatory and BASF's safety & Transport Distribution safety and environment guideline. Job Requirements Diploma or degree holder in logistics, supply chain or related discipline. Good capability in written and verbal English and Bahasa Malaysia; Have intercultural competence, communication and language skills; Proactive and solution orientated; Have issue handling skills; Skillful in software of excel, word and PowerPoint; Experience in SAP preferred. About BASF in Malaysia BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Payroll & People Data Analyst (Thai speaker) - 12 months Contract
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position •    Understand business needs and provide expert advice, services and solutions on Payroll, HR data, systems and processes. •    Provide expert consultation in payroll and HR data practices by staying abreast of current and emerging market insights and legal legislations in local countries. •    Drive process improvements, automation, and digitalization measures to offer best service delivery experience. •    Ensure payroll and statutory reporting and payments are processed with high accuracy and timeliness according to our SLAs and local legal requirements. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Operational Excellence •    Ensure data quality and data integrity for Payroll and HR data maintenance processes. •    Manage full payroll portfolio (either in-house or via vendors) accurately, timely and in compliance with statutory requirements, business policies and company guidelines. Responsible for payroll issues resolutions, data analysis, payroll accounting activities, payroll taxation and legislation administration. •    Provides solutions to manage time and attendance processes for office and production workers, including the maintenance of time system configurations, time settings such as public holiday calendar maintenance, work schedules arrangements, time calculation rules etc. •    Provide actual payroll and compensation data based on SAPHR to the Compensation & Benefits and Mobility teams in support of the salary review management. Develop expertise in International labor and social standards and support relevant internal/external audit analysis (for example: Corporate Audits, external audits, FRC processes) •    Responsible for vendor management for Payroll, which includes service provider scouting, selection, negotiation, contract management, onboarding, performance monitoring and vendor invoice processing. •    Accountable to ensure finance processes with relevance to payroll is followed through with high accuracy and timeliness. Service Engagement •    Provide advisory such as manual payment calculation, pay slip simulation, gross up computations for payment, national service claims etc. •    Monitor and stay abreast with local payroll legislation which affects the HR climate and support business to manage changes proactively. •    Analyze, clarify, and resolve operation issues and enquiries with close collaboration with relevant Country HR and Regional HR Business Partners to ensure quality services are delivered from the service hub. All unsolved and potential operational issues are escalated timely according to establish escalation process, with detailed analysis provided to Assistant Manager and Manager. Process Improvement and Project Initiatives •    Continuously review and update knowledge documents in areas of Payroll and HR data to develop the formation of competence hub. •    Identify opportunities, prepare and analyze business case and participate in digitalization and process optimization. Actively work on implementation of process improvements, automation and digitalization measures which will be rolled out predominantly in the GB KL Hub for achieving the efficiency target. •    Drive initiatives which contribute to the improvement of service experience •    Develop and maintain the blueprints of multiple system processors in Payroll and HR data maintenance processes to ensure the capturing of business requirements, system settings, configuration needs and change trackers. Provide inputs and participate in user acceptance testing in system maintenance and upgrade, follow up and escalate timely with respective party to ensure fixes or changes can be delivered on time. •    Participate in mergers and acquisitions activities pertaining to setting up or transfer of payroll and HR data maintenance activities. Ensure successful implementation of payroll and HR data maintenance processes for mergers and acquisition activities. Team Collaboration •    Works autonomously within established procedures and practices; seeks guidance in the more complex aspects of the process. •    Contribute positively to a knowledge sharing environment through generously provide guidance and sharing knowledge with others. •    Guides and trains junior team members and newly joined team members. Job Requirements Education •    Relevant tertiary qualifications: Degree in Accounting, Mathematics, Commerce, Business Administration and Finance Working Experience •    With minimum 3 years of related HR working experiences in Payroll and HR Operations •    Experience in relevant payroll procedures, practices and country statutory •    Working knowledge of integrated payroll systems preferably on SAP. Technical & Professional Knowledge •    Demonstrates a high level of proficiency in language and culture of the supported country/location. •    Understanding of HR principals and/or Employee Laws of the supported country/location. •    Strong processing skills and analytical abilities (inclination for Mathematics/Finance/Problem solving). •    Service mindset with strong interpersonal and communications skills. •    Functional knowledge and skills in using Microsoft application i.e. Words, Excel, Power Point.

jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF The Service Unit Global Engineering Services crafts and engineers a sustainable future with world class technical expertise. Our interdisciplinary, global, committed teams serve the BASF businesses to grow with our customers, products and markets. We add value by delivering competitive execution of investments. On construction sites across the globe, we deliver safe and reliable solutions to build and keep BASF assets operating at top performance. In doing so, we continuously improve and drive digital transformation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In the field of industrial communications technology, we support operations with industrial and hazard communication technology. In addition to conventional system technologies, we use innovative technologies for early hazard detection in the process industry. You will support us in the further development and implementation of our solutions. Possible topics include artificial intelligence (AI), PLC programming, computer vision, evaluation of innovative technologies. The focus of your work will be jointly determined depending on your interests and skills. At the Ludwigshafen site, you will work for this purpose in an interdisciplinary and cross-departmental team, in which you will present and discuss your results and implement them in the companies. WHAT YOU OFFER advanced bachelor's or master's degree in a STEM field of study good programming skills (e.g. Python, C/C++, Codesys) advantageous: knowledge in software versioning and MLOps (e.g. Git, DVC), machine learning, computer vision, network technology very good communication in German and English independent familiarization with new topics as well as the ability to actively contribute your ideas to the team we look forward to receiving your application documents, including a current certificate of enrollment. if it is a compulsory internship, please attach your study regulations or a corresponding document certifying the duration of the compulsory internship to your complete application documents WHAT WE OFFER Practical phase - actively apply theory in challenging and varied tasks/projects Teambuddy - contact person for all questions and regular feedback Networks - get to know different perspectives, ways of thinking and fields of work Internship compensation - a recognition of the commitment, more information here: on.basf.com/compensationBASFSE Flexible working hours - depending on the location and area of work HOW TO REACH US Yulia Haars (Talent Acquisition), yulia.haars@basf.com, will be happy to answer your questions for this position You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here: on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US BASF SE, located in Ludwigshafen am Rhein, is the corporate headquarters of the BASF Group and part of the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region. BASF stands for competence in chemistry since 1865 and is represented today in the world's major consumer markets, with a wide range of products. As the largest employer in the region, BASF SE offers multiple career opportunities for students, university graduates and professionals providing also training in over 30 professions. Leisure, sports, culture and a good infrastructure characterize the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region, in which BASF is also involved with numerous activities. Learn more about BASF SE at on.basf.com/BASFSE_LU Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.
